articleTitle: Application of data mining in intelligent power consumption
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In this paper, the key technologies of data mining are firstly studied detailedly, and huge data of intelligent power consumption are transformed into valued knowledge which applies advanced data mining technology based on the huge data. It focuses on the application in the intelligent power consumption field, and the applications, such as classification of power customers, analysis of power consumption of intelligent appliance, analysis of abnormal family electricity consumption and so on, which are realized by clustering algorithm, correlation analysis algorithm and outlier analysis algorithm. The analysis results can lead power consumers to use electricity rationally, and provide decision support for power companies.

articleTitle: The FPGA verification of USB to RS-232 bridge controller
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The digital circuit of USB to RS-232 bridge controller is designed; HDL procedure of digital circuit module is downloaded to the FPGA verification board. A driver of the controller which works under the Windows XP is developed using softwares such as DDK, VC6.0, and the virtual COM is realized. Under driver and relevant cooperation of hardware environment, expected the function succeed of the controller is realized in the FPGA. This bridge graft device can be used in the data transmission between serial interface of the mobile phone and USB interface of the computer, reaching the effect of verification.

articleTitle: UAV flight control system modeling and simulation based on flightGear
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In order to develop a new aircraft model for FlightGear, this paper has described the establishing process of the 3D aircraft model and the configuration files which are mainly described in XML format. Aiming at finding an effective way to design and test the control law for the UAV, a real-time visual flight simulation system is constructed based on FlightGear. In this simulation system, the FlightGear visual module is driven to simulate the real-time 3D UAV model which contains flight states, weather condition and geographic environment. And the fight simulation data is sent to the FlightGear simulator through autopilot I/O port by UDP. This simulation system plays an important role in designing and testing the control law, and has made good effect on validating the control law of the UAV. The simulation results have shown that this visual flight simulation system is economic, valid, feasible, and has great progress on enhancing the efficiency of the project.

articleTitle: Kernel least-mean mixed-norm algorithm
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The Kernel method is a powerful tool for extending an algorithm from linear to nonlinear case. The least-mean mixed-norm (LMMN) algorithm possesses good performance when the system measurement noise shows distribution with a linear combination of long tails and short tails. In this paper, we combine the famed kernel trick and the LMMN algorithm to present the kernel LMMN (KLMMN) algorithm, which is an adaptive filtering algorithm in reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS). The optimal norm-mixing parameter is derived. To demonstrate the effectiveness and superiorities of the proposed algorithm, we apply the algorithm to nonlinear system identification when the environment noise composed of a linear combination of Gaussian and Bernoulli distributions.

articleTitle: Efficient maximum-likelihood period estimation from incomplete timing data
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The problem of estimation the period of a periodic event from a sequence of noisy, incomplete time-of-arrival (TOA) observations is studied. A novel grid spacing determination strategy is proposed for a class of numerical-search estimators, whose performances is determined by grid spacing selection. A modified algorithm based on the Fogel's Periodogram estimator is proposed by employing that strategy. It is shown that our algorithm is very likely to yield the maximum likelihood estimate (MLE), with a low complexity of O(n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>). Simulation results demonstrate the superior performance of our estimator comparing with the other existing estimators.

articleTitle: Research on Synchronized non-coherent blinking jamming to monopulse radar seeker
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Blinking jamming could effectively jam missile which is equipped with monopulse radar seeker and increase missile's miss distance. The performance of blinking jamming used to against monopulse radar seeker is affected by power ratio of two jammers, period of blinking and so on. In order to improve performance of blinking jamming, a novel realization of blinking jamming based on two jammers transmitting simultaneously the jamming signal is proposed. An angle measuremengt model was established for different blink jammers to study the result that power ratio and blinking period which impact the performance of blinking jamming. The results indicated that little value of power ratio could obviously delay the monopulse seeker distinguishing targets and appropriate period of blinking jamming could make the probability of temporary steady tracking increase.

articleTitle: Attitude stabilization control of a quadrotor helicopter using integral Backstepping
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Quadrotor helicopters are emerging as a popular platform for unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) research. This work included integral action in a Backstepping design for attitude stabilization control of quadrotor helicopter. Firstly, a complete dynamic model of quadrotor was built using blade element and momentum theories. Based on this dynamic model a new controller called ‘Integral Backstepping’ was designed by added tracking error integral term to the normal Backstepping controller. Through various simulations and the real flight experiment, it is proved that the new controller was quite effective and the integral term indeed brought robustness against model uncertainties in the controller.

articleTitle: Ziegler-Nichols based intelligent controller design of a SPM system
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This work applied a vertical probe without the balance and lever arm as in the previous design of a Scanning Probe Microscope (SPM) system. Ziegler-Nichols-based PID and the intelligent fuzzy methods are also integrated for the controller design, thus the relative stability can be reserved at the nominal condition. Besides, even the system with parameters variation we can see not only the voice coil hysteresis effects are reduced to one fifth, but the respond speed is also increased by five times. So both the accuracy and response speed can be increased. This effect is not discussed before. Comparing the results with the design by the traditional Ziegler-Nichols-based PID controller, we find this system is more robust.

articleTitle: Automatic woven fabric classification based on support vector machine
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In the textile industry, the classfication of woven fabric is usually manual. To improve work efficiency, this paper purposes a novel approach to extract image features for woven fabric's recognition automatically. Firstly, the local binary pattern method and the gray level co-occurrence matrix are adopted to compute the fabric image features. Then, the principal component analysis is utilized to reduce the high dimensional feature data. Lastly, a support vector machine is used as a classifier to recognize the woven fabric type. The experiments show that these methods can automatically and accurately classify the plain weave fabrics, twill weave fabrics and satin weave fabrics.

articleTitle: An optimization algorithm based on ant colony algorithm
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper proposes an optimization algorithm to resolve combinatorial optimization problem. Congestion degree in the artificial fish school algorithm is used in ant colony algorithm in this paper. During the initial process of the optimization, the congestion degree plays the main role to guide the ants to search the new path randomly, which makes the algorithm have the stronger ergodicity searching ability. The role of the congestion degree gradually decreases to zero, the algorithm becomes the conventional ant colony and completes the optimal process by the principle of pheromone positive feedback, which insures the algorithm to have a quick convergence rate. Simulation experiment result shows this algorithm not only overcomes possible problem such as prematurity phenomenon in the early period of the ant colony algorithm, and enhances algorithm the ability of traversal optimization, but also has fast convergence speed, and improves optimal performance. This algorithm is better than the adaptive ant colony algorithm and the adaptive fish school algorithm.

articleTitle: A cluster-tree based data gathering algorithm for wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: A wireless sensor network (WSN) consists of a lot of tiny sensing devices, which can monitor environment or other events. Because these devices run on battery, energy is an extremely critical resource for them. Thus, energy-efficient method need be carefully designed for data gathering. Most of the existing energy-efficient algorithms always forward packets by clusters or tree. Both the structure of clustering and tree can realize to gather data with energy-efficient method. In this paper, considering the concept of clustering and tree, we proposed a cluster-tree data gathering algorithm (CTDGA) to reduce the energy consumption when a WSN is used to gather data. In CTDGA, the goal of this basic approach is to use the architecture of cluster to gather data from the nodes sensed interesting event to the cluster-head (CH) so as to reduce the transmission energy in a cluster. Then, a special CH is responsible for gathering data from other CHs and transferred the data to sink node by the architecture of tree so as to protect the CHs with relatively low residual energy. Our simulation results show that CTDGA can improve energy efficiency, and thus prolong network lifetime.

articleTitle: Simulation of the direct instantaneous torque control of SRM using MATLAB
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Direct instantaneous torque control (DITC) method of the switched reluctance motor (SRM) is studied in this paper. Modeling and simulations of the DITC system have been conducted with MATLAB/Simulink. The simulation results accurately reflect the actual operation states of SRM. It is verified that DITC method can effectively reduce the torque ripple of SRM.

articleTitle: Research on the compromising electromagnetic emanations from digital signals
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Information can be compromised by electromagnetic emissions from running information technology equipments. Most data in these equipments are processed or transmitted as digital signals, and they're of vital importance to ensure the emission security of digital signals. As the data rate goes faster and faster, the edges of the digital signal get sharper, which means it contains more high-frequency components and can generate electromagnetic emission by small-sized antenna-effect components of the equipment. The level fluctuation process may be recovered or demodulated by analyzing the intercepted electromagnetic emission, thus restore the digital signal and course information security problem. Characteristics of the digital signal are analyzed in depth and the electromagnetic emissions of digital signals with different wave forms are researched. Finally, compromising emanations examples of digital signals with different characteristics are analyzed.

articleTitle: A robot dance system based on real-time beat prediction
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In this paper, we present a robot with a system of tracking beats and downbeats from musical audio in real time as well as automatically synthesizing dance motions synchronized to the extracted musical events. And a real-time beat prediction approach improved by an off-line analysis is described, which has positive effects on the estimations of beat and downbeat. We also make an attempt to solve the problem of enabling a robot to understand the played music and accomplish dance compositions intelligently itself. Consequently, the experimental results are quite encouraging and show that our implemented robot, to some extent, has the ability of dancing in time to the music.

articleTitle: Optimization and scheduling of AGV in automated warehouse system based on immune algorithm
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: AGV as an important part of automated warehouse system, it can improve the efficiency of the system. One way travelling path of AGV is simple, but always leads to deadlock and lower efficiency. On consideration of bidirectional AGV travelling path, an alternative path policy is proposed to avoid deadlock. The transporting tasks of AGV are constructed by bipartite graph and a task allocation based on maximum-weight matching in bipartite graph is proposed. The steps of allocation method are described in detail. An algorithm based on immune algorithm is given to solve the problem. The simulation result shows that the proposed method is effective and can be used in practical.

articleTitle: An improved tracking dirrerentiator capable of compensating phase lag
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: An improved tracking differentiator(ITD) is proposed for processing the signal with noise. Tracking differentiator(TD) is a kind of low-pass filter utilized in many industrial control systems for its advantages: simple structure, model-independence, and so on. TD not only has the function of filtering the signal, but also can provide derivatives of the signal at the same time. Like most low-pass filter, TD have the same disadvantage: producing the phase lag while eliminating the noise. ITD presented in this paper is to solve this problem. By the frequency domain analysis, the filtering effect of the ITD is discussed. The result is compared with the TD filter. Both the theoretical analysis and the simulation results indicate that the ITD obviously decrease the phase lag, and has the better tracking accuracy.

articleTitle: Fish motion tracking based on RGB color space and interframe global nerest neighbour
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Detection and tracking is still a difficult and important problem. In order to improve the algorithm of detection and tracking in our work, an efficient method is proposed in this paper. The main research contents are as follows: 1)moving detection of fish based on RGB-color and contour information, where multi-threshold is used to segment the color image. 2)moving tracking of fish based on interframe global nearest neighbour (IGNN) algorithm. Experimental results demonstrate that detection inaccuracy and shadow are solved. Meanwhile, the method is robust to illumination and noise, so that it can meet the requirements of actual applications.

articleTitle: Distributed parallel processing of mobile robot PF-SLAM
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Real-time property is a fundamental requirement for a practical robot system. For this purpose, this article proposes an implementation architecture of robot SLAM by adopting two parallel threads processing. Since the dominant factor which determines the computational complexity is the employed particle number, two distributed threads with different particle set size are executed simultaneously. Conventional PF-SLAM algorithm occupies one of threads, and the other thread which hires more particles is activated whenever robot has significant motion changes. Advantages of this presented idea are validated by experiment carried on Pioneer robot.

articleTitle: TCP Vegas-V: Improving the performance of TCP Vegas
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: It has been proved that TCP Vegas can make better performance compared to many other delay-based transport protocols, such as TCP Reno. However, when TCP Vegas is used in the mixed network environment that coexists with other TCP flows, it still exist some disadvantages in aspect of sharing with bandwidth, such as unfairness and less aggressive. So we propose a new congestion avoidance mechanism based on TCP Vegas to overcome such disadvantages and make its performance that features of fairness and aggressive, become much more efficiently. By our simulations, it proves that our algorithm (TCP Vegas-V) guarantees good performance that meets our demands in the respect of sharing with bandwidth and preserves the properties of Vegas that the desirable feature (e.g. stability) when TCP Vegas-V coexists with other congestion control mechanisms in the network.

articleTitle: Navigation line detection based on support vector machine for automatic agriculture vehicle
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Agriculture image segmentation plays an important role in the agriculture vehicle navigation. Robust segmentation gives a better influence on the extraction of navigation parameters. The color image was converted into gray scale image, and in order to obtain more crop row information, the average image of the gray scale one based on rectangle weight module were realized. The standard deviation of every pixel was computed too, to remain the origin crop row width. The average and the deviation value were fused and as a new input factor of support vector machine to segment image. In order to save running time of algorithm, all the operation were executed on the low resolution image obtained through wavelet analysis. The result of segmentation obviously conquered the influence of broken ridges, weeds and others high frequency disturbs. The running time is less than 0.6s when the program was written in Matlab.

articleTitle: Simulation analysis of MUSIC algorithm of array signal proccessing DOA
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Array signal processing is an important branch of the modern signal processing, and the source orientation is an important application of array signal processing. The MUSIC algorithm, can super distinguish the direction of arrival (DOA).Through the simulation, the paper Comprehensively analyzed the classical MUSIC algorithm, Roots MUSIC algorithm, the fourth-order cumulant MUSIC DOA estimation algorithm, it analyzed the performance of three algorithms in the same signal noise ratio and in different signal-noise ratio, it is indicated that the signal-noise ratio is an important influence factor of the resolution of the MUSIC algorithm.

articleTitle: Interpolated NC-root-MUSIC algorithm for almost uniform linear arrays
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: A novel method of applying array interpolation and polynomial rooting to NC-MUSIC (multiple signal classification for noncircular signals) algorithm, termed as IN-root-MUSIC, is presented for almost uniform linear arrays (AULAs). The method is accuracy and computationally efficient because AULAs are interpolated to uniform linear arrays (ULAs) for which the polynomial rooting can be used without modelling errors.

articleTitle: Open architecture multi-axis motion control system for industrial robot based on can bus
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: To shorten the developing period of multi-axis motion control (MAMC) system for industrial robots in different manufacturing places, it often prefers motion controllers to be modularized. In that case we can connect a certain number of controllers together for occasions where more axis (>6) controlling or multi-robot collaboration is needed. This methodology allows for a highly accurate, flexible, compact, and low-cost motion control system. In order to connect those controllers, CAN bus become the best choice due to its excellent stability and high compatibility with many existing industrial systems. To achieve better interchangeability and interoperability, the system adopts an open architecture. All the control tasks are assigned to personal computer (PC) and motion controllers respectively. The whole multi-axis motion control system is implemented on a platform consisting of a can bus based multi-axis motion controller, servo drivers, a 6-Degree-of-Freedom arc-welding industrial robot and a host personal computer. Furthermore, it has been proved that the newly developed controller achieves desirable performance in Qianjiang-I arc-welding robot with advanced adaptive PID control algorithm.

articleTitle: An improved PSO-based optimum design of speed controller for BLDC motor
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This Paper presents an improved particle swarm optimization (PSO) method for speed control of the brushless DC (BLDC) motor. With introducing a shrinkage factor into PSO algorithm, the speed control ability of the BLDC motor can be improved. The brushless DC motor is modeled in Simulink and the PSO algorithm is implemented in MATLAB. Comparing with fuzzy control method, the proposed method is more efficient in improving the step response characteristics, such as, reducing the steady-states error; rising time, settling time and maximum overshoot in speed control of a linear brushless DC motor.

articleTitle: A new DCT-based digital image watermarking algorithm
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel digital image watermarking algorithm, which can embed a multi-bit message into the image and realize the blind extraction of the message. To embed the watermark, the image is firstly scrambled to enhance the security. Then, some feature vectors based on the DCT of the scrambled image are extracted. The expanded watermark generated using the spread spectrum technique is embedded into the extracted feature vectors. The Watson perceptual model is also considered to obtain good invisibility. By means of corresponding inverse transformations we get the watermarked image. The watermark extraction process is similar as the embedding process. Unlike previous works, we use a new scheme to extract the image feature vectors and embed the watermark repeatedly into them. And the codebook in spread spectrum watermark generation is orthogonalized and unitized. These steps can dramatically improve the robustness of the watermark. Experiment results demonstrate the robustness of our algorithm against various common attacks such as JPEG compression, additive noise, histogram equalization, low-pass filtering and cropping.

articleTitle: Improved stability for linear system with sawtooth delay
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper considers an improved approach for linear systems with sawtooth delay. By constructing a new time-dependent piece-wisely continuous Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional and by using a free matrix approach, an exponential stability criterion is derived without systems model transformation in terms of linear matrix inequalities (LMIs), which is illustrated by a numerical example.

articleTitle: Digital automatic power control system design
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: We design a digital automatic power control system based on an automatic current control circuit (ACC) because an automatic current control circuit has the advantage that it doesn't require a photodiode to sense light intensity and correct output current, and we can adjust the current flowing through a light-emitting diode when the voltages of light-emitting diodes vary with temperature. Reducing the dependence of LED light power on temperature is our main goal. The digital automatic power control system in this paper includes an instrumentation amplifier, a microprocessor, a digital-to-analog convertor and a voltage-to-current circuit.

articleTitle: Active disturbance rejection controller for space teleoperation
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: As space teleoperation becomes a new hotspot in space exploration, interesting control challenges including large variant timedelay, model error and unpredicted disturbances are presented. Though good results have been received using linear error feedback controller such as PID algorithm, limited robustness and tracking performance are still big problems. Aiming at a stable, efficient and robust controller, this paper develops an active disturbance rejection control (ADRC) method, which doesn't rely on the knowledge of a precise robot model, for a single degree-of-freedom (DOF) telerobot rotating joint with an approximate 6 seconds roundtrip timedelay. Some computer simulations have been done, and stable performance, better disturbance-rejection capability and robust ability of ADRC for space teleoperation than PID are verified by simulation results.

articleTitle: Design and simulation of an improved wideband low noise amplifier with an active balun
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper presents the design and simulation of a improved CMOS wideband 1-6Ghz low noise amplifier (LNA). The LNA can be suitable for several different kinds of standard receivers, including Global Position System, wireless local area network, Bluetooth and ZigBee. An active balun is added to the differential amplifier. The active balun can transform the signal received form the antenna or fitter into differential signal. The transformation reduces the number of matching network. The circuit of LNA is designed and then simulated with TSMC 0.18??m technology, and the simulation results illustrate that this proposed LNA achieves a good gain with suitable noise figure, input and output loss which gives a maximum gain of 14dB in the bandwidth with 4 dB noise figure.

articleTitle: Classification based on four-component decomposition and SVM for PolSAR images
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: A new algorithm of target classification for polarimetric SAR data is proposed in this letter. First, each pixel is decomposed into four scattering components which are used for the feature vectors. Second, classifier can be designed using support vector machines through training the selected samples and then applied in segmentation of the images to be tested. The experiments are used for analysis, which are carried out on polarimetric data from the NASA/JPL AIRSAR of San Francisco.The results indicate it is feasible and efficient that combining four-component decomposition and SVM for PolSAR image classification.

articleTitle: Research on the model of pedestrian evacuation in large public building based on Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: To settle the pedestrian evacuation problems of large public building, by taking advantages of Ant Colony Algorithm in solving the shortest path problem while taking the behavioral characteristics of persons during fire into consideration, this paper puts forward a dynamic optimizing model of person evacuation path based on Ant Colony Algorithm, and combines with the analogue simulation of fire-free or fire occurrence examples, finally goes to a conclusion that dynamic adjustment of the optimized evacuation path can improve the evacuation efficiently and reduce the casualties effectively.

articleTitle: A novel mean shift algorithm simulator of video images
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: A novel mean shift algorithm of video images is proposed to track moving target in dynamic scene. The global compensation method is used to eliminate the background diversity caused by the motion of camera. Then the target is detected by difference algorithm and segmented by MRF method, so we can get the target template automatically. Finally mean shift is used to track moving target. This method solves the problem of orthodox mean shift tracking method which should select target region artificially. The experiments of the Coastguard standard video images and the practical with dynamic scene demonstrate that the proposed algorithm is effective to track moving target and it is precise and adaptive.

articleTitle: Line-of-sight identification based on area measurements
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Non-line-of-sight (NLOS) propagation is a killer issue in mobile location and line-of-sight (LOS) base stations (BSs) identification method can be used to effectively mitigate the NLOS error. In this paper, a novel method is proposed to identify LOS BSs using range measurements. Because of the measurement noise and NLOS error, the points of intersection of three position circles may construct overlapping area. In most time, the overlapping areas may be small or not being when three BSs are all LOS BSs. On the other hand, when some of these BSs are NLOS BS, overlapping areas may become bigger. The initial identification is made by that principle. However, some cases aren't subjected to that principle; the initial identification may be misjudgments. In order to reduce those misjudgments, constraint method, which contain residual test and statistical method, are used to make further identification. The proposed method can identify LOS BSs with respect to not only motional MS but also static MS. Simulation shows that the proposed method can successfully identify all of the LOS BSs over 94% of the time.

articleTitle: Convex optimization-based design for transmitted waveform
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Waveforms should be synthesized efficiently according to different environment with the development of modern technology. In this paper, based on the mutual information definition of tranmitted waveform, discrete optimization model is proposed. Convex optimization method is used to design the tranmitted waveform. The simulation results demonstrate the validity of our algorithm.

articleTitle: Online intelligent verification of relay protection based on protection importance
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: With the rapid development of national economic and social needs in our country, power grid has gradually developed to modern interconnected power system with flexible operation mode, and which increasingly high demands on relay protection system. In order to enable the verification and management of relay protection setting more scientific and effective, an online intelligent verification of relay protection based on protection importance is presented. First, combining risk assessment theory with grid cascading failure risks, obtain system comprehensive risk and use it to measure the importance of all protections. Then, verify all protection settings based on protection importance from high to low order online. The simulation of IEEE39-bus system and the analysis of the algorithm complexity prove the method feasible and correct, which avoids the shortage of traditional setting checking randomly, and is of great significance to improve the security and stability of power system.

articleTitle: The improvement of the artificial potential field robot path planning based on 3-D space
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In order to make the trajectories of robot more close to the actual situation, and make the robot avoid obstacles which are very close to the target point to arrive at the target, in this paper the robot's path optimization in the 3-D space force field have been studied. By using the method of artificial potential field, the traditional artificial potential field theory will be improved. By adding an adjustment factor, a new repulsive force field function has been constructed, and the robot's motion trajectories will be extended to three-dimensional space. Simulating the trajectory planning through the platform of Matlab software, the simulation results show that robots can avoid obstacles effectively and arrive at the target quickly under the method of the improved artificial potential field, even if the obstacle and target is very close.

articleTitle: The longitudinal attitude control of UAV based on GPFN neural network
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: At present, more and more applications of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV) makes the control of UAV to be a hot pot in doing research. In the controlling of UAV, traditional PID controller's parameters are not easily chose and anti-interference ability of the control system is poor. Aiming to improve it, the paper designs a GPFN-PID controller based on GPFN neural network. The controller has the functions of online training, self-training and self-adjusting, which makes the control of UAV longitudinal channel more effective. The simulation results show that both the dynamic characteristics and the anti-interference ability of the control system improve a lot.

articleTitle: Method of image fusion for apple surface quality detection
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Surface quality detection of apples has been absolutely indispensable in the apple production and processing nowadays. A new method, image fusion, was introduced to get more visible defect information. In the research, both of the visual images and infrared images of apples were obtained and fused based on wavelet transform fusion methods. The image acquisition and processing system was designed for the apple defects detection. Besides, a series of experiments were carried out on apples as models.

articleTitle: Statistical inference for alpha-series process with truncated normal distribution
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In this paper we consider an alpha-series process when the distribution of the first occurrence time of an event is assumed to be truncated normal distribution. Firstly, we study several nonparametric inferences including the Least-square estimate (LSE) and the Maximum-likelihood estimate (ML). Some estimators of the parameters in alpha-series process are derived by using the methods referred above. Furthermore, we consider the consistency and asymptotic normality properties of the estimators. Finally, we obtain the simulation results which are calculated over Monte Carlo replications to compare the performance of these variety estimators.

articleTitle: A network security situation perception model based on immune state transition
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper proposes a new Model of Network Security Situation Perception based on artificial immunity which can realize immune state transition. This model is used to solve the self and non-self dynamic describing problem in computer immune system. It can realize the detection to known and unknown network intrusion. It has some characteristics like distributed behavior, self-learning, robustness etc; it also presented memory Immunological detection trees based on the antibody concentration. It adjusts each node's order dynamically. Each time while testing, detector is extracted from high to low according to the antibody concentration to matching antigen. When antibody concentration is changed with the network attack, adjust the tree node sequence timely, make high concentrations detector match antigen prior to the low concentration detector for reducing invalid matching times and improving detection efficiency.

articleTitle: Optimal design of chirp signals with applications to frequency response measurement
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper explores the possibility of testing the frequency response using Chirp signals. First, the spectral properties of the Chirp signal are studied. Second, based on the properties and specifications, a constrained optimization problem is formulated and numerically solved to find the parameters of the desired signal. Finally, the frequency response test procedure is provided using Chirp excitation. Simulation results show that high measurement precision could be achieved by the proposed approach.

articleTitle: A surveillance activity recognition model based on Hidden Markov Model
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In this paper a novel activity recognition model based on Hidden Markov model was proposed. For the HMM parameters learning problem, a two-phase model including a bottom-up process and a top-down process was introduced. Bottom-up used Dirichlet Mixture Model to learn the HMM structure automatically and top-down defined a generative clustering process, which was called HMM-mixture. Both processes were unsupervised. The performance of the proposed model was tested by real surveillance video and an application for classification of activity was also showed. Clusters of HMM-trajectory were successfully recognized by the proposed model and properly classification results were achieved.

articleTitle: The processing of palmprint image based on CUDA
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper processed the palmprint feature image with neural network by utilizing the parallel computing technology based on CUDA, at the same time, this paper also processed the same neural network based on Matlab as contrast. By comparing the results of processing speed, we came to the conclusion that parallel computing technology based on CUDA has a huge advantage on processing speed. The algorithm was deduced and discussed, and it was also verified by the experiment. The result showed that parallel computing technology can improve the speed of processing greatly and the performance of palmprint recognition processing.

articleTitle: Route planning of stacker by improved genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: By the improved adaptive of genetic algorithm, the genetic operators that have adaptability at any time can be obtained, and the premature convergence problem of the traditional genetic algorithm have been overcomed. Then, the location of each storage in the warehouse has been defined by the serial number method, and the model of stacker to pick has been established. Finally, the adaptive genetic algorithm has been adopted to improve the initial path and get the optimal solution. In addition, a simulation has been conducted by the Matlab Genetic Algorithms Box to show that this algorithm is more quickly and efficiently.

articleTitle: Synthetic Array Processing for GNSS receiver in multipath environments
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Synthetic aperture techniques combine data obtained from multiple sensors or one sensor moving among multiple locations. This article discusses Synthetic Array Processing for weak GPS signal tracking issue. In this provided SAP method, the combination of weak signal collected at different positions is optimized: permitting to signals separation and mitigating MP in the synthesized space domain. Simulation results illustrate the effectiveness of the developed method. The limitation of SAP is for compensation phase dynamic due to antenna motion, the motion information of the receiver (trajectory and velocity) should be known. That means Inertial Measurement Unit is needed at the receiver side. For the future work, un-uniform synthetic array as well as arbitrary trajectory and random receiver's velocity case should be researched because these conditions are more close to practical case.

articleTitle: The research of maneuvering target tracking based on Interacting Multiple Model
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: An improved Interacting Multiple Model tracking algorithm is presented to solve the maneuvering target tracking problem. The model set including Constant Velocity Model, Constant Acceleration Model and Current Statistical Model is designed, and the Interacting Multiple Model method is used to select model. The improved unscented Kalman filter algorithm is proposed to enhance filtering effect. The simulation and actual tracking experiment results indicate that the algorithm in maneuvering target tracking is valid.

articleTitle: Analysis of agent-based “non-organization and direct interest” collective event
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper presents an agent-based collective model to study “non-organization and direct interest” collective events. The purpose of this model is to analyze the spread phenomenon emerging in this type of events and explain some important characters which affect the spread. The experimental results show that the degree of spread is influenced by some variables, and these variables also influence individual's motion intensity. Simulations reproduce the spread phenomenon of this type of events and indicate the weight of different factors which impact on individual's motion intensity, revealing the regular pattern of this event.

articleTitle: Adaboost algorithm with floating threshold
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: A novel AdaBoost algorithm with floating threshold, called AdaBoost.FT, was put forward based on the maximum likelihood principle. The proposed AdaBoost.FT algorithm significantly improved the stability of classification compared to the real AdaBoost algorithm. For this purpose, each weak classifier of AdaBoost.FT algorithm used the floating threshold to obtain the outputs of classifiers by the distribution on the training samples. In contrast, the real AdaBoost algorithm employing the fixed classification threshold was so unstable that the classified results were oversensitive to the slight change of the instance near to the classification threshold. Furthermore, the using method about AdaBoost.FT algorithm was elaborated. Theoretical analysis and experimental results both show that AdaBoost.FT algorithm was effective.

articleTitle: Research of semantic search algorithm based on Cloud computing
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Traditional search algorithm based on keywords, is easy to appear polysemy and synonyms phenomenon, which affects the recall and precision of search. And it uses a centralized search algorithm. Once the servers have problems, the whole system will be out of service. As a new distributed computing, Cloud computing has a high computing and mass storage. In order to reduce server load and increase the efficiency of resource discovery, this paper puts forward the search algorithm based on semantic in the cloud environment, which realizes intelligent search through the Chord precise search and semantic fuzzy matching fusion, and enhances the recall rate. Simulation experiment shows that the algorithm achieves high recall-precision, which performs the efficiency search in small-scale stable network.

articleTitle: Adaptive integer wavelet filter design for image compression
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper presents a new algorithm for designing revertible wavelet transforms by using lifting framework. The design objective is to achieve good performance of compression. We use the least MSE as optimization criterion to create adaptive biorthogonal wavelet filters which have linear phase property. The experimental results demonstrate that the efficiency of the proposed method for lossless image compression is quite competitive with other. IWT-based filters.

articleTitle: Persona Analysis with Text Topic Modelling
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: We present a new way called Persona Analysis with Text Topic Modelling (PATTM), which tries to learn the role of personae according to the literal descriptions. It is similar to Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) and Author Topic (AT) model, with the attribute of allowing all text to join in the topic modelling process, even when there is no persona in the text. We experiment on the “Libya Event” data set which contains more than 4,000 texts collected from the Internet. The PATTM gives lower perplexity than LDA and AT model on the data set.

articleTitle: Anchor-Free Localization Algorithm for underwater sensor networks
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Due to limited bandwidth, severely impaired channel and non-negligible node mobility, localization for Underwater Wireless Sensor Networks (UWSN) is very challenging. Most of existing localization schemes assume that the network has a plurality of auxiliary anchor nodes to assist positioning. As Global Positioning System (GPS) and other existing direct positioning technologies do not work efficiently in underwater environment, usually take Autonomous Underwater Vehicle (AUV) or node with special equipment as anchor node. High cost and poor flexibility make them not well suitable for UWSN. In order to overcome this disadvantage, we propose an Anchor-Free Localization Algorithm, called AFLA. It is designed for active-restricted underwater sensor networks. AFLA does not need anchor node's information, and makes use of the relationship of adjacent nodes to calculate node positions. It could be used in both static and dynamic networks. The obtained simulation results indicate that AFLA is an effective localization scheme for UWSN.

articleTitle: Simulation of Aircraft cabin pressure control based on Fuzzy-PID
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: When an aircraft flying at high altitude changes altitude, atmospheric pressure will change. As high-altitude atmospheric is much different from ground atmospheric daily adapted, this change can make physical condition of the crew and passengers abnormal, even be risk for their life. Therefore, Aircraft cabin pressure must vary with altitude and the appropriate pressure rate is necessary in order to ensure the safety of crew and passengers and make them comfortable for the cabin pressure and its changing rate. Contrary to cabin pressure control law of modern large civil aircraft in this paper, pressure control system model is established and a Fuzzy PID algorithm is designed to control the cabin pressure model according to nonlinear characteristics of system model. Lastly, aircraft cabin pressure control system is verified by Matlab simulation software for a complete flight. The results of simulation illustrate that the model and the algorithm have good control effect and can meet the precision requirements of cabin pressure control.

articleTitle: Anti-collision method of tower crane via ultrasonic multi-sensor fusion
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Recently, tower crane safety focused on anti-collision problem as construction environment and group of tower crane got more and more complex. The mainstream anti-collision methods used at domestic and overseas was still passive security model represented by working area limitation technology, which lacked flexibility, initiative and portability. Other on-going researches which adopted advanced sensors, communication techniques, intelligence algorithm couldn't use in construction practice successfully. This paper presented innovatively a practical methodology which used ultrasonic sensors to gradually obtain the accurate state of barriers, security judgment and Anti-Collision alarm through multi-sensor information fusion techniques such as Kalman optimal fusion estimation, neural networks time fusion, fuzzy clustering space fusion and curve fitting prediction, etc. It was verified successfully that the method could sense distance with a wide range, rapidity detect either multiple types of stationary or moving objects, accurately determine the surface outline and position of each stationary barrier as well as the track of each moving objects via simulations and experiments, so that can give operators sufficient time to take corrective action in alarm mode before a collision occurs. Moreover, this methodology had characteristics of low cost, high precision, real-time.

articleTitle: Highest frequency optimization of VLSI by a novel clock skew scheduling scheme
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The paper proposes a novel clock skew scheduling scheme, which is used to improve the highest frequency of VLSI (Very Large Scale Integrated Circuits) and has higher efficiency than the traditional scheme. To reduce the n of flow iterations, the feature of physical-optimizing-potential is embedded. A lookup table about the physical distance and the optimizing potential is generated before performing the clock skew scheduling algorithm. By this table, fake critical paths are removed, that relieves the stress of the clock skew algorithm and makes the optimizing more efficient. Besides, to make sure the optimizing potential can be realized, some particular physical constraints should be set. Genetic algorithm is adopted to find a minimum subset which includes the paths must be constrained. Experiments on ARM1136J-FS show that the highest frequency increases 13% and the time consumption is almost halved compared to the traditional.

articleTitle: Small Unmanned Aerial Vehicle visual system for ground moving target positioning
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Recently, Small Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (SUAV) are used in a variety of reconnaissance, surveillance, combat applications and so on. Tracking and positioning ground moving targets using a camera mounted on SUAVs has important applications in military and civilian purposes. Although many approaches for a vision-based target positioning system have been developed, most researches are limited to target recognition algorithm or target state estimation. And hardware implementation schemes which can work well with the whole SUAV system are seldom discussed. In order to achieve an available systematic scheme, a complete visual system which incorporates a vision-based ground moving target positioning algorithm is presented in this paper. Experiment results are finally shown and commented. Experiments indicate that the system performs great real time response and high positioning precision.

articleTitle: Application of non-cooperative game theory to multi-objective scheduling problem in the automated manufacturing system
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The optimization and scheduling of production operations is one of the key issues in automated manufacturing systems. In the past 30 years, single-objective scheduling problem in the automated manufacturing systems has attracted the attention of many scholars, but the research results had certain limitations in the application because it was only a simplified case of the actual production. It is more in line with the needs of actual production that to study the automated manufacturing systems scheduling under the conditions of multi-objective. In this paper, the mathematical model of the multi-objective optimization and scheduling in the automated manufacturing systems was established, and applied the non-cooperative game theory to propose the scheduling algorithm.

articleTitle: LiFePO4 battery capacity prediction based on support vector machine
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Capacity character is one of the most important parameters to reflect the basis performance of secondary battery, whose precise measurement is of great significance in the aspects of safety and efficiency of battery usage. The law between capacity, ambient temperature and charge-discharge rate are studied in this paper, and a novel method of capacity prediction is presented to apply to LiFePO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> battery. Furthermore, battery capacity prediction experiments are respectively carried out for charging and discharging process in case of small sample, and the corresponding relative errors are lesser than 4.45% and 3.72%. In addition, this paper also conducts a subdivided prediction of battery capacity, which elaborates the validity of the proposed method from the global perspective.

articleTitle: A RESTful information service method in Hybrid Sensor and Vehicular Networks
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Hybrid Sensor and Vehicular Networks (HSVNs) include the features of WSN (Wireless Sensor Networks) and VANET (Vehicular Ad Hoc Networks), is becoming the tendency in vehicular network. To obtain vehicular sensor service information reliably in real time is always a bottleneck in the application of vehicular network. The REST architecture uniforms the pattern of resource and interactive behaviour, building stateless service between server and client, is advantageous in heterogeneous application. This paper analyses the feature of HSVNs' information service and uses REST pattern to design the service resource and model in HSVNs', it provides a lightweight method to build an information interacting system in heterogeneous network environment.

articleTitle: Load forecasting considering the regional economic environment
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Load forecasting is the basic work of power system. The study of mid-long term load forecasting technology of power system has important practical value and theoretical significance. It is more important especially in the background of intelligent power grid. This paper studies load forecasting from the perspective of regional economic environment, builds a complete set of indicators of regional economic environment, assesses the economic situation of Hubei Power Grid, establishes the load forecasting model with principal component analysis and regression analysis and forecasts the load effectively.

articleTitle: A modified carrier frequency estimation method based on self-correlation for QPSK signal
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: QPSK (Quaternary Phase Shift Key) signal is a carrier frequency restrained modulation signal. In this paper, a novel estimation method based on self-correlation for QPSK signal is proposed. At first, self-correlation biquadratic QPSK signal is analyzed, and then its carrier frequency is estimated with M-Rife (Modified Rife) algorithm instead of estimating frequency only by max frequency line position. The simulation results indicate that our carrier frequency estimation method is feasible and more accurate than the former method, and the RMSE (Root of Mean Square Error) of the modified method is close to CRLB (Cramer-Rao Lower Bound).

articleTitle: An improved density estimation method in NSGA2
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Multi-Objective Evolutionary Algorithms (MOEAs) are efficient and widely accepted ways in solving Multi- Objective Problems (MOPs), and NSGA2 may be the most popular one. Diversity distribution is one of the major indexes to reflect the performance of MOEAs. The diversity maintenance strategy in NSGA2, is a density estimation method, called crowding-distance also, based on which, a new density estimation method is proposed in this paper. The new method has been tested with five test problems, and it performs better in diversity preservation.

articleTitle: Realization of reliable stage control console based on CPLD
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Plenty of switch information that were transferred between PLC and control console in the stage boom control system is analyzed. A control console based on CPLD and touch panel is introduced according to the characteristic and requirement of the control system. The operation principle of control console and CPLD software design are discussed in detail. The CPLD is adopted to achieve peripheral signal processing and control for logic and sequence. The simulation and application show that the method discussed is not only simple and reliable, but also save a lot of PLC I/O modules.

articleTitle: An improved Fuzzy C-means clustering algorithm
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In view of the faults of the traditional fuzzy C-means Clustering algorithm in clustering accuracy and convergence speed, the particle swarm optimization algorithm with cross-operation is used to make up for the deficiency of the FCM (Fuzzy C-means) algorithm, thus an improved fuzzy C-Means Clustering algorithm is formed. Simulation experiments on date sets IRIS and KDD CUP99 show that the MFCM (Modified Fuzzy C-means) algorithm is better than FCM algorithm in clustering accuracy and convergence speed, and its performance is reliable in intrusion detection.

articleTitle: Resonance experiments of vortex-induced vibrations based on frequency lock
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: When the fluid flows around the bluffy body, the vortex will be formed and shed alternatively behind the bluff body in the near wake. As the frequency of vortex shedding is close or equal to the natural frequency of structure, the resonance vibration will occur, even endangers the safety of structure. Due to the difficulty in detection of natural frequency of structure, experiments of vortex-induced vibrations (VIV) are carried out difficultly. In present paper, the structure is designed as a cylindrical pendulum. By using the method of frequency lock (FL), which indicates the vortex shedding frequency locked to the natural frequency of cylindrical pendulum, the VIV experiments are then designed.

articleTitle: Feature extraction using supervised constrained maximum variance mapping
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Constrained maximum variance mapping (CMVM) based on the multi-manifold learning is an efficiency method for feature extraction. CMVM preserves the local manifold structure by keep the sum of the distances of samples unchanged, but ignores the local label information of the samples, which is very important to the recognition. To tackle the shortage, we propose a new method called supervised constrained maximum variance mapping (SCMVM), which projects the local structure into feature space by a linear map. SCMVM combines the Euclidean distance with the label information in local structure and maximizing the distance of samples with different classes. Because consider the local label information, the efficiency of recognition enhances clearly. In this paper, we take experiments on Yale face database and USPS handwriting database using CMVM and SCMVM, and compare the efficiency.

articleTitle: An improved vibration and disturbance reduction method for a quad-rotor micro air vehicle
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper focuses on the vibration and disturbance reduction method for a quad-rotor micro air vehicle. A hanging structure of vibration isolation is proposed, modelled and analyzed. The results show that it can attenuate the high-frequency vibration and eliminate zero drift of the accelerometer effectively. A simple attitude measurement strategy which can reduce the disturbance of the inertial sensors is also presented.

articleTitle: Missing data imputataion for traffic flow based on weighted local least squres
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Data missing is the issue that is encounter in Intelligent Transportation System (ITS). The missing problem gives rise to many difficulties to further utilization. To overcome these difficulties, various methods have been proposed for the missing data imputation. A imputation method based on weighted local least squares for the missing data imputation of traffic flow is proposed in the paper. The real-time flow data recorded by SCOOT system in Beijing is applied to test the performance of the method and experiments results shown that the raised method has better imputing capabilities than BPCA imputation method.

articleTitle: Study on detection sensitivity of missile-borne star tracker
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The electronic number of star point light spot (called star point in short) target center pixel was obtained by APS image sensor response to stellar radiation. The energy concentration degree of star point target center pixel was derived by star point energy distribution under static condition and dynamic condition respectively. The noise sources of APS image sensor were analyzed one by one. With signal to noise ratio (SNR) criterion of star point target detection, the static detection sensitivity model and dynamic detection sensitivity model were established. Thus a more detailed description of detection sensitivity was given.

articleTitle: Distributed NURBS interpolator for high-speed and high precision machining
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: NURBS interpolation is very important for high-speed and high-precision five-axis machining. In order to get a small chord error with high precision and high speed machining, a short interpolation cycle T is necessary. But short interpolation cycle will lead to high CPU load of the CNC controller. This paper tries to solve this conflict with “Distributed interpolator”, which assigns five-axis NURBS interpolation to the intelligent servo drives. Firstly, the NURBS curve in machining space is transformed to a new NURBS curve in axis space, and consequently discomposed to independent NURBS curve for every axis individually. In the real time running stage, the CNC system just needs to convert the prepared axis curve data and trigger the interpolators on the servo drives. The synchronization of the interpolators in the individual servo drives is critical for the contour error. The paper use EtherCAT as the data exchange protocol between CNC controller and servo drives. The EtherCAT controller can provide highly synchronized signal to trigger the servo drives for interpolation and servo control loops. This paper also introduced an experimental system.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of a new jet-boat based unmanned surface vehicle
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Autonomous unmanned surface vehicle (USV) has great potentials in many applications such as water quality monitoring, coastal defence and anti-terrorist. However, complicated surroundings and high uncertainties make its full autonomy difficult to realize. In this paper, we design and implement a new USV system rebuilt from a jet boat to provide convenience for future's autonomous control experiments. The new designed USV system is composed of three parts: main body, on board computer control system and ground control system. Both its hardware structure and its software system are introduced detailedly in this paper, and some experimental results on data exchange are also presented to verify the validity of the whole USV system.

articleTitle: Parameter optimization of PID controller for boiler combustion system based on adaptive genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: For power plant boiler combustion control system has large inertia, nonlinear and other complex characteristics, a control algorithm of PID optimized by adaptive genetic algorithm is presented. By taking the rise time, error integral and overshoot of system response as the performance index, and using genetic algorithm for real-coded of PID parameters, then a group of optimal values were obtained. Simulation results show that the method has a good dynamic performance, superior to the conventional PID controller.

articleTitle: Self-regulation controller design based on disturbance estimation for reusable launch vehicle
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: A new robust controller scheme integrating sliding mode control and nonlinear dynamic inversion technique for reusable launch vehicle re-entry attitude control is proposed. Sliding mode item was introduced in the nonlinear dynamic inversion controller to enhance its robustness and designed for high performance of the nominal system. For choosing an appropriate magnitude of the sliding mode item, which will ensure the robustness and avoid unnecessary large chattering, a nonlinear estimator, based on nonlinear extended state observer, was built to estimate the disturbance between the nominal system and nonlinear plant. Then the estimation of the disturbance was used to regulate the magnitude of the sliding mode item online. Stability of the whole system is analyzed. Feasibility and validity of the new controller is demonstrated with RLV simulation examples.

articleTitle: Study on double-loop control technique for micro-grid inverters
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: A three-phase full-bridge voltage inverter based on voltage-current double-loop control strategy is proposed. The voltage-current double-loop controller is set up through analyzing the mathematical model of the inverter in the two-phase synchronous rotating coordinate system. In order to improve the dynamic response character and interference rejection ability, outer voltage loop includes the feedforward of load current and output filter capacitance current decouple component, inner current loop includes the feedforward of output filter inductance voltage decouple component. The simulation results verified that the control system has good dynamic performance and steady-state performance.

articleTitle: A new wavelet-neural network-ARIMA shares index combination forecast model
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: To improve the accuracy of forecasting stock prices, a new stock index prediction approach is proposed, which based on wavelet analysis combines the autoregressive integrated moving average (ARIMA) and artificial neural network. The non-stationary share price index series are decomposed and reconstructed into one low frequency signal and several high frequency signals by wavelet; the approximate stationary low frequency signal is predicted using ARIMA forecasting model, and the high frequency signals are forecasted using Elman neural network models; the prediction result of each layer are mixed by the radial basis function(RBF)neural network and the result is the final prediction. Examples show that the prediction of the combined forecasting model is precise.

articleTitle: Analysis of an infrared interference antagonizing window tracking algorithm
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Interference is an important issue in visual tracking. While most tracking algorithms are able to track well in simple condition, they usually fail when the objects have serious occlusion interference. This paper provides a surface type interference which has an excellent effect to disturb three common window tracking algorithms, includes fasten window algorithm, group windows tracking algorithm and adaptive window algorithm. This paper also proposes a series of experiment to find out the proper parameter of the surface type interference, and the results show this kind interference is a strong one against the window tracking algorithm.

articleTitle: Simple auto-geometric correction for non-planar projection
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper presents a simple approach for automatic correcting the distorted image displayed on a non-planar surface of unknown geometry with one or more projectors placed casually. With an un-calibrated camera capturing the viewer's perspective of the projection surface, a simple checkerboard pattern is used to build the mapping of the correspondence pixels of the projector image to the camera image. Unlike the method using homograpy to represent the mapping, we use perspective projection invariant rational Bezier patches to approximately represent the mapping from projector to camera, which also considers the non-linearities of projector or camera to achieve better registration. Compared to the method using many structured light pattern, our method saves a lot of computing time and become easier. The achieved mapping can be used for texture mapping to pre-warp the rendered images for projection. As a result, a layman user can get a corrected image displayed on a non-planar surface for the point of view of the camera easily.

articleTitle: New fuzzy attribute reduction algorithm based on similarity category clusters
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Classical rough set has a limited processing capacity in fuzzy decision table. Combining fuzzy set with classical rough set, attribute reduction algorithm on fuzzy decision table is studied. First, new similarity degree and new similarity category are defined. In the meantime, similarity category clusters which are divided by condition attribute are provided. And then, two theorems are presented. Subsequently, a new attribute reduction algorithm is proposed. Finally, the new attribute reduction algorithm is verified through a performance evaluation decision table of the self-repairing flight-control system. The result shows the proposed attribute reduction algorithm is able to deal with fuzzy decision table to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Research of low-voltage arc fault classification based on support vector machine
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Support vector machine is introduced into low-voltage arc fault research, carrying out arc fault classification analysis for different loads. Referring to U.S. UL1699 standard, current data is collected by doing experiment. Then support vector machine is used to classify and compare the recognition results for different kernels. Light bulbs, switching power and cleaner are selected as typical loads to analyze arc fault. The differences between normal arc and arc fault are compared. Finally, it is concluded that arc fault current is usually short-time zero, has big differences between positive and negative half-cycle, and has large variation of amplitude and other characteristics. This provides reference for further arc fault research.

articleTitle: Three loop topologies scheme of spinning missiles with decoupling control
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Classical three loop topologies have been successfully employed in high performance command and homing guidance missiles. However, for spinning missile the cross-coupling effects between pitch and yaw channels which are induced by periodic rolling around longitudinal axis of missile have to be taken into account and decoupling is necessary in control system design. In this paper, dynamics model of spinning missiles in the form of complex summation is established and the state feedback controller is designed. Parameters of controller are obtained through eigenvalue placement for desired eigenvalues. According to physical components of missile control system, digital state observer is constructed. The control system results in a classical three loop topology autopilot with desired dynamic response. Meanwhile, the controller with complex feedback gains achieves decoupling control of spinning missile through cross-feedback-compensation. Finally, numerical simulation implied that the proposed method is efficient and suitable for engineering applications.

articleTitle: Adaptive order of fractional Fourier transform for whispered speaker identification
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: A method widely used in speech signal analysis is based on short-time Fourier transform (STFT), but STFT only provides “average” characteristics of a signal, which can't depict the refined structure of speech. Therefore, a new speech analysis tool called fractional Fourier transform (FRFT) is introduced into this article. The transform orders for FRFT are adaptively set according to piecewise linear fitting of instantaneous frequency (IF), which is based on AM-FM model theory of speech production. Then we present a kind of feature, namely, adaptive fractional Fourier transform cepstral coefficients (A-FRCC). The proposed speech parameters have been applied for whispered speaker identification. Experimental results show that in the test condition of mismatched channels, the new features can observe more sophisticated structure of speech and more personalized of speakers, at the same time, effectively improve the recognition rate and robustness, comparing with MFCC.

articleTitle: Good word attack spam filtering model based on artificial immune system
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Current spam filtering algorithm based on artificial immune system considers little regarding to the good word attack, so in this paper, we put forward an immune-based good word attack spam filtering model called GWAIS, which uses the Mutual Information Difference as the evaluation function to discard the good words in the spam and the spam words in the normal email during the generation of the gene library, so that it can improve the quality of the antibody. The experimental results show that GWAIS has better classification performance than that of DTDEF (Danger Theory Based Junk Mail Dynamic Filtering System).

articleTitle: Noise analysis and determination method of optimum multiplication rate for APD sensor
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Signal to noise ratio (SNR) is an important indicator to measure the performance of high-gain optical sensor. The article first introduced the operating principle of APD sensor. Then three kinds of noise are analyzed in detail. Determination method of optimum gain and computing method of noise equivalent power (NEP) under the condition are proposed basing on the discussion and analysis of APD sensor's SNR and NEP. According to the conclusion, it is quite convenient to determine the optimum avalanche multiplication of APD sensor and the corresponding NEP levels. It has great theoretical significance and use value for determining and controlling APD sensor's characteristic of photoelectric transforming and so as to the design of lownoise interface circuit.

articleTitle: A novel local threshold binarization method for QR image
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In this Paper, we propose a new adaptive local threshold method for non-uniform illumination of QR image. Our approach is an extension to Bernsen algorithm, which is a local threshold method of binarzation. We consider the local and edge information to select the threshold value.
