Experiment result shows that our approach is effective adaptive thresholding method for non-uniform illumination QR image.

articleTitle: Anomaly detection of Municipal Wastewater Treatment Plant operation using Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: It is difficult to run a wastewater treatment process (WWTP) stably in the long term. In this work, to monitor the operation state of the treatment process, Support Vector Machine is applied for anomaly detection in Municipal Wastewater Treatment Plant based on operational data. Considering the characteristics of the water quality parameters and relevant regulations, we select the detection vector and choose C-SVM and Radial Basis Function (RBF).Then this paper analysis the parameters optimization of SVM, using the Grid search and Particle Swarm Optimization for model calibration. By comparing the accuracy with 10-Cross Validation of three models, we determine the final classification model. Validation demonstrates the model is able to gain high classification accuracy.

articleTitle: Application of catastrophic adaptive genetic algorithm to reactive power optimization in power system with wind farm
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: A catastrophic adaptive genetic algorithm and its application to reactive power optimization in power system with farm are studied in detail. The multi-objective mathematical model is established, and the model includes network loss, stability margin of static voltage and average deviation of voltage. To improve convergence rate and avoid the premature convergence, the cataclysm operator is added into the adaptive genetic algorithm, and in reproduction operator, the method of retaining optimal individual is combined with the competition method; in mutation operator, the mutation probability Pm is improved. The new algorithm has been applied to IEEE 30-bus testing system with wind farm, and the test shows that the novel algorithm is effective and feasible.

articleTitle: The design and implementation of user behavior mining in E-learning system
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: For the current E-learning system's deficiencies appeared in the realization of personalized learning, and combined with the basic process and key technology of Web mining, this paper presents a E-learning system model based on user behavior mining. In the learning process, learning behavior of users can be invisibly obtained by using web browser plug-in technology, to get learners' feature information, such as learning target, style, preference. Then, user interest model can be established, and E-learning system personalization can be achieved better.

articleTitle: Control algorithm research of quadrotor system based on 3-DOF simulation platform
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Quadrotor is a classical multi-input and multi-output system, which is non-linear, complicated and dynamically unstable. In this paper, 3-DOF mathematical model of quadrotor is described at the begining, and then attitude controllers making use of PD, LQR and backstepping are put forward for quadrotor. Finally, the comparison of results between simulations with and without pulse interference is carried out. The results show that both LQR and backstepping perform adequently as attitude controllers with respect to PD algorithm. Furthermore controller based on Backstepping method obtains satisfactory response, which is of no overshoot and quick regulation.

articleTitle: Empirical modelling of received signal strength in indoor localization
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper presents an indoor positioning solution using the Weibull model for approximating the WiFi signal strength distribution. Practical measurements showed that main disadvantages of maximum likelihood and graphical methods could be overcome with the moment-based methodology. Results show the possibility of indoor positioning through inquiring the WiFi-enabled handsets in range.

articleTitle: Two-way wide-angle parabolic equation method for modeling electromagnetic waves propagation in urban areas
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In this paper, the wide-angle two-way parabolic Equation (PE) method is presented and applied for predicting both forward and backward electromagnetic waves propagation in urban environments. The buildings are assumed to be knife-edges or rectangular blocks with vertical sides and flat rooftops, and the terrain is assumed to be flat. The wide-angle Fourier split-step algorithm is iteratively implemented in a forward-backward manner to incorporate both forward and backward waves into the solution when there exists obstacles in the propagation environments. Numerical results of the two-way wide-angle PE method are compared with those of the two-way narrow-angle PE method and the one-way PE method for the urban scenario problems.

articleTitle: Underground water level dynamic prediction based on hybrid genetic algorithm and the least square support vector model
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper will be least square support vector machine applied in underground water level forecasting calculation, based on rainfall, and the time is a ground water level of the underground water level for input combination forecast model, model of the super parameter the hybrid genetic algorithm was used to optimize the determined, the combination of Wanjiazhai Yellow River water supply area in Taiyuan measured data for the underground water level for verification. The results show that prediction model of underground water level has a high precision, and can be used to predict the region of underground water level.

articleTitle: Application of an improved BP neural network in the forecasting of urban power supply
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The electricity is closely related to the residents' living. The satisfaction of living and industrial electricity consumption is directly related to economic development and social stability. Accurately predicting urban electricity consumption for the foreseeable future there will help decision makers make the adjustment and specific work. In recent years, in order to solve the problem of the forecasting of urban power supply, many models have been proposed, such as multiple regression analysis, gray prediction algorithm, and so on... It is the basis of the forecasting of urban power supply that artificial neural networks have strong holographic associative learning ability and fault tolerance. Because the data collection for forecasting electricity consumption is often inaccurate, and may even have larger errors, but only when the selection of forecasting model parameters is changed in different environments, a better prediction will come out. The traditional forecasting methods are difficult to resolve these problems. The improved BP neural network was put forward to resolve these problems, after analysis, this method got more realistic results than other models.

articleTitle: Object tracking and trajectory recognition using improved CAMSHIFT and Hidden Markov Model
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Vision-based motion object trajectory recognition is currently one of the hot spot of scientific research. This paper describes a method for extracting and classifying two-dimensional motion in an image sequence based on trajectory. In the trajectory feature extract stage, as the traditional CAMSHIFT algorithm can't exclude the non-target objects which have the similar color space, we proposed an improved method. The image obtained from the background subtraction of GMM background model do AND operation with the binary image based on threshold segmentation of HSV color space, then, the result image (G-H image) do AND operation again with the color probability distribution image in CAMSHIFT algorithm. We can avoid the interference of non-target through this improved CAMSHIFT. In the next stage, threshold segmentation was used to get the start and end points of the trajectory. In the final stage, the trajectory is recognized by using Left-right Banded model, Baum-Welch algorithm and Viterbi algorithm. Experiment result shows this system is satisfied for applications.

articleTitle: Research on inverse dynamics of FSAE racing car based on recurrent neural network
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In order to research on inverse dynamics of FSAE racing car. The multi-body dynamic model of a certain FSAE racing car with 47 DOF was built, and its accuracy was verified by experiment data. Taken double lane change condition for example, the nonlinear mapping relation between lateral acceleration, velocity and steering angle was built by recurrent Elman neural network. The identification result shows, the method to study on automobile inverse handling dynamics by Elman neural network is feasible which has a rapid learning speed and high accuracy. The method can accurately identify the handling input of racing car when it has ideal performance.

articleTitle: The design of the cascaded network interface based on DM9003 and STM32
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In order to cascade the Ethernet interface, reduce the equipment cost and simplify the interface circuit during data transmission between multiple network interfaces, this design used STM32F103RBT as the key control unit, we can cascade the network interface by driving the dual-port network card chip DM9003EP. We used STM32 microcontroller to initial the network card chip and control data communication. In order to cascade the network data interface, we used port 0 of the DM9003 chip to receive the data from PC, and port 1 as the data sending port of the next level. Paired with the use of TCP/IP protocol stack and UIP protocol stack, we realized the receiving and sending of the TCP and UDP packets between multiple network interfaces.

articleTitle: Control of omni-directional intelligent wheelchair based on sitting postures
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: A large number of wheelchairs are manipulated via joysticks. But for the different degree of the handicapped, joystick does not fit for any disabled person and it will limit the users' hand behaviour, especially in sport for them. This paper elaborates a more effective and hands-free method to control the intelligent wheelchair (IW), and describes the details of control algorithm on the omni-directional platform. The algorithm controls the IW's directions and velocities according to user's different sitting postures. Using the information from the force sensors under the seat surface, the different 2D position of gravity centre will be calculated out to control the intelligent wheelchair in response to the user's leaning in different directions and velocities. Furthermore, it describes the motion mathematical model of the omni-directional wheelchair platform and provides control system hardware structure as well. Experiment results eventually indicate that the sitting postures control function is realized accurately, effectively in directions and velocities.

articleTitle: A practical attack on 8-round Camellia-128
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Block cipher is always the core encryption algorithm of information system. Camellia is a famous block cipher. Some 5-round distinguishers of Camellia are found in this paper. By exploiting the property of the key schedule for Camellia-128 and the meet-in-the-middle attack method, we present an attack on 8-round Camellia-128. The data complexity is only 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">13</sup> chosen plaintexts and the time complexity is 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">58</sup> encryptions. This is the best cryptanalytic result for 8-round Camellia-128 in the single-key model. Furthermore, our attack is the first practical attack for the 8-round Camellia-128.

articleTitle: Exitence and uniqueness of forest insect pests model with growth fuction
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Based on the classical forest systems model and consider the growth function's impact on cut rate and forest age, a new forest epidemic model is established. The existence and uniqueness of nonnegative solution of the system are proved by using the operator C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> -semigroup theory.

articleTitle: A research on equivalence between event trace diagram and goals
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Scenario, as an important requirement description in software requirements engineering has been used widely in various requirement modeling method. But scenario based requirement description has great difficulties in maintaining correctness and complement. In recent years, the method of oriented goal requirement has become a hotspot of requirement researchers, who solved the judge problem of the consistency and complement successfully by establishing formal semantic of goals. In this paper we establish formal semantics by describing scenario event trace diagram and presenting equivalence definition from scenario to operational goal set, and present the judgment theory to simplify judgment complexity in practice and the method to transfer scenario description into operational goal set. We make a conclusion that we combine the goal correctness and complement judgment to solve scenario judgment by deducing scenario to operational goal set.

articleTitle: Visual odometry research based on efficient feature tracking
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Visual odometry can use feature tracking to estimate the motion of robot in sequence stereo frames. High quality feature point set can be obtained by all kinds of detection and removal methods through the each process of visual odometry. Several methods have been summarized in the paper and applied in our experiments. The result shows that these methods are better than single RANSAC algorithm.

articleTitle: Computational efficient DOA estimation algorithm based on MSWF and polynomial rooting
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: A novel computational efficient direction of arrival (DOA) estimation algorithm using multi-stage Wiener filter (MSWF) and polynomial rooting is proposed. The signal subspace is obtained using MSWF, which avoid the known of desired signal, the estimation of data covariance matrix and its eigen-decomposition. Then, a new polynomial rooting based on the estimated signal subspace is adopted to realize DOA estimation. Therefore, comparing with the conventional DOA estimation algorithms, the proposed algorithm has smaller computational complexity. The correctness and effectiveness of the proposed method are verified by computer simulation results.

articleTitle: Nonsmooth dynamics analysis of a switching controlled system
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The switching control strategy needs to design the switching-surface and the control signal. In this paper, the control effect and the control process are studied for different control strategy based on dynamics method. For autonomous van der pol system, the orbit can be suppressed to an equilibrium when the switching-surface is chose to include equilibrium; otherwise the orbit only can be controlled to a sliding limit cycle of small amplitude. Crossing-sliding bifurcation and switching-sliding bifurcation is common route from crossing orbit to full-sliding orbit, and grazing-sliding bifurcation is common route from crossing orbit to equilibrium. The control strategy is robust to the disturbance of parameter and control signal once the steady full-sliding orbit is achieved.

articleTitle: Airplane extraction in infrared image
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel method for extracting airplanes in infrared image. Firstly the image is enhanced based on Multi-scale Retinex algorithm. Eye micro-movement algorithm is approved to extract airplanes in infrared image. It can be concluded that such an approach is effective for airplane extraction in infrared image.

articleTitle: Suboptimal guidance law design based on discrete dynamic programming
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: A suboptimal guidance law is designed for commanding satellite-guided projectiles to move with a large landing angle. Based on the characteristics of the projectile trajectory, motion state equations are established. A method for suboptimal guidance law design is presented based on discrete dynamic programming. Using the method, the suboptimal guidance law is obtained by inverse recursion at all the discrete time point. Comparing with the existing analytical design method of guidance laws, its benefit is that the hypothesis of constant or changing slowly for speed is not required, so it can be used in a wide variety of situations. Whole ballistic simulation of six degree-of-freedom is made using the suboptimal guidance law and general proportional navigation law respectively. The proposed method is effective for landing angle increased 100 percent.

articleTitle: Embedded design based on the frame buffer digital photo frame
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper introduces the digital photo frame project which based on the FrameBuffer<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[3]</sup> and Linux operating system. The digital photo frame is designed for digital format photos instead of paper photos through liquid crystal display screen. At the same time, special effects can be used on pictures while playing music. And the project focus on more novel picture shows effects to make it stand out. Finally, on the mini2440 development board, the whole design is realized completely.

articleTitle: Trustworthy services selection mechanism based on machine learning techniques
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: With the rapid growth of web services, users select the available services according to not only functional requirements, but also non-functional QoS characteristics. Therefore, research on how to find suitable and trustworthy service becomes increasingly important and challenging. In this paper, we propose an efficient Trustworthy Services Selection model named TSSelector by employing state-of-the-art machine learning techniques to improve services' semantic representation and predict services' QoS characteristics. Compared with the existing approaches, the TSSelector has at least two advantages. First, it imports WordNet and Latent Semantic Index to extend web services' semantic and represent it as the low-dimensional compact feature vectors. Second, it employs matrix completion technique to predict and correct the missing and corrupted QoS values. Preliminary experimental results performed on the real-world data set demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed approaches.

articleTitle: Uncorrelated optimal discriminant vectors based on generalized singular value decomposition
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In this paper, we put forward an uncorrelated optimal discriminant vector algorithm based on generalized singular value decomposition for feature extraction. The algorithm maximizes the Fisher criterion by employing the theory of generalized singular value decomposition, and obtains projection vector with the constraint of statistical uncorrelated theory. Especially, our method provides a mathematical method to contribute to understanding the problem of singular by employing the generalized singular value decomposition technique. Experimental results show that our method reduces the computational complexity and gets better performance.

articleTitle: Phase detection algorithm and precision analysis based on all phase FFT
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In the phase measurement of three-phase electricity signal, the measurement accuracy based on traditional FFT algorithm is restricted by harmonic components. Even though it can be corrected by some spectrum correction algorithm, such as FFT+DFT spectrum continuous refining method, phase difference method and so on, these correction algorithms are based on FFT results. So the precision is very limited. Aiming at the deficiency of traditional phase measurement methods, this paper applies digital phase measurements based on the all phase FFT algorithm. This algorithm has the characteristic of initial phase invariability and can prevent the spectrum leakage effectively. Using all phase FFT algorithm can solve the problem of non-synchronous sampling frequency spectrum correction, and improve the phase measurement accuracy obviously. In addition, it can forecast the precision of phase, and greatly reduce the computation. All of these characteristics make it helpful to achieve the phase real-time measurement.

articleTitle: Posture measurement for the aircraft model based on the monocular-vision system
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: To solve the posture measuring problems of aircraft model in the wind tunnel tests, a kind of method based on the monocular vision has been put forward in this paper, making use of a few geometric information of marking points and its corresponding image information according to the projective geometry, so that the relative object posture can be calculated. This method combines the advantages of analytic algorithm and nonlinear algorithm, and uses the constraints between frame and the follow-up frame to optimize the posture, reducing calculation steps but not decreasing its accuracy. A good result has been gotten in the actual test.

articleTitle: Intrusion detection research based on improved PSO and SVM
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Based on the thought of crossover operation and mutation operation in genetic algorithm, this paper improves particle swarm optimization algorithm. The improved particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to optimize penalty parameter c and kernel function parameters g of SVM and the optimized model named new-PSO-SVM is established. KDD Cup 99 intrusion detection data set is used to carry out experiment. The results show that PSO optimization improves the classification accuracy rate of SVM.

articleTitle: Katsevich algorithm for spiral cone beam tomography with half-cover scan
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Half-cover scan means x-ray beam horizontally covers half of the inspected object at each view angle. It can enlarge the field of view (FOV) of spiral cone-beam CT (computed tomography). In imaging algorithms of CT, Katsevich algorithm is exact and efficient. The imaging result is not influenced by cone-angle. If Katsevich algorithm used directly in spiral cone-beam CT, PI line is not completely covered by x-ray beam at each view. The image reconstructed by Katsevich algorithm based on PI line is partly absent. In this paper, an improved Katsevich algorithm is proposed for transversely truncated projection of half-cover scan. It canobtain complete reconstruction images with proposed algorithm. Numerical result validates the non-PI line imaging algorithm.

articleTitle: Sliding mode trajectory tracking control of underactuated surface vessels
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Aiming at the model parameters uncertainties in the trajectory tracking control of a 3 degrees of freedom (3DOF) underactuated surface vessel, a new nonlinear sliding mode control law is presented. According to the properties of underactuated surface vessels, the sway direction is not actuated, and for manoeuvring the vessel of 3DOF in surge, sway, and yaw directions, the sliding mode based controller is designed by introducing two sliding surfaces, one is the first order surface by surge following errors, the other is the second order surface by sway following errors. The efficacy of the tracking controller is explained through numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Design of a real-time tracking robot based on simplified binocular positioning model
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: A real-time-tracking robot based on binocular positioning is proposed in this essay. This system synthetically evaluates both color and morphological property of the target, realizing fast positioning with a simplified binocular positioning model. With the use of Kalman filter to predict the movement of the target, the system promptly adjusts the direction of the PTZ which carries the cameras, making it possible for the real time tracking of the target. Besides, the essay introduces an edge detection algorithm based on brightness equalization to eliminate possible false boundary lines caused by shadows or illumination. Finally, experiment results demonstrate the realtime performance and accuracy of the system.

articleTitle: A improved Elman neural network with application to fault diagnosis of pneumatic valve actuator
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Because of the inherent uncertainty, changeable, nonlinear characteristics, faults diagnosis is a very difficult task in the pneumatic actuator system. In addition, slow convergence speed exists in the original Elman network, so, a model, an improved Elman neural network, was presented to achieve fault diagnosis in this paper. The adjustable weights between the context units and output units are embedded in the improved model. So, they make the speed of convergences more quickly and make the detection of nonlinear dynamic system better. The severity of the common faults contains control valve faults, servomotor faults, etc. Through the simulation research based on MATLAB platform, the new method is efficient at diagnosing the pneumatic actuator system's faults from the experimental findings.

articleTitle: Design of automatic flight controller for an unmanned helicopter based on SDRE
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In accordance with different response rate of state variables in Unmanned Helicopter (UMH), the whole affine nonlinear model was divided into inner, middle and outer loops, and then, a “three-timescale” mathematics model was established. The paper improved state dependent riccati equation (SDRE) control approach, deriving analytical conditions for achieving global asymptotic stability with lyapunov theory. Proof was given. By combining improved SDRE control with nonlinear feed-forward compensation technique, the full envelop attitude control laws was designed. On the basis of achieving decoupling control for attitude, a three-axis speed controller was also developed. Actual flight tests were implemented and test results show the effectiveness of control strategies.

articleTitle: Configurations of networked override control systems
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The concept of networked override control system (NOCS for short) is proposed and its configurations are investigated in detail. Override control system, wherein the control loops are closed via real time networks, is called networked override control system. Based on the proposed node-device connectivity matrix and network transmission matrix, three typical configurations of NOCSs are explicitly proposed and characterized. The configuration diagrams and block diagrams of them are also presented. Future research directions are also pointed out.

articleTitle: Novel convergence analysis of narrowband fxlms-based algorithm
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper presents a novel convergence analysis of the narrowband active noise/vibration system with FXLMS-based algorithm. It is revealed that the convergent behaviour mainly depends on the phase error of the secondary path model as well as the structure of the controller. With a constant step size, the convergent speed of the algorithm is maximized at a critical value of the phase error. The algorithm exhibits different convergent behaviours if the phase error is below or above this critical value, respectively. The theoretical analysis is validated by numerical simulations.

articleTitle: An approximation algorithm for graph K-partitioning
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Graph partitioning used in many fields is an important problem in graph theory so that an efficient algorithm for graph partitioning is meaningful. But graph partitioning is a NP-complete problem which is hard to obtain an optimization solution in polynomial time. This paper studies the relevant knowledge of information theory and designs an approximation optimization algorithm for solving graph K partitioning. The theory analysis and experimental results show that time complexity of the algorithmis O(V2).

articleTitle: Supervisory arc of Petri nets and its application on traffic signals control system
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Petri net is a tool of graphic contributing to system analyzing and modeling. It has a great power on describing concurrencies, conflicts and synchronizations for a distributed system. Additionally, extended Petri nets proposed before not only enrich the representations but also enhance the ability of modeling. This paper proposes a supervisory arc which can simplify the Petri nets, and it is beneficial for modular design. Finally a Petri net of a four-phase signalized intersection for urban traffic signal control system is modeled and simulated, then the function of supervisory arcs is validated from the result.

articleTitle: A parallel feature selection based on rough set theory for protein mass spectrometry data
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper presents an efficient parallel algorithm of optimal feature selection to reduce dimensionality for protein mass spectrometry data. The algorithm divides data into some parts to calculate separately, and then the relative importance of features is used for the parallel computing of each part. At last, the master process computes the final decision table reduction based on the part reduction. Experimental results show that the algorithm is suitable for mass spectrometry data. It not only reduces the computational cost but also keeps the classification accuracy.

articleTitle: Esprit algorithm performance analysis based on vector hydrophone array
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The intrinsic essence of DOA estimation of the vector hydrophone array utilizing ESPRIT algorithm is analyzed. All the processing methods can be classified into two types. One is utilizing the rotational invariance information of acoustic pressure and particle velocity and the other estimates DOA parameters using the information of different subarrays. The formulas for theoretical error of DOA estimation methods are deduced and a weighted angle fusion algorithm to improve estimation performance is proposed. Simulation results show that the theoretical error formulas are in good agreement with the practical circumstances and the proposed method improves the estimation performance.

articleTitle: Application of distance discriminant analysis method to predict the fault water inrush
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In order to analyze the phenomenon of water inrush from faults theoretically, it is essential to make simplification and takes only the most significant factors related to the problem into the theoretic model, such as existence of water source, water pressure, thickness of block, mining failure thickness of floor, and fault displacement etc. Fifteen representative engineering cases of water inrush from coal floor were taken as training samples. A correspondent forecast model of water inrush quantity was established based on the principle of Mahalanobis distance discriminant analysis theory. The forecast model was applied in five faults of Zhangcun mine. The results show that the carboniferous limestone aquifer causes fault water inrush more easily than the Cambrian limestone aquifer does. And the water inrush level is the maximum when the fault lies in the carboniferous limestone aquifer. Otherwise the bigger the fault displacement, the higher the water inrush quantity is. The prediction results also consistent to the real ones. So the method to predict the fault water inrush proposed in the article is feasible.

articleTitle: Iris location based on maximum probability
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: With the development of society, personal identification becomes more and more significant. As we know, there are many disadvantages of the traditional identification. So lots of biometrics arise. As one of biometrics, iris recognition is of great importance nowadays with its higher accuracy and stability. Here, the main steps of iris recognition are introduced, including pre-processing of image, iris location, iris normalization, feature extraction and pattern recognition. Our work focuses on pre-processing and a new accurate and rapid method of iris location is proposed. The validity of this method is verified by our experimental results.

articleTitle: Application of fuzzy self-adaptive PID control in electrostatic dust removal power system
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The paper introduces fundamental principle of electrostatic dust removal and designs the three-phase high pressure dust removal of power-supply system based on fuzzy self-adaptive PID control algorithm centring on single-chip C8051F060. Based on the designs of hardware structure it gives software design flow chart. The control system increases the stability and control precision of dust removal of power-supply system. The engineering practice shows that the dust removal of power-supply system has advantages of easy operation, steady system and high work efficiency.

articleTitle: Key technological research of fingerprint collection and identification based on OMAP5912
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: For the characteristics unique and safety, the Biometric fingerprint identification technology is widely used in the security identification systems. However, the current products which bases on the single-core (ARM, DSP or MCU) systems have defects in drivability, processing speed and recognition rate. We takes the OMAP5912 dual-core processor as the hardware platform to maximize the benefits of ARM and DSP and use the new improved Gabor algorithm. Therefore the singularity at the wrong ridge fracture and connection problems is eliminated. The stability, speed and recognition of the entire system rate will be improved greatly.

articleTitle: High-frequency mechanical behavior research of Terfenol-D Rod
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The Radial Distribution Rules of Internal Stress and Strain on Terfenol-D Rod in High-frequency Driven were analyzed with Thermal-magnetic Analogy Method, Which Provided a Theoretical Basis for Further Research of the Giant Magnetostrictive Transducer.

articleTitle: Identification of nonlinear system using computational paradigms
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: System identification is the powerful technique to identify the mathematical model of the unknown system based on input-output data. It is difficult with ordinary methods when the system is nonlinear with uncertainty. The computational paradigm has very high & efficient self-learning ability. It has great potentialities for mapping of nonlinear system particularly for identification. ARX based neural network is designed with back propagation and genetic algorithm training algorithms for nonlinear system. The comparative analyses of these algorithms are discussed in this paper.

articleTitle: A knowledge granularity based heuristic algorithm for attribute reduction
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Rough set theory is a new mathematical tool to deal with the imprecise, incomplete and inconsistent data. Attribute reduction is one of important parts in rough set theory. Currently, lots of literatures have proposed many algorithms for attribute reduction based on similarity. But all these algorithms just consider the connection of condition attributes and decision attributes, and the similarity of condition attributes is neglected. A heuristic algorithm for attribute reduction based on knowledge granularity is proposed. Firstly, we calculate the similarity between condition attribute and decision attribute, and then use the similarity between different conditions attributes to measure and choose important attributes which are added to the reduction set. Theoretical analysis and experiments show that the algorithm of this paper is efficient and feasible.

articleTitle: Design of central region visual two-dimensional barcode
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel visual two-dimensional barcode, which has visually significant appearance and can be used more widely than traditional barcodes. Based on the theory of pattern encoding method of visual two-dimensional barcode, pattern encoding-oriented error diffusion is proposed to improve the barcode visual quality. In order to increase the barcode capacity, central region visual two-dimensional barcode is designed and generated according to the human visual selective attention mechanism. The barcode is composed of center encoding area and surrounding encoding area. Experimental results show that the generated barcode not only has better visual quality, but also has larger capacity. More importantly, it can be used to identify Authentication.

articleTitle: The design of human simulated intelligent controller for DC motor
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: A control system based on human-simulated intelligent control (HSIC) is designed using a mathematical model of a DC motor. In the DC motor control system, the human-simulated intelligent controller is implemented for the HSIC speed loop. The controller parameters are set and optimized using the particle swarm optimization algorithms with adaptive inertia weight based the simulation model. Simulation results show the human-simulated intelligent motor control system of the HSIC-based DC motor has high dynamic and static performances as well as high adaptability and robustness. The result of simulation confirms that the controller is able to reduce steady state error and improve controller's reliability during power supply disturbance and load disturbance.

articleTitle: The design of target movement simulation system based on auto-disturbance rejection controller
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This research focuses on the design and debugging for a control system—Target Movement Simulation System, In order to acquire high performance of turntable in condition of time-variety load, ADRC (Active Disturbance Rejection Controller) is applied creatively in servo-control system. According to the variety of load and disturbance, the speed-controller is designed by ADRC. Then the experiment results indicate that the servo-control system using ADRC have better performance and better anti-disturbance capability than the general servo-control system. That is said, ADRC is effective method to achieve high performance of servo-control system with time-variety load.

articleTitle: Constrained location algorithms based on total least squares method using TDOA and FDOA measurements
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper focuses on moving source location estimation using TDOA and FDOA measurements in the presence of random errors in sensor locations. A one-step location algorithm based on constrained total least squares algorithm (OSCTLS) is proposed, and a qusi-Newton method using the BFGS rule is utilized to give a numerical solution. Simulation results show that the proposed OSCTLS algorithm can attain the CRLB accuracy before the thresholding effect occurs, and is more robust to large measurement noise than the two-step weighted least squares(T-WLS) method.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of magnetic field driven nano-wire rotation in fluid
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: CFD(Computational fluid dynamic) approach has been used to investigate laminar flow caused by long cylinder rotating around its mid-point. Several numerical methods dealing with solid motion in fluid, including some CFD methods and one FEM(Finite element method), have been compared. The relationship between cylinder length, rotation speed, fluid viscosity and resisting fluid torque has been researched. Fluid resisting torque has been tested. Combined with equipment data, finally nano-wire rotation resistance torque model is obtained.

articleTitle: Control method analysis based on welding process
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The fundamental difficulty of realizing pulsed GTAW automation and intellectualization is to detect and control the weld pool's dynamic behavior, such as weld pool's geometry parameters, weld penetration and weld beam forming. Arc welding is a complex process which involves interactions of materials, metallurgy and physical chemistry. Weld quality (weld beam forming, microstructures and properties of joint) is related to the multiple parameters of welding technology, these parameters are related, coupled in the dynamic process and overlapped in the static process. The dynamic process of the weld pool is a high complex object with strong nonlinearity, multi-variable coupling and a mount of stochastic and uncertain factors, and this makes it very difficult to control the weld pool's dynamic changes, and to control the weld pool's width, penetration and weld beam forming. To solve the problem by using of classic and modern control theory will face the challenges both on the theory and application. In this paper, the PID control law is designed for the two-order welding pool model obtained by identification and the Smith predictor is adopted to compensate time-delay at the start of welding. Tuning method of PID controler based on optimal transfer function is presented as well. Test shows that the Smith predictor can compensate time-delay well.

articleTitle: An attitude modeling method for small-scale unmanned helicopter
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Attitude control is crucial for small-scale unmanned helicopter autonomous flight, and attitude model is the basis for attitude control. This paper presents an attitude modeling method for small-scale unmanned helicopter. First-principle approach is applied to analyze and construct the structural attitude model with consideration of the coupling effects between different channels. The PEM parameter estimation approach is adopted to identify the parameters of the model. Verification experiments are carried out to validate the model. The validation results show that the modeling method is effective and has high accuracy. The modeling method takes the coupling effects between yaw channel and other channels into account and combines the first-principle approach and the system identification approach.

articleTitle: End-to-end QoS performance analysis of wireless mesh network on RM-AODV routing protocol
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The wireless mesh network (WMN) is an emerging technology to provide a solution to the special commercial uses. In this paper, we research on the end-to-end quality of service (QoS) performance of wireless mesh network. The radio metric Ad hoc on-demand distance vector (RM-AODV) path selection way will be discussed. Furthermore, we deploy the optimal method to determine the radio hop metric based on the required QoS parameters and the end-to-end transmission latency performance for some hops will be simulated.

articleTitle: Research on motion simulation of railway rescue crane based virtual reality technology
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The paper takes the design of 120t railway rescue crane of Wuhan Bridge Heavy Industries Group Co., Ltd. as the research object. The developing method for VR simulation based on Multigen-Vega is discussed and VR modelling technology is applied to establish the relevant kinematics models of the railway rescue crane which enabled the operator to observe a variety of movement states of railway rescue crane as if he is on the scene personally. The real-time driving and controlling of the rescue scene of virtual railway rescue crane are made. The developing step is analyzed and a method for developing Windows style simulation programs combing Microsoft Foundation Class with Vega is proposed. The crane's motion simulation and part scene of the real working circumstance digitizing and other functions are realized.

articleTitle: Utilize the generating functions to enumerate the specialized mechanisms with design constraints
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This study presents a mathematical method to calculate the generating function of the specialized mechanisms in type synthesis with design constraints. First, the link permutation group is derived from a candidate kinematic chain according to the combinatorial theory. Next, according to the types of design constraints, joint, path, and adjacent (or non-adjacent) pair groups are derived from the link group respectively. Then, the generating function of these groups can be calculated mathematically based on four well defined operators and basic groups. The generating function is a polynomial to express the results of specialized mechanisms subjected to a specific design constraint. The benefit of the method is that the results of the type synthesis can be calculated directly by mathematical manner without any inspection of isomorphism.

articleTitle: Prediction of fouling in condenser based on k-means algorithms and improved Chebyshev neural network
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Many factors affect the production of condenser fouling, but there is no accurate way to predict it. In this paper, it makes good use of k-means algorithm in order to cluster data in different seasons and different phases to carry out a comprehensive improvement from the algorithm and network structure aiming at Chebyshev neural network weaknesses. Improved Chebyshev neural network in line with the basic characteristics of biological neural networks is simple and fast convergence. Using the modified Chebyshev neural networks to predict fouling factor, the results show that this method not only provides an effective fouling factor forecast method with good predictive ability, but also in the same precision under the premise of the convergence speed is superior to the general neural network, can provide scientific and rational decision making for decontamination period of condenser.

articleTitle: Application of near infrared spectroscopy in quality control of Irpex lacteus
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The use of near infrared spectroscopy (NIRS) to measure the concentration of elements in Irpex lacteus was investigated. One hundred and sixty three samples were collected and traditional methods were used to determine the concentration of adenosine, polysaccharide and mannitol. The spectra were pre-treated by avitzky-golay smoothing, fast fourier transform (FFT), 1st derivative and 2nd derivative prior respectively to developing calibration models using partial least squares regression with cross-validation. The results showed that 20 point savitzky-golay smoothing treated spectr established PLS model might be used to determine three elements simultaneously. The RMSECV of optimum PLS model for adenosine, polysaccharide and mannitol were 1.15, 29.93 and 7.97, respectively. The results suggest that NIR measurements can be applied as a rapid method to determine three indicated elements in Irpex lacteus.

articleTitle: Layering control of feedback linearization and fuzzy supervision of the typical multi-cylinder precise forging hydraulic press
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The study of the typical multi-cylinder precise forging hydraulic press (TMPFHP) has widespread significance to solve problems of the control of many multi-cylinder precise forging hydraulic presses. Aimed at the problem of the stability of the internal dynamics in the feedback linearization control of the system, with combination of feedback linearization and fuzzy supervision, a layering control method is given. It can not only achieve the tracking accuracy of the output, but also ensure that the internal dynamics is stable. The results of the system simulation show that the method is very valid.

Author Keywords: Typical multi-cylinder precise forging hydraulic press (TMPFHP)

articleTitle: Hybrid genetic algorithm based on an effective local search technique
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper presents a hybrid genetic algorithm (HGA) with a local search technique, a local search technology into the genetic algorithm (GA). This local search technology, that is, set a selection mechanism which uses the steepest descent method, and is used to determine whether convergence algorithm or not. The basic genetic algorithm (BGA) and with a local search hybrid algorithm (HGA) to the numerical results shows that the algorithm has high efficiency. Finally, After taking numerical examples, it shows the proposed hybrid algorithm has a good performance.

articleTitle: Source camera of digital image identification base on Interpolation Algorithm
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The popularity of image acquisition equipment of today as well as accessibility to editing and tampering issues has made Digital Forensics technology an important area of image processing. The study uses image interpolation to figure out the image characteristic value with support vector machine introduced to conduct classification in order to reduce time of identifying the source camera of digital images, and also, to simultaneously achieve high recognition rate. As far as experimental design is concerned, cameras in different brands and models were used under the experiment environment of this study to conduct classification. The experiment results indicated that this method reports good recognition rate, with recognition rate up to 90% once the wave filter is introduced additionally.

articleTitle: Spectral representation of multi-valued functions
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Multi-valued functions can be compute by multi-valued neural network. In order to use linear algebra method for analysis of multi-valued function, this paper gives the spectral representation of multi-valued functions. By define a checksum function of n variables, this paper gives an group of orthogonal bases. Any multi-valued function in GF( p)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">pn</sup> can be uniquely represented as a linear combination of the bases. The coefficients are the correlations of the multi-valued function and the bases. All the coefficients combine the generalized spectrum of the multi-valued function. For a multi-valued function that can be realized by a multi-valued neuron, it is computable by depth-2 polynomial-size neural networks.

articleTitle: A local linear algorithm for calculating the pre-image in kernel PCA
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In this paper, we show a novel method for solving the pre-image problem. The most algorithms of dimension reduction are trying to maintain the geometric structures including the local and the global. Usually we assume that the manifolds are local linear. Given the assumption, we can obtain the reconstructing images by calculating the locally optimal linear fits. In the novel pre-image algorithm, firstly we find the k nearest neighbours of test samples in feature space, and then calculate the optimal approximation of test samples by their k nearest neighbours. And we give a simple stability analysis to this nonlinear iterative algorithm. The novel pre-image algorithm has been used in the second defect detection of notes' printing. The effect of detection is very obviously in improving detection speed and accuracy.

articleTitle: A method for nose tip location and head pose estimation in 3D face data
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: 3D nose tip location and head pose estimation are the crucial step for registration and recognition of 3D face data. In this paper, we propose an automatic method that is robust to head pose and expression variation. Firstly, we determine candidate areas using the curvature information. Then we define an effective statistical feature per point to extract the nose tip, in addition, we also estimate the head pose. Experiments are performed on the CASIA-3D face database which contains 123 subjects under varying pose and expression. Experiment results show that the method is capable of nose tip location and head pose estimation across the pose and expression variation represented in the database.

articleTitle: Design of hybrid magnet for PEMS
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Three structure types of hybrid magnet are analyzed, one of them which is most fit for this paper is chosen, then based on energy consumption, sorption safety, controllability, corresponding index is put forward, approximate scope of parameters for hybrid magnet is fixed, and simulations of finite element are taken out, then applicable hybrid magnet structure is worked out, at last, experiments and tests are carried out to confirm that the magnet is applicable.

articleTitle: Object localization with discriminate superpixels
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: We propose a simple image component parsing method based on discriminate regions. We define a discriminate region as some image areas which can be easily identified as foreground or background. For instance, eyes are the discriminate regions for face because it can hardly be found in background, while trees are discriminate ones as well since we can hardly found similar regions in face. Foreground should contain more discriminate regions than that of background. Based on this idea, we employ superpixels to mine those discriminate regions and construct a graph to reveal the relationship among them. We compute the unary and pairwise potential of the graph and then carrying out inference with conditional random field model (CRF). Finally pixels could obtain the most possible classes they belong. Our method performs excellently in two image databases: CaltechlOl andGraz02.

articleTitle: Obstacle detection for intelligent vehicles using semi-supervised active learning
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Reliable environment perception system is critical to path planning and autonomous navigation of intelligent vehicles. One feasible way to percept environment is obstacle detection by classifying image patches as obstacle or non-obstacle. Accurate classification system depends on appropriate training data. For intelligent vehicles, a large number of images can be easily obtained while labeling them is tedious. Additionally, the accuracy is limited for the scene diversity. In this paper, we propose a semi-supervised active learning algorithm which can exploit the most certain unlabeled examples and query the most informative examples to enhance the performance of classifiers. In view of the scene diversity, we present a two-level classification system which first distinguishes the scene category using level-I classifier before calling the suitable level-II classifier to detect obstacles. The experimental results demonstrate the efficiency of our algorithm and two-level classification system.

articleTitle: An economy digital controller of ARC welding power supply
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Considering the expensiveness of digital welding power products on the current market, an economy digital controller is designed with STM32 series of microprocessor in this paper. The guiding principles of our design are simplicity and effectiveness besides low cost. It realizes external characteristic of constant current with out-pulling and controls output current with proportional-integral (PI) method. Extensible system program and expert database make it a potential multifunctional and intelligent system.

articleTitle: An improved adaptive LS algorithm using QR decomposition for digital predistortion
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: An improved adaptive Least Square (LS) algorithm using QR (orthogonal and upper triangle matrix) decomposition for digital predistortion (DPD) is presented in this paper. Compared with the traditional LS algorithm, this new method is featured by low complexity and high efficiency. Simulation results show that this adaptive LS algorithm using QR decomposition can significantly reduce the complexity and therefore, is ease of implementation.

articleTitle: Design of cloud data warehouse and its application in smart grid
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, enterprises have carried out application system construction on a large scale, which generates vast amount of data. Because traditional data warehouse can't meet the demand of processing vast amount of data, the data warehouse based on cloud computing technology was born. The paper puts forward a kind of cloud data warehouse platform and has implemented it. The platform builds on top of Hadoop ecosystem the core of which are Hadoop, HBase, Hive and so on. And the platform also adds ETL, OLAP analysis, Data Mining and BI Report. At the same time, the platform is applied to the field of smart grid in this paper. The paper also uses OLAP to analyse user's power consumption data, and combines data mining technology to solve the problem of analysis of user's power consumption behaviours. Finally, the paper also analyses the defect of cloud data warehouse and the focus of the research direction in the future.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of a novel wireless sensor network system terminal based on embedded web server and database
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: A new type terminal with high performance, low power consumption, low cost, high integration, and intelligent solution was designed. The terminal is based on integrating the Sink, Data Service and Data Manage in traditional system. An integrated operation platform which can provide web server, database, and PHP runtime environment in the embedded environment was built by using ARM Linux equipped with Apache+PHP+SQLite3 based on the high performance ARM11 processor S3C6410. Various internet accesses were offered by using 3G and Wi-Fi wireless networks communication technology.

articleTitle: Centralized antennas adjustment of overshooting and its influence on network indexes
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Overshooting is a familiar problem in GSM network. Now the manners to reduce overshooting remain in theory and their effects in an actual implementation in real network are missing. In this paper, we implement these manners to reduce overshooting in GSM network. To observe the results more precise, all our adjustments are centralized in a recent short period. The detailed data are given and it is shown that the network indexes will be significantly improved by centralized antennas adjustment of overshooting. From this experiment, some valuable experiential conclusions are obtained, which might be widely used to upgrade the network indexes in the future.

articleTitle: A novel method of similarity search for moving object trajectories
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: An interesting issue in moving objects databases is to find similar trajectories of moving objects. Similar trajectories search highly depends on an efficient algorithm calculating similarity between two trajectories. The high complexity of existing methods, which is quadratic, interfere the promotion of the application. In this paper, we introduce a novel similarity function, Maximum Common Grid (MCG), of which the complexity is constant multiple of n. Our method divides the whole activity area of moving object into small regions, and then each trajectory is represented as a sequence of regions. We claim that the more two trajectories have Common Region, the more similarity they have. Common Region is defined as the region passed by both the two trajectories. Therefore we determine the similarity by the number of Common Regions between trajectories. The experimental results show that MCG is accurate and efficient.

articleTitle: An enhanced k-means algorithm using agglomerative hierarchical clustering strategy
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: To overcome the drawback that the k-means algorithm is sensitive to the selection of initial centroids, we proposed an enhanced two-stage k-means algorithm. In the first stage, we begin with selecting as many as enough initial centroids, then the basic k-means algorithm is applied to get the intermediate clusters, i.e., we keep the number of initial centroids k′ large enough to eliminate the bad centroids' effect to the result. In the second stage, the k′ intermediate clusters are merged into k result clusters using agglomerative hierarchical clustering algorithm. We have tested our algorithm on standard data sets and synthesized data set; experiments results have manifested that our algorithm can obtain higher clustering accuracy.

articleTitle: Bar code detection using omnidirectional vision for automated guided vehicle navigation
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In this paper, a study on detectability and readability of barcodes using omnidirectional vision system for automated guided vehicle is presented. Images from omnidirectional camera are known to be distorted against the height of the object. We present an algorithm for detecting and reading barcodes successfully without correcting the image distortion. Experiments were conducted both when the AGV was in motion and at rest. Three contributing factors were identified for successful barcodes detection and reading.

articleTitle: Empirical numerical study on denoising by wavelet and by second kind of fourier analysis
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: As the wavelet bases usually have relative small support sets, three defects of wavelet denoising for a complex time series can be deduced. The first defect is that for in large sample size, the wavelet denoising is not better than the second kind, Fourier analysis denoising. The second is that wavelet denoising has the worse reconstructive capacity for the high frequency signal. The last defect is that the wavelet denoising is not better when there are many outliers. The numerical experiments are carried out to make sure the three deductions.

articleTitle: Implementation of permanent magnet synchronous motor servo system with novel adaptive inverse control
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: A novel adaptive inverse control strategy is proposed for the permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) servo system which is nonlinear, multi-variables and strong coupling. This control strategy adopts modified radial basis function (RBF) neural network and FIR filter as nonlinear filter. The proposed filter is used to identify the plant, inverse plant and designed the adaptive inverse controller. Meanwhile modified variable step size LMS algorithm is used to optimize the parameters of the nonlinear filter online. The proposed control strategy improved the convergence speed and accuracy, further improved the control performance of adaptive inverse control. The simulation and experiment results validate that the PMSM servo system has good dynamic, static performance including transient responses, parameters disturbance responses and tracking responses.

articleTitle: Distance-based key management in hierarchical wireless sensor network
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The key management is the most important way to protect the communication in Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs). In this paper, we present a Distance-based Key Management (DKM) which can efficiently enhance the security and survivability in the hierarchical WSNs. Different from previous works, we generate the key system as well as the cluster formation. And the DKM distributes keys based on distance (hop counts), which not only localizes the key things but also has no overhead. The DKM can protect the network from the compromised nodes by reducing the high probability of the common keys. The security analysis can effectively prevent several attacks.

articleTitle: Projective contour point matching using FPI, GRA and PSO
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The contour point set is a very important feature for an object image. Finding the correspondences between two sets of contour points is a difficult task, especially under projective transformation. It has wide spread applications. For example, it can be used for object recognition by matching points derived from object models with points extracted from imagery. In this paper, a new contour point pattern matching (CPPM) algorithm using five-point invariant(FPI), grey relational analysis(GRA), and particle swarm optimization (PSO) is proposed. Firstly, two contour point sets from different images are extracted and normalized, then FPI is used to form the descriptors, GRA is employed to match the pair of point sets, and PSO is used to find exact corresponding pairs. Comparative experimental results manifest that the proposed method is more efficient, robust and fast than a comparative algorithm, RANdom SAmple Consensus(RANSAC) algorithm, for projective contour point sets matching.

articleTitle: Road detection based on region similarity analysis
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Drivable space detection is a key component for autonomous driving and robot road-following. In this paper, we propose a visual-based approach to detect road region in a dynamic environment from a moving camera. In the approach, a free road region candidates are estimated first based on intensity similarity search which using statistical feature analysis (SFA) combined with a breadth-first search (BFS) algorithm to segment different intensity similarity regions in a road image. Then, the similarity between a prior road model by drivers selected and the road region candidates is expressed by a metric derived from the Bhattacharyya distance. Finally, the road region can be identified by voting scores for these similarity measures. The experimental results have shown that the proposed approach can detect road regions in real road scenes.

articleTitle: Eyebrow recognition using Radon transform and sparsity preserving projections
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Sparsity preserving projections (SPP) rooted in compressive sensing has already been successfully applied in face recognition. SPP is based on subspace analysis. The key of methods based on subspace analysis is seeking a good projection matrix to extract the features. It allows the desirable characteristics in the original high-dimensional space can be preserved in the low-dimensional subspace. In SPP, projection matrix is closely related to sparse weighting vector, so the key of SPP is seeking a sparse weighting vector as well as possible to describe the original signals. In order to get a better sparse weighting vector and gain a higher recognition rate, we proposed a new method integrating Radon transform and SPP (RadonSPP). In this paper, we conduct experiments on the public BJUT Eyebrow Database to verify the feasibility and validity of the proposed method. In addition, the experiment results show that the method integrating Radon transform and SPP can gain a higher recognition rate than SPP, and we explain the reason.

articleTitle: The coordination control of Electrohydraulic Brak System
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In this paper, a coordination control strategy of Electrohydraulic Brake System was designed based on Sliding Mode Variable structure control. It mainly researched on how the motor participate in Anti-lock Braking system. The simulation results show that the algorithm effectively improved the hydraulic system slow response disadvantage and the oscillations of longitudinal acceleration and slip ratio are effectively suppressed. Besides, this paper analyzed the effect of optimal slip ratio of Variable structure control on the coordination control result.

articleTitle: Design of car Bluetooth hands-free mobile phone system in Linux system
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: A car Bluetooth hands-free phone system is designed in Linux operating system. ARM S3C2440A microprocessor is used in vehicle terminal for controlling and managing the system. Bluetooth hands-free application according to Bluetooth Hands-free Profile (HFP), is realized by using API of Bluez protocol stack. In the paper, it analyses HCI, SDP and RFCOMM protocols which are included in HFP and designs the software architecture. The system can successfully control Bluetooth mobile phone, and has high reliability and operating convenience.

articleTitle: Using GM (1, 1) model to forecast the trend of research in Internet of Things
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: A recent development in technology is the Internet of Things (IoT). This is seen to bean integrated part of Future Internet and maybe defined as; a dynamic global network infrastructure with self-configuring capabilities based on standard and interoperable communication protocols. In this paper, we forecast research trends expressed by the amount of research papers published in the digital libraries. GM (1, 1) model is used to predict the number of future research papers based on the previous years' summary. From the results we analyse the research popularity as well as to find out how GM (1, 1) deals with uncertain data sequence. The result shows that in the future, the interest of researchers in this field increase.

articleTitle: Wind farm communication system research based on Ethernet
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper discusses the communication of the wind farm and wind farms with remote power dispatching centre, because so many wind farms plants have been built in the last few years. The power capacity of wind farms becomes more and more important for the power gird. Due to the effect of the weather conditions on the supply it is necessary for the power dispatching centre to monitor the wind farm condition regularly. However, these wind turbines are from different manufacturers, and therefore use incompatible monitoring technologies and communication protocols. So the issues has became how to communicate with wind farm monitoring system and transfer the wind turbine condition information to the remote power dispatching centre safely and reliably. Additionally most wind farms are located in harsh areas, offshore or mountainous area which is different from the centralized power plants of traditional power systems. The IEC 61400-25 series of standards for communication technologies has been designed to address this problem. This enables the power plant to be monitored at the remote power dispatching centre to maintain the power system's stability, reliability, and security. Using international communications standards and protocols such as Ethernet and TCP/IP ensures long term compatibility. This paper is based on the local and regional wind farm system development and the IEC 61400-25 requirements. It uses a wired communication system between the wind turbines, the wind farm monitoring system and the remote power dispatching centre. The whole system is modelled using the OPNET simulator and the results are analysed and presented.

articleTitle: Rapid prototyping design for UAV flight control system simulation
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Design of flight control system is a complex system project. In this paper, flight control system for UAV based on MATLAB/Simulink is introduced. The paper also set out core function of mission management in the whole system, formulate the guidance and control law. At the same time, it has an exploratory study of UAV dynamics model, monitor and sensor system, etc. The architecture design of flight control system at the software level is then established. In addition, it provides the rapid prototyping design for flight control system based on MPC Target and xPC target and has a strong engineering application value.

articleTitle: A prototype of MEMS gyroscope based on digital control
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In order to improve the performance of the Micro Electronic Mechanical System (MEMS) gyroscope, a digital control scheme based on Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) is proposed. The phase locked loop (PLL) in phase tracking, the automatic gain control (AGC) in amplitude control and the quadrature demodulation in the sense output are analyzed respectively. Some important experiments are done and the results adequately show that the scheme is feasible and reliable. The scale factor of the gyroscope is −1.6mV/°/s in the measurement range of ±300°/s, and the zero bias stability attains 22.44°/h.

articleTitle: Finite element modelling and experimental investigation of Low Frequency Electromagnetic Technique in pipeline defect detection
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Finite Element (FE) models of LFET were employed to investigate Low Frequency Electromagnetic Technique (LFET) in pipeline defect detection.
