Two-dimensional and three-dimensional LFET simulations were carried out using the ANSYS Parametric Design Language (APDL). Magnetic Flux Leakage (MFL) signals of different defects were obtained from the established models. From the simulations and experimental results, the practicality of LFET-based pipe defect detection was demonstrated, therefore, it could be recommended for the applications in non-destructive testing of pipelines such as boiler water wall etc.

articleTitle: Adaptive pinning synchronization of the complex dynamical network
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper investigates the synchronization of the complex dynamical network with nearest neighbor rule, by introducing effective adaptive strategies to the coupling strengths. Using the Lyapunov function method, we prove that the dynamical network described by connected graph can synchronize to the given state. In addition, we discuss the synchronization of the complex dynamical network for some special cases. Some simulations verify and illustrate the theoretical results finally.

articleTitle: Sniper: A social relationship based defence for Network Coordinate Systems
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Network Coordinate Systems (NCS) allow accurate latency estimation with low measurement overhead. However, NCS are vulnerable to attacks, which makes security issue a crucial concern in their large-scale deployment. This paper proposes Sniper, a social relationship based defence mechanism for securing NCS. In contrast to prior proposals that allow attacks to occur and then detect them, Sniper can filter out potential malicious nodes before they mount attack. Extensive simulations demonstrate that Sniper can protect NCS against various forms of attacks efficiently and that Sniper can tolerate a large fraction of malicious nodes.

articleTitle: EtherCAT-based functional safety-integrated communication
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The integration of Functional safety has been more and more important in the industry automation, especially for servo drives. So the communication protocol for the control system should support Functional safety. EtherCAT is a real time industrial Ethernet protocol with high performance, which also specifies Functional safety profile. This paper firstly describes the safety integrated servo drive and its safety functions. Then, the FSOE is studied, which communication principle is demonstrated with a functional safety example for servo drive control.

articleTitle: The design of network video monitoring system based on ARM
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper introduces the transplantation process of the camera driver, and then builds the Boa Web Server to complete the monitoring function. The server sends the image to the network, and then we can do video monitoring or image collecting function through the window or webpage in the Linux system. So this system realizes the remote monitoring. This system uses the S3C2440 microprocessor and 301 series USB camera which is produced by Vimicro as the image acquisition equipment and constructs a small size, good reliability, low price and convenient use of network video monitoring system.

articleTitle: SPGAO: A simulation platform for genetic algorithm based on OOP
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The genetic algorithm is one of the most important intelligent method in the evolutionary algorithm and it has been applied in science and engineering field widely. In order to use the genetic algorithm easily and flexibly, this paper provides a simulation platform for the genetic algorithm by using the OOP language and the platform is called SPGAO. The architecture of SPGAO is presented and each module is implemented in detail. The data structure and functions for manipulating the genetic algorithm are defined in this platform and the chromosome data type, crossover, mutation, selection operators are defined. The animation demonstration module in SPGAO is implemented using the double buffer mechanism and it can show the progress of the every step of algorithm. The multithread technology is made for the genetic algorithm. Finally an example of function optimization based on genetic algorithm in SPGAO is provided and it shows that the platform make the user to use the genetic algorithm quickly and efficiently. The SPGAO provides strong interaction and better flexibility.

articleTitle: Design of data acquisition and control system in the coal spontaneous combustion experiment in low temperature
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: At present there are many defects in the data collection process in the coal spontaneous combustion process experiment, so it is needed to improve experiment platform. The data acquisition and control system in the coal spontaneous combustion experiment in low temperature is designed for realizing the data acquisition intelligent control on the combination of theoretical research, numerical simulation and experiment, which is based on the coal oxygen composite theory, establish coal spontaneous combustion process model according to the fluid mechanics and intelligent control theory, and research and test for coal combustion parameters through experiment and theoretical analysis. It provides theoretical basis for the prediction and prevention of coal spontaneous combustion and control technology research which realizes visualization simulation test for the real-time changes of coal body internal temperature field and concentration field in the conditions of different temperature, oxygen quantity, air humidity and so on in the test bench in the furnace.

articleTitle: A mobile agent computing service for distributed risk assessment system
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper mainly focused on how to design and implement a mobile agent computing service, which can improve the efficiency of geospatial data cooperation under distributed, heterogeneous and dynamic environments. A four-layer system architecture and multi agent system was firstly designed. Then a mobile agent computing service model was given. Finally, the above scheme was integrated into a distributed risk assessment service system. Experiment results prove that the mobile computing service can reduce the flow of data in the network, enhance data security, and improve the efficiency of data cooperation.

articleTitle: Implementation of high speed serial communication based on FPGA
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In the embedded integrated navigation system, the high speed multi-serial communication between DSP and peripheral devices is necessary. In the integrated navigation system, DSP is used to process the navigation information, and FPGA is used to control the peripheral devices. In order to meet the system real time capability, UART is designed in the FPGA and connect to DSP by DSP's EMIF. In this way, DSP can be devoted in complicated navigation algorithm and enhance the efficiency and speed of the serial communication. This paper describes the realization of high speed serial communication based on FPGA.

articleTitle: Design scheme of multi-axis numerical and control system based on iCAN protocol of field bus
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The CAN bus is one field bus which is used widely. The development and the application of the CAN bus is introduced in the paper. The main problem of the CAN bus is that there are several different application layer protocols, which is analyzed in the paper. The iCAN protocol developed independently by China is introduced in details, together with the characteristic of Cortex-M3, and a multi-axis numerical and control system based on iCAN protocol is designed.

articleTitle: A study of the Single-Program Multiple-Task model on GPU computing
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In recent years, GPU is rapidly developing in performance and used in wide range of extensive scientific and computation-intensive computing. However, the high performance on GPU depends on the degree of parallelism of applications. So GPU computing is usually used to solve a single large-size problem to utilize its massively parallel capability. In this paper, we devote the efforts to solve a number of variable-size tasks with the same algorithm on GPU and focus on the study of the Single-Program Multiple-Task (SPMT) model on GPU computing. In addition, a novel allocation algorithm is proposed to map multiple tasks into GPU execution resources on SPMT model. The experiments show that our solution increase the performance of processing multiple tasks and can achieve up to 86.7% efficiency of single large-size task and 4.1 times speedup over sequential multi-task on Geforce 9800GTX+ in our example application.

articleTitle: Development of an automatic test and control system for radar seeker
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Automatic test and control system is the desired system for the test of massive electronic equipments. In this paper, an automatic test and control system for a certain type of radar seeker is proposed, based on the virtual instrument technology. The system architecture on the basis of the Compact Peripheral Component Interconnect (CPCI) platform is introduced, and the design and implementation of the special-purpose boards and supporting software are discussed. After the system calibration, system testing was performed. The testing results prove that this system with high efficiency and accuracy is suitable for the test of the radar seeker and other similar products.

articleTitle: The preliminary extruding technology with two-material source for 3D assembly
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Cell direct controlled assembly technology with one material source is grown-up increasingly, but can't satisfy the multi-cell assembly requirements. On this condition, it is becoming a needed research program to develop an assembly technology which can distribute a variety of cells and biological activity materials to a specifically location precisely and noninvasively, so that a multi-cell structure similar to natural tissue structure and function can be constructed. Here utilizing an in-house single nozzle assembly technology based on rapid prototyping and controlled forming process with cell gelatin-based hydrogels, develop a kernel of multi-cell directly controlled assembly technology, namely the two-material source controlled extruding technology. It mainly includes a multi-nozzle switched on-demand extruding technology and a single nozzle with a multi-material source delivery extruding technology, it is possible to directly manipulate cells with bionic extracellular matrices and arrange them in proper spatial sites according to predefined digital models to form living constructs. The experimental formed 3D cell structure was 3–4 mm high and cultured for 8 weeks, actually, there is no limitation for the size and height of the 3D organ analogs. This technology will direct promote the development of multi-cell controlled assembly technology; consequently promote the manufacturing engineering of artificial organs greatly.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of 3-D imaging sonar signal processing on FPGAs
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper proposes the implementation of 3-D imaging sonar signal processing on FPGAs. The architecture and cut-away view of the signal processor is shown. The procedures of sonar signal processing and electronic signal processing are also illustrated. Finally, the paper gives the resources utilizations for the FPGAs. The proposed signal processor has both low communication overhead and low requirement of hardware resource.

articleTitle: Acoustic analysis of the vocal tract from a 3D physiological articulatory model by finite-difference time-domain method
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: A faithful 3D physiological articulatory model was constructed in the previous work to investigate the mechanism of speech production. The model consists of the tongue, hyoid bone, jaw, larynx complex, bilateral piriform fossae, and vocal tract wall that includes the hard palate, soft palate, pharyngeal wall. In this study, we generated a series of time-varying vocal tract shapes in simulating vowel-vowel (VV) sequence by the 3D articulatory model and analyzed their acoustic characteristics using the finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) method. Area functions (AF) showed that the vocal tract shapes vary smoothly frame by frame, while the transfer functions (TF) transit continuously from vowel to vowel for the first four formants. Acoustic roles of the piriform fossae were also examined. The piriform fossa generated two spectral d ips around 4 kHz in transfer function. Pressure distribution patterns at first four formant frequencies for vowel /a/ were examined, which are consistent with previous studies. Experimental results showed that our physiological model can describe the details of the vocal tract.

articleTitle: The study of binary decoding cache for instruction-set simulation
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Instruction-set simulator (ISS) is used to complete most of the software development and debugging, in order to improve software development efficiency. To improve the performance of instruction-set simulator for ZW100 which was developed by CETC, this paper proposes a optimization strategy for instruction set simulator, with a binary decoding cache which is based on the largest jump block. Using this strategy, the simulator can achieve the adaptive size of cache.

articleTitle: An optimization model for shingled disk via hybrid mapping and multiple garbage collection strategies
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The emergence of shingle recording technology has made the high-capacity disk possible, which does not change the original magnetic medium, but add a shielding layer to the original disk. However, random write performance of the current shingle disk is very poor, which becomes an important factor restricting the extention of its applications. We propose an Optimization Shingle Disk Model short for OSDM to provide a feasible method for shingle disk. Through the study of traditional shingle disk model, we list the following optimization aspects: 1. Redesign mapping module, aiming at the random write optimization, where we proposed the partition mapping using SR-Sector and SR-Block structures; 2. In garbage collection module, through the dynamic optimal and greedy algorithms, each region has shown good collection efficiency; 3. For data transfer module, a multiple collection has shown to improve the separation efficiency of cold and hot data. A prototype of OSDM also has been implemented by software simulation, and the results also show excellent performance as well as 5 times significant capacity.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of visual SCL configurator
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: IEC 61850-6 defines a substation configuration language (SCL) and provides interoperability between intelligent electronic devices (IEDs). The complexity of SCL configuration files makes it difficult for engineers to configure IEDs, and therefore a visual configuration tool has been developed to streamline the work. This paper introduces the technical principle and implementation methods for building such a tool. Its software architecture, visual component and SVG implementation for visual interface are discussed in detail. Several other design considerations like SCL object model, visual representation and graphical substation elements are taken into account as well. The approaches introduced in this paper have potential for fully graphical XML-based configurators.

articleTitle: Influence of aerodynamic load on aerocraft actuator and research on Special Loading with Hydraulic Load Simulator
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper focuses on influence of aerodynamic load on aerocraft actuator, then proposes a new concept of Special Load to evaluate the ultimate performance of actuator, and explores how to process the Special Load simulation with Hydraulic Load Simulator (HLS). To test actuator stability and load stiffness, conventional methods generally use several specific loads for simulation and test considering both cases with no load and elasticity load. In general, if the system is stable without load, it will remain stable after loading. The elasticity load test is taken to measure the load stiffness of the system. Furthermore, theoretical and practical methods are insufficient to proceed the research of how authentic aerodynamic load influences actuator. Practical test experiences indicate that although the actuator passes the loading test with spring, some aerodynamic load profile will still make the actuator controller unstable in the real case. Based on the analysis of aerodynamic load, particularity of inertia, viscosity and elasticity load, a correlation model can be built aerodynamic load and state variables of actuator control system. In this paper, we attempt to replace aerodynamic load with a combination of some special loads as the Equivalent Special Load. In order to reproduce the influence on actuator of aerodynamic load with Equivalent Special Load, potential methods applying HLS are explored. Moreover, conducting the analysis of dissimilarities of special and conventional loading, as well as stability analysis, help put forward the requirements of controller for special loading.

articleTitle: Fuzzy criticality assessment for process equipments maintenance
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Criticality-based maintenance (CBM) is a prioritized approach to the maintenance of (industrial) process equipment. CBM requires personnel with a thorough knowledge of the process/equipment under scrutiny. In this paper a criticality assessment system that is implemented by a local company (which represents the expertise and knowledge of the company experts) is reviewed and fuzzy logic theory is applied to improve the system's capability and reliability. The quality of the fuzzy system is evaluated based on several case studies. The results show that the fuzzy logic based system does not only what the conventional system does, but also outperforms in terms of reliability and has a unique ranking capability.

articleTitle: Design and simulation of high frame frequency CMOS camera image acquisition system
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: For the requirement of high frame in supervision and control for instruments in compartment and record of missiles lunching outside the compartment of a fighter, a high frame CMOS image acquisition system based on the FPGA is designed. High speed CMOS image sensor LUPA-300 is used in this system. Xilinx's FPGA is used as timing and readout of the image sensor and image transmission controlling. FIFO generated by FPGA using Verilog HDL (Hardware Description Language) achieves high-speed image data buffering. Camera Link interface is used to communicate with the image acquisition card of the host computer. The Experiments of the system show the frame can reach 249.6 fps in a format of 640 * 480 with the clock of 80 MHz.

articleTitle: Test point optimization for model-based fault diagnosis expert system
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Expert system, as the basis for other fault diagnosis methods, can take advantages of the expert domain knowledge and intuitive rule-based reasoning model. However, when test points of a faulty system are limited, combinatorial explosion problem of minimal diagnosis is caused by the use of model-based fault diagnosis expert system. In this paper, we develop a method to gradually reduce the minimal diagnosis by adding the system test points to realize fault location. Firstly, the computing procedure is formalized by combining set enumeration tree (SE-tree) with closed nodes to generate all the minimal hitting sets (i.e., minimal diagnosis). Then, as fault diagnosis synthetic information quantity and correlation matrix are introduced, we show that with progressive decomposition of the matrix, test point optimization strategy can be found out. Finally, using new observations and removal rules, minimal diagnosis can be gradually reduced, until the only minimal diagnosis is retained. The proposed test point optimization strategy for model-based fault diagnosis expert system can be applied to different engineering applications and its effectiveness is demonstrated with an example.

articleTitle: Non-destructive testing of GFRP materials by Fourier-domain Infrared Optical Coherence Tomography
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Fourier-domain (or spectral-domain) Infrared Optical Coherence Tomography (FDOCT) can penetrate into the scattering material noncontactly and therefore it can be used to characterize and image the inner structure of material in a non-invasive manner. In the paper, glass-fibre reinforced polymer (GFRP) materials were quantitatively characterized by using home-made FDOCT system. In the developed FDOCT system, a 50W Tungsten halogen lamp and a high-performance spectrometer are, respectively, employed as the light source and the detector. The broadband of the spectrometer and thermal light source results in the FDOCT system with high robust performance and an excellent depth resolution of 0.7 um. From the experimental results, the developed FDOCT system could be recommended in non-destructive testing or health monitoring of GFRP materials.

articleTitle: Study on the technology of inverter based on DSP and SPWM
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper introduces a SPWM inverter to output the high precision three-phase SPWM through rule sampling method, based on TMS320LF2407A chip, by using comparison units on event manager. Simple circuit, easy programming, high quality and reliability of SPWM waveform, and output waveform of the variable frequency, all can well meet the requirements of VVVF inverter system, and achieve more easily. Test results prove that the system is running stablely, has small harmonic coefficient and a certain practical value.

articleTitle: A new validity measure and fuzzy clustering algorithm for vanishing-point detection
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In combination with the fuzzy clustering algorithm, this paper proposes an image-preprocessing method. Critical edge information can thus be extracted from an image to locate vanishing lines and the vanishing point more accurately. To estimate an appropriate initial cluster number, the study also proposes a new clustering validity measure to assess the similarity of cluster areas. Experimental results show that the proposed preprocessing method and validity measure can not only accurately discover the location of the vanishing point and vanishing lines, but also further provide useful information for image segmentation.

articleTitle: Design for portable virtual instrument with USB interface
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper introduces the design process of a new type of portable virtual oscilloscope and signal generator, including both the hardware and software design. The data collecting board centers around the new generation of highly integrated C8051F020 and the VB program developed. The USB communication mode has been applied between the data collecting board and computer. This virtual instrument integrates together the perfect function if signal generating, data collecting, real-time data curve display, data storage and playback, analysis afterwards, etc.

articleTitle: The application of remote monitoring in solar MPPT output device based on GPRS-internet
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper introduces remote monitoring of maximum power point tracking (MPPT) output data system design scheme based on GPRS-Internet, It includes hardware and software systems. According to the power output data complete solar power output device reliability monitoring, as the same time, analysis solar maximum power point tracking output device's efficiency, provides a quick and convenient means long-distance maintenance for solar power and related equipment, save a lot of maintenance costs, also can provide a objective data platform about the solar maximum power point tracking output devices. Using GPRS-DTU and GPRS-Internet communications connection realize remote monitoring. It uses force control software to storage and analysis data. Operation results show that the system stability, conveniently installation and operation.

articleTitle: Research on Agent and Web Service-based automatic screening system of gas discharge tubes
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The existing screening systems of gas discharge tubes have following problems: they cannot take order with the changes timely when the business management applications or processes change; they are information silos. In order to solve these problems, this paper firstly analyzes the Agent, Web Service; Then, this paper analyzes the architecture of agent and web service-based lightning protection components automatic test system; Thirdly, this paper designed and analyzes the architecture of gas discharge tube automatic screening system; Finally, the screening system was designed and implemented, the concrete instances show that the system overcame the disadvantages of the existing systems, when it was fitted in with the changes of business management applications or processes through Agent method, it integrated with other systems through Web Service architecture without information silos.

articleTitle: Porosity analysis based on the CT images processing for the oil reservoir sandstone
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Sandstone is widespread in the world as the main storage place for oil and gas. The pore structure characterization of the reservoir sandstone is crucial for oil and gas production. Porosity is the ratio of the pore space volume to the total volume of the rock, and it is one of the key parameters of the pore structure. X-ray computer tomography (CT) is often used as an effective tool to investigate the pore structure of the rock in the recent years. Porosity analysis is the key for the CT grayscale images segmentation. The accurate choice of the threshold valve for the binary CT images is also essential. The maximum variance method (OSTU) of the threshold valve in the image processing is presented in the CT images binary and segmentation in the paper, where the measure porosity with air (He) as a constraint condition. The porosity calculation from 2D CT images processing shows that OSTU threshold valve method constrained with the known porosity avoid the random comparing from the water porosity and the air porosity.

articleTitle: Norm invariance property of two-spin 1/2 systems
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The problem of norm invariance property of two-spin half systems is discussed in this paper. Based on the basis of tensor space, the Liouville-von Neumann equation of two-spin half systems is transformed into the coordinate differential equation by using matrices of adjoint operators of two-spin half systems. Then, norm invariance property of trajectory of the transformed coordinate differential system is established.

articleTitle: Energy efficient data compression algorithm and strategy for data uploading in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: For the applications of Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN), the lifetime of WSN has been a very important and hot research topic. In practical applications, data gathering is a common but critical operation in many applications of WSNs, especially in environment monitoring system. In some harsh environment, deploying wireless sensor networks is a difficult and expensive work. Therefore, energy saving is one of critical issues for sensor networks since most of sensors are equipped with non-rechargeable batteries that have limited lifetime. In this paper, we proposed a data compression algorithm (DCA) and a strategy for data uploading (SDU) to extend WSNs' lifetime. Simulation results show that DCA, SDU and DCA_SDU (combination of data compression algorithm and strategy for data uploading) outperforms LEACH significantly with prolonging the network lifetime over 32%.

articleTitle: Echo canceller with both double-talk detector and path change detector
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: An echo canceller with both double-talk detector (DTD) and echo path change detector (PCD) is put forward. Double-talk detector is based on the activity detection of speech, using sub-filter to detect the near end talk, and enhancing its performance by adding a sliding window. The path change detector works by comparing the performance between main-filter and sub-filter. There is a problem when an echo canceller has both detectors: It's hard to discriminate between echo and near end speech after path changes, which can cause the echo of far voice increase suddenly and this echo is similar to the near end voice. To solve this problem, we propose to change double-talk detection threshold after path change happened. In addition, using the short silence mute at the beginning of a call, some random sequences will be sent to initialize the filter. The simulation results show that the proposed echo canceller has a satisfactory performance during double-talk and path change.

articleTitle: Research of classification methods of EEG signal based on wavelet packet transform and CSP
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: These years have been witnessing an increasing emphasis on researches of brain computer interface (BCI) which becomes a novel communication method from the brain to the output device, independent on normal peripheral nerve and muscle. And electroencephalogram (EEG) signal processing is one of the key research topics. In this paper, wavelet packet transform and common spatial patterns (CSP) are utilized for feature extraction. Finally, support vector machine (SVM) and Mahalanobis-distance are chosen to classify two kinds of motor imagery signal of left and right hands. Through experiments, we can recognize various factors affecting classification accuracy and the maximum accuracy rate could be up to 90.00%.

articleTitle: A novel computer network traffic modeling based on threshold-optimization
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Aiming at bottlenecks (such as ambiguous physical meaning, complex mathematical expression, and so on) in traditional network traffic modeling analysis, this paper puts forward a novel threshold-optimization-based traffic model.In this model, the actual network traffic is divided into two different parts (i.e., a-traffic with burst characteristic, and b-traffic with steady characteristic) according to optimized threshold results obtained with particle swarm optimization algorithm. The a-traffic and b-traffic are respectively described with mathematical formulas which not only can depict the traffic nature precisely but also can be resolved easily. It is proved that the threshold-optimization-based traffic model presented in this paper can describe the traffic nature more accurately.

articleTitle: Theory analysis of a new absolute position sensor based on electromagnetism
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Rotating angle of joint is an important factor in control field of robot arm. In the paper, a new sensor to test the absolute rotating angle of robot arm joints is designed. Firstly, structure of the magnetic field emitter is presented. Secondly, the generating process of signals sine and cosine is introduced. Then, working principle of the senor is described. At last, a new encoder is designed. The emitter working together with the encoder can test the absolute rotating angle and the calculation process is given in the paper. At the end of the paper, advantages of the sensor are listed.

articleTitle: Performance analysis and improvement on spread spectrum communicattion system
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper processes the theoretical analysis about the interference when digital or analogy jammer occurrs in spread spectrum communication system. Bit-error-rate (BER) performance is simulated to evaluate the influence caused by different spread codes and jammer signals. Moreover, some new methods to improve the performance of spreading system are discussed.

articleTitle: Integral variable structure control for grid connection of double-fed wind generator
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: With combination of integral variable structure control (IVSC) and field-oriented vector control technique, a control strategy is presented for smooth no-load grid connection of variable-speed constant-frequency double-fed wind-power generator. In order to get strong robustness to many kinds of disturbances in global range and excellent dynamic performance, the control system consists of two current controllers using IVSC and one voltage deviation controller based on variable integration rate. The saturation function is employed in switch control, which can decrease the chattering of rotor current and reduce the harmonic distortion rate of stator voltage.

articleTitle: Analysis on the control of supercavitation projectile stability
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The existence of supercavition affects the trajectory as well as the stability of motion of projectile. So modelling and control problems for supercavitation projectile are complicated and important. A ameliorate control device was designed to control the attack angle of cavitator in order to obtain the better stability performances of projectile. The nonlinear dynamics equations motion in body coordinates were obtained via analysed the hydrodynamic of supercavitation projectile. And the control parameter β, attack angle of cavitator, effect the stability of supercavitation projectile was obtained based on stability equations. Simulation results indicate that pitching angle velocity of projectile reduced 90% and the impact force reduced 87% using this control model. This study is of engineering signification.

articleTitle: Interactive segmentation based on super-pixel and multi-cues combination
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Interactive segmentation is very useful in many computer vision applications, and in which graph cut is a very popular technique. Traditional graph cut approaches usually assign labels to pixels or pixel-grids. To large scale images, those approaches are very time consuming, and possibly fail when there are some similar properties between foreground and background in color, texture, etc. In this work, we improve the computation process of the edge costs in graph with neighborhood interactions, and propose a new edge descriptor to measure edge continuity among neighboring nodes. Rather than a simple combination of multi-cues, we use parameter learning to predict the weights of different cues. The experiment results show our method increased segmentation accuracy and reduced effort on the part of the user.

articleTitle: Gait detection and analysis based on omni-directional lower limb rehabilitation robot
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In this paper, an ultrasonic gait detection and analysis method is introduced. The proposed detection system, which is fixed on an omni-directional lower limb rehabilitation robot, can get the gait parameters of subjects including step length, speed, and frequency, etc. A set of gait symmetry index is proposed to analysis walking symmetry of subjects, which is based on gait cycle phase, swing instantaneous velocity and the walking position of subject. Experimental results show that the gait detection system can timely get the gait information of subjects, it is proved that the walking symmetry of subject can be effectively analyzed by the suggested symmetry index.

articleTitle: Hamiltonian stabilization control for hydro turbine generating units
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The stability of hydro turbine generating units (HTGU) is very important for power systems as it is power supply point. Based on the Hamiltonian model of HTGU, this paper derives the additional Hamiltonian function by means of Casmir function method. Modified Hamiltonian function is a Lyapunov function at given equilibrium, and it can is used to stabilize system. Simulation results show that stabilization control is effective, and can decrease the reverse regulation of active power.

articleTitle: Simulation of the fuzzy PID control system for Brushless DC motors based on MATLAB
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Based on the mathematical model of the Brushless DC motor (BLDCM), the simulation model of the BLDCM control system in MATLAB has been built. The self-adaptive fuzzy PID controller is applied to the speed control of BLDCM to adjust certain parameters of the fuzzy PID online by adopting fuzzy control principle, so as to achieve high-precision control for motor speed. The system is analyzed in MATLAB/SIMULINK. The simulation result shows that the simulation model can work well with quick response, no overshoot output, high control precision, and the system has strong robustness for various disturbances and parameter variations, whose static and dynamic performance with the self-adaptive fuzzy PID control are both better than conventional PID control.

articleTitle: A fast responsive and compounded control method for initial phase of small satellite attitude tracking
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper studies a fast responsive control method to deal with the initial phase control problem of spacecraft-attitude tracking. A “Feedforward Compensation & Error PD & Modified Sliding Mode” compounded control law combining PWPF modulator is proposed to enhance the robustness and the responsive velocity of the MIMO attitude tracking system. The stability of the control law is demonstrated by using a Lyapunov's function. Numerical simulation is presented to illustrate the effectiveness of the control strategy with the present of external disturbance and uncertain inertial parameters.

articleTitle: A generic and scalable mapping system for ID/locator separation based future internet architectures
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: ID/Locator separation is a clean-slate way of addressing the challenges as mobility, routing scalability, scalable multi-homing, traffic engineering faced by current Internet. By now many ID/Locator separation based future Internet architectures have been proposed by the Internet research community. And it is commonly believed that mapping system plays a very important role in ID/Locator separation based architecture, making a bridge for connecting ID and Locator for users and hosts. In this paper we propose a generic and scalable mapping system for ID/Locator separation architecture, which is organized in hierarchical DHT way, providing great scalability, robustness, and flexibility.

articleTitle: The analysis and research of Wireless Sensor Network coverage optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Network coverage is one of the important indicators to measure the performance of sensor network, and is one of the basic problems of sensor network. We can study the problem of area coverage in order to find ways to improve sensor network service quality. Based on the introduction and analysis of the multiple area coverage algorithms, this paper studies and analyzes the Dividing Domain Algorithms, Delaminating and Non-Uniformity Coverage algorithm and Neighbourhood Node Utmost Coverage Algorithm, summarize and compare these algorithm characteristics, and the current main problems of covering algorithm are discussed.

articleTitle: Clustering strategies for sharing web services in mobile P2P networks
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Web Services and Peer to Peer (P2P) technologies both aim at providing a platform for publishing and discovery across networks. It is sensible to adopt Web services to P2P networks. But due to the network bandwidth and computing capability of mobile devices, it is a challenge to effectively and efficiently deploy Web services to mobile P2P networks. In this paper, we propose clustering strategies for sharing Web services in mobile P2P networks. We first present a mechanism based on P2P agent-based architecture in which a relay node bridges between mobile nodes in wireless links and an agent node in wired links. Then a number of clustering strategies are investigated. The functionalities of relay nodes are discussed and the performance of the mechanism with different clustering strategies is analysed. The results show the mechanism is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: New similarity measures for automatic short answer scoring in spontaneous non-native speech
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper focuses on similarity measures about automatic short answer scoring in spontaneous non-native speech. We propose two new corpus-based measures of text similarity, which are Manhattan similarity measure and keywords coverage rate based on edit distance. Manhattan similarity measure is converted by Manhattan distance. Furthermore, automatic speech recognition (ASR) system and students' pronunciation may lead words' variation including pronunciation and morphology. Improved keywords coverage rate combined edit distance can distinguish students' grade and provide more objective scores. Experiment results show that these similarity measures are effective to our scoring system and performance of scoring system can achieve 96% of it by human raters.

articleTitle: Computational cognitive modeling of civil aviation pilots
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Aiming at the lack of the pilot cognitive behavior integration modeling in the domestic aviation field (section 1), this paper provides some deep explanation and comprehensive models for the inherent mechanism of pilots flying skills acquisition, retrieval and exertion on the base of the ACT-R architecture (section 3).The core of section 2 is that it discusses the features of ACT-R theory. Through describing the process of flying an aircraft (section 4.1), the experimental design (section 4.2) and integrated simulation (section 4.3) of the typical missions in the cockpit, “the pilot warning information perception, processing and decision-making”, are set up. The subjects' performance and the simulation results are consistent at three distinct levels, from broad to fine grain (section 4.4). It shows that the ACT-R architecture applies the modeling of pilot well.

articleTitle: Nonmonotonic trust region algorithm for unconstrained nonsmooth optimization problems
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Nonmonotonic trust region algorithm for nonsmooth unconst-rained optimization problems is proposed and compared with the classical trust region method. At the same time, the global convergence of the algorithm is proved under the conditions of some assumptions.Numerical results show that nonmonotonic strategy not only in solving nonsmooth unconstrained optimization problems is effective, but also expanding the nonmonotonic trust region algorithm application fields.

articleTitle: Adjusting MRP with real-time process quality for postponement manufacturing
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Postponement manufacturing often requires that the identical items should be differentiated for customization with different processes at a Customer Process Differentiation Point(CPDP). A significant issue then emerges as how to determine the input item quantity that should be processed with a customization process at a manufacturing stage. A real-time yield rate based methodology is proposed to achieve dynamic adjustment of MRP. The algorithm for implementing the proposed methodology is also developed. A case study shows that the item-differentiating decisions made at CPDP are more reasonable than those made according to traditional MRP approaches.

articleTitle: Study on web based Fruit pests image retrieval technology
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Fruit pests can cause severedamage to Fruit trees. This paper studies on the web based fruit trees pest image retrieval technology. Firstly, by contrast, we choose the color feature as a retrieval method. Secondly we modify the use of histogram intersection method, improveand correct the retrieval similarity value.

articleTitle: Research of Multi-target attack ordering based on multi-hierarchy cluster decision
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Environment of modern air war is complicated and mutative, and it has many threat targets in the air. In order to win absolute superiority in actual air war, Multi-target attack ordering is particularly important. This paper constructs a multi-hierarchy structure model of the target by analyzing the influence factors of air target. The target weight is replaced by clustering weight, combining grey clustering decision-making method, structuring grey fixed weight clustering coefficient matrix and determining target attack sequence. Finally, it particularizes a practical example to validate the rationality and feasibility of this method.

articleTitle: A novel H.264 rate control algorithm for scene transition video
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper presents a novel scene transition detection method and a rate control algorithm for H.264. To enhance the reliability of scene transition detection, the difference of histogram of sub-pictures (DOHSP) is used as a metric. The scene transition frame is encoded in intra-pattern. And the target number of bits for it is determined based on buffer status. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can increase the average peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) of reconstructed video by 1.42 dB. At the same time, video quality fluctuation is depressed.

articleTitle: Efficient parallel design for BWT-based DNA sequences data multi-compression algorithm
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: DNA is the crucial material foundation for survival, reproduction and evolutionary development of species. DNA sequences data compression plays an important role in storage, management and transmission of massive genetic data. In the field of data compression, there are not only classical data compression algorithms but also some improved algorithms that are specific to DNA sequences data compression. In this paper, we propose an optimized method for BWT-based DNA sequence data multi-compression algorithm by using OpenMP and MPI. The revised algorithm has a good performance.

articleTitle: Tracking control of 2-DOF underactuated mechanical systems
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The tracking controller design of 2-DOF underactuated mechanical systems is investigated in this paper. First the system is linearized at its equilibrium, then the controlled Lagrangian and asymmetric damping force to get desired closed-loop system are constructed, and asymptotical stability conditions of the closed-loop system are derived from its characteristic equation. By solving matching conditions satisfied by the close-loop system, tracking controller for the underactuated system can be obtained. At last, as examples, 2-DOF Acrobot and Pendubot are studied. The matching conditions for the two robots are solved and associate controllers are designed. The simulation results verify effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Application of BP neural network in failure diagnosis of electromagnetic direction valve
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The paper discussed the application of BP Neural network in electromagnetic direction valve failure diagnosis. The models of failure simulation were made through damaging some parts of the electromagnetic direction valve. A three-layer BP neural network were constructed to diagnose the electromagnetic direction valve based on the signals measured by a non -intrusive detection device. After trained by a subset of the input-output dataset, the diagnosis errors of the application of the BP neural network in electromagnetic direction valve failure diagnosis were comparatively small.

articleTitle: Guide control of the autonomous mobile robot based on image pattern recognition
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The main purpose of this study is to use pattern recognition methods to control an autonomous mobile robot (AMR) and then achieve the purpose of navigation. The AMR is equipped with a video camera and is controlled to search for patterns on the ground. First, the AMR will go ahead to approach the pattern, and then identify it, and then perform the action according to the instruction the pattern gave. When this pattern action is completed, the next pattern is sought and the action will continue, so the circle continues to achieve the navigation control of the AMR

articleTitle: Harmonic detection in traction power system based on improved Hilbert-Huang transform
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The improved Hilbert-Huang transform is applied in harmonic detection in traction power system, in this paper. Because the energy of fundamental is much larger than the other harmonics', mode-mixing appears during the sifting by Empirical Mode Decomposition (EMD), and consequently, each single harmonic component cannot be effectively extracted from the complex original signal. In order to solve the mode-mixing problem, the improved method, EMD based on Fourier transform, is used in this paper. The improved HHT method is applied to analyse harmonic voltage and harmonic current in traction power system, and then complex harmonic signal can be decomposed into single harmonic component, and time-amplitude and time-frequency of harmonics can be obtained accurately. The results show that the improved method has better performance in harmonic analysis than wavelet packet analysis in traction power system.

articleTitle: Skeleton detection of crack based on multiscale geometric analysis in space domain
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The common defects of work pieces include cracks, inclusions, pores and shrinkages. This paper presents a crack's skeleton detection method based on multiscale geometric analysis in space domain using beamlets and curve segments. By combining the tree structure of multiscale and top to bottom inter-scale inhibition strategy, the skeleton of crack is detected. Numerical experimental results demonstrate the method is effective.

articleTitle: A formal definition on ontology integration
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: There is currently a great deal of research focused on integrating ontologies created for similar domains through different sources. Generally, the definitions of ontology integration explain the functions of the operation. However, there are less works that expound the formal definitions of ontology integration. This paper formally defines ontology integration based on micro-sub graphs, and then proves that the constructed integration ontology is consistent.

articleTitle: Design of a high-voltage intelligent insulation resistance tester
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: To ensure the security and economic operation of power equipment, there must be regularly test of its insulation resistance. In this article, an intelligent insulation resistance tester based on C8051F020 has been designed. It consists of DC high-voltage module, measuring circuit, display module and some additional control circuit, making the test of the insulation resistance in a low voltage come true. It improves the test speed a lot, shortens the test time, and also stops the artificial operating error. A large number of experimental tests show that the tester has the feature of regulation high-voltage output, strong load ability, high test precision, suitable used in the field??and some additional functions, such as the display of measuring time, battery check, automatically storage of measurement data, print the measurement data and so on.

articleTitle: A hybrid approach for Chinese word similarity computing based on HowNet
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Word similarity has a wide range of applications, such as machine translation, word sense disambiguation <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1, 5]</sup>, text classification, information extraction and so on. HowNet is an online common-sense knowledge system <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[12]</sup>. It's described by a language called KDML (Knowledge Database Markup Language). In this paper, we use the resources provided by HowNet 2002 <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[11]</sup> to compute the semantic similarity of words, and propose a hybrid approach for calculating word similarity using tree-similarity and Markov model.

articleTitle: Design of algorithm for assignment of MSE theses evaluation
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In order to meet the need of advanced engineering technologic talents for economic development, masters of software engineering (MSE) draw more and more attention of the society and schools. The evaluation of theses is very important in the process of education of the MSE students. Then how to assign theses evaluation has become an important applied topic. This paper gives an algorithmic description to settle the program. It is shown that this program can improve the efficiency in practice and has considerable application value.

articleTitle: The analysis of multi-fractal structure of stock markets on the basis of MF-DFA
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Fractal theory is one of important branches of modern nonlinear science, whose development provides economics research with a new tool. Based on Fractal theory, the paper chooses the profit data from stock market and uses MF-DFA to study fractal property. It is found that stock market has obvious Multi-fractal characteristics. Furthermore, it is also found the significant difference between developed country's mature stock markets and developing country's emerging stock markets.

articleTitle: Configuration design and analysis of generalized inverse pose kinematic problem of 6-DOF wire-driven gantry crane robots
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Some configurations of 6-DOF wire-driven parallel crane robots with 3 wires have been designed. For each kind of the design configurations, the generalized inverse pose kinematics problems are analyzed and the general existences of solutions are studied, which will verify the feasibility of the design configurations. It has a certain guiding significance for future researchers to select the configuration of 6-DOF wire-driven parallel crane robots with 3 wires.

articleTitle: An adaptive multiuser interference cancellation for ofdma communication systems
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In multiuser systems, the multi-user interference (MUI) degraded the system performance, especially in near-far effect environments. In this paper, an adaptive weight partial parallel interference cancellation (AWPPIC) scheme is proposed to reduce the MUIs and to improve the bit error rate (BER) performance for uplink orthogonal frequency division multiple access (OFDMA) communication systems. Simulation results show that under the near far problems for block-interleaved subcarrier assignment (BICA) scheme, the AWPPIC scheme can improve the BER performance for all users.

articleTitle: Supervised and unsupervised face recognition method base on 3CCA
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Feature fusion is widely used in face recognition as a new technology. As we all know, face recognition methods can be divided into two parts: supervised methods and unsupervised methods. So we want to propose a new algorithm which can get a better group of effective discriminant vectors for recognition by combining supervised methods and unsuperviseds method together. Hence we introduce a novel method for feature extraction and feature fusion based on the canonical correlation analysis (CCA). In particular, we extend the traditional CCA method to 3 sets CCA (3CCA), which can extract canonical correlation features from three different feature sets. Finally, we implement the supervised (LDA, DCV, DLDA) and unsupervised (PCA, LPP, SPP) methods for face recognition based on 3CCA. At the end of this paper, we compare our methods with other face recognition methods on AR face database, the experiment results show that our proposed approaches have better recognition performance compared with single supervised and unsupervised feature extraction algorithms.

articleTitle: A novel LOS/NLOS channel learning approach based on PSO algorithm
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Particle swarm optimization (PSO) is a swarm intelligence based computer algorithm that is used to find a solution in the search space of an optimization problem. Adding frequency diversity, through subcarrier redundancy, in orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) is a popular approach to improve the robustness of the system. However, frequency redundant OFDM system is prone to high peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR), due to the fact that the same source information is transmitted on multiple subcarriers. Existing schemes such as Selective Mapping (SLM) and partial transmit sequence (PTS) are effective but difficult to implement due to the high computation complexity. In this paper, we propose a two stage PAPR reduction method. We analyze the computational complexity and extensive simulations on the PAPR and show that our scheme considerably reduces the computational complexity while achieving similar PAPR reduction as SLM and better PAPR reduction than PTS.

articleTitle: Embedded real time image compression module for data link
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In order to solve the current fundamental conflicts between the large amounts of image data and low channel bandwidth of tactical data link, and to realize real time transmission of images, an effective image compression scheme is presented. A novel algorithm for CCSDS 122.0-B-1 image data compression convenient for hardware implementation is proposed. The algorithm has lower complexity and good parallel architecture, the reconstructed image quality and coding speed are improved. Experiment results show the feasibility and efficiency of this scheme, and the peak signal noise ratio (PNSR) is larger than 35dB and the coding time is reduced, which totally meets real time compression requirement.

articleTitle: Research on fundamental properties of C2 system-oriented Complex Network
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In this paper, Complex Network theory is applied to macroscopic research of C2 system, and based on fitness degree model of scale-free network, the topological properties and robustness of C2 Complex Network are discussed. In view of the cascading failures of Complex Network, the node dependency degree parameter and the adjustable increasing parameter are added to the load-capacity model, and the fundamental research approach to the cascading failures of C2 system, which opens a new way for the research of macroscopic law of C2 system.

articleTitle: A novel static calibration method for antenna position error based on CDGPS
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In the GPS/INS Navigation System, the accuracy of navigation result is influenced directly by the position error of GPS antennas. Research on the static calibration method of position error is conducted. With the foundation of Carrier phase Differential GPS (CDGPS) basic formula, the longtime observation position error calibration equation is created through the analysis of error sources, a novel calibration algorithm based on attitude angle search is proposed, in which the best estimation vectors are selected according to the least squares method and residuals of observation equation, then an iteration calibration is carried out after the attitude determination process. No extra equipments are required besides the original GPS components. The numeric simulation and practical tests are conducted to verify the algorithm, comparison results with other methods which show the accuracy and effectiveness of the algorithm are also presented.

articleTitle: Two-dimensional sparse preserving projection for face recognition
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The basic idea of sparse representation is that any sample can be accurately reconstructed by few related samples, however, one-dimensional sparse projection damages the structures of samples when turning image matrices into vectors in feature extraction and it also results in the problem of singular covariance matrix. This article extends one-dimensional sparse preserving projection to two-dimensional feature extraction area, and develops a new method called two-dimensional sparse preserving projection (2D-SPP), 2D-SPP can effectively extract the features and resolve the small sample size problem. The experimental results on face database verify the validity of this method.

articleTitle: PID fault tolerant control with consistent pole and H∞ PERFORMACNE INDICES CONSTRAINT
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper focus on the PID fault tolerant controller design method for linear discrete-time stochastic system with multi-performance indices constraint. The performance indices investigated in this paper including circular region index and robust H∞ performance index. Based on the convex optimal theory and LMI method, consistency analysis method between multi-performance indexes is deducted in detail. And the range of H∞ performance index, which is consistent with circular pole index been analyzed in detail. Furthermore, the effective PID fault tolerant controller design process with consistent poles and H∞ performance indices is illustrated by a simulation example.

articleTitle: Power allocation for cyclic prefixed single carrier relaying system with CDD
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In this paper, we consider a cyclic prefixed single-carrier (CPSC) relaying scheme for wireless relay systems over frequency selective fading channels. At the source node, a CP is inserted to combat the inter-symbol interference (ISI). Each relay amplifies the received signal after CP removal and a cyclic delay (CD) is introduced to improve the system performance. With the CP and the cyclic delay, the multiple relay channels are combined into a multipath fading channel. As a result, low complexity frequency domain equalizers, such as minimum mean square error (MMSE) equalizer, can be used to recover the transmit signal. We analyze the output signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of the proposed cyclic prefixed single-carrier relaying with cyclic delay diversity (CP-SCCDD) and frequency domain MMSE equalization. Under a system power constraint, we also investigate the power allocation among the source and the relays to improve the system performance. Finally, extensive numerical results are provided to show the frame error rate (FER) performance of the CP-SC-CDD scheme.

articleTitle: A kind of new data processing method suited to the GM (1, 1) model
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In this paper, we analyze the data transformation given in the literature [8] and the methods to evaluate its parameter proposed in the literature [9], and point out it can't be suitable to the sequence whose class ratio sequence is unstable and has the increasing or decreasing trend obviously. According to the variation trend of the class ratio sequence of the original sequence, this paper proposes a kind of new data processing method, taking into account the class ratio monotone decreasing or increasing trend. The parameters in the new data transformation are evaluated by the least deviation of class ratio. Examples show that the new method is feasible and efficient.

articleTitle: The design of an eight-digit Fibonacci sequence generator
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper presents a field programmable gate array (FPGA) prototype of an 8-digit Fibonacci sequence generator. The design is based on the Verilog hardware description language, synthesized by the Xilinx Synthesis Technology (XST) synthesizer, and implemented with the ISE design flow. The circuit was tested to run on the Spartan-3E Starter Kit Board. The resource utilization and the test results are reported. The design itself can be an independent tool or a small device in a bigger system.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation and characteristics prediction on unsteady two-phase flow of hydraulic retarder
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In order to completely understand the real flow condition in a hydraulic retarder, sliding mesh method of multi-flow regions numerical caculation and mixture model were used to simulate the transit flow, and the change of internal flow field structure and the volume distribution of the two-phase flow under different filling rate were obtained. The external characteristics of the hydraulic retarder was calculated. The simulation results were well matched with the test data, which showed the accuracy of numerical calculation method and would greatly contribute to designing the hydraulic retarder and optimizing its structure.

articleTitle: Object manipulation of a 4 degree ARM of robot based on visual feedforward and visual feedback
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In order to realize the robot's grasping operation, the paper presents a grasping strategy which is based visual feedforward and Visual feedback. By using visual feedforward, the robot hand can achieve preliminary location that is based a new inverse kinematics algorithm. Besides, visual feedback can compensate the error which is between hand and target. The combination of the two control algorithms can simplify the robot's grasping operation, and the experiment demonstrates the algorithms' correctness and feasibility.

articleTitle: An asymptotic distribution of a specific beta distribution
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The asymptotic distribution of the Beta distribution is studied by means of decomposing the Beta distribution properly and the classical analysis is truncation method. It is proved that the asymptotic distribution of the Beta distribution is normal distribution when the two parameters a and b of the Beta distribution are all positive members and a over a + b → α, where a,b → ∞, 0 < α < 1.

articleTitle: Synchronization control based on the feedback linearization decoupling of the typical multi-cylinder precise forging hydraulic press
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The study of the typical multi-cylinder precise forging hydraulic press (TMPFHP) has widespread significance to solve problems of the control of many multi-cylinder precise forging hydraulic presses. Aimed at the characteristics of the affine nonlinear dynamic model of the system, a synchronization control method based on the feedback linearization decoupling is given to achieve a high accuracy of the system. The result of the system simulation shows that the method is very valid.

Author Keywords: Typical multi-cylinder precise forging hydraulic press (TMPFHP)

articleTitle: A petri-net based approach for flexible manufacturing system modeling
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Flexible manufacturing system (FMS) is a typical discrete event dynamic systems (DEDS) and Petri-Net has been widely used in the field of modeling a FMS because of its intrinsic features. In this paper, the Petri-net modeling approach is firstly introduced. A model of FMS is created by using Timed Petri nets; the algorithm is discussed based a job needs of FMS with 3 resources and 3 jobs. The analysis results show the constructed model and presented algorithm can solve the designing of scheduling problems of FMS effectively and practically.

articleTitle: Estimation of lateral track irregularity based on an unknown input identification filter
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In this paper, we consider the railway lateral track irregularity estimation issue based on an unknown input identification filter. The lateral track irregularity is closely related to the lateral displacement of the wheelset. The measurements for the truck irregularity are the lateral acceleration and the yaw rate of the bogie and the lateral acceleration of the vehicle body. The effectiveness of the proposed approach is demonstrated by simulation results.

articleTitle: Prediction of aircraft vibration environment based on support vector machines with particle swarm optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low generalization capacity in predicting the vibration environment of the aircraft platform, a new predicting model combined particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm with support vector machine (SVM) is put forward. In the model, PSO is used to determine parameters of penalty factor, loss function and kernel function of support vector machine. The optimized SVM model can solve the practical problems such as small samples, nonlinear and partial infinitesimal. The engineering analysis results show that the SVM model has better predicting performance than the BP model, which proves that the SVM predicting model is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Iterative learning control for voice coil motor XY motion platform
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Iterative learning control (ILC) is an effective control tool to reduce systematic errors of the system that perform repetitive tasks. In this paper, based on the voice coil motor XY motion platform, we design a filter type ILC feedforward and feedback control structure to insure the robust stability and the tracking performance of the motion system. In the design of the control system, the concept like double closed loop control and zero phase error tracking control algorithm are being used. Both simulations and experiments show that with this control structure, a better dynamic and static performance is obtained, i.e., the maximum acceleration of the system up to 5g, maximum speed of 0.8m/s, after 4 times iterative learning, trajectory tracking error can be reduced to 0.003mm, High speed and high precision point to point control is realized. So ILC can be widely used in the field of motion system, especially for IC package, that repeatedly perform the same movement.

articleTitle: Application of multi-objective optimization based on the integration of linear physical programming within collaborative optimization
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The problems in the practical engineering design of large-scale complex systems always contain multiply optimal objectives and several smaller functional units (subsystems). Aiming at the multiple problems and conflicting objectives in Multidisciplinary design optimization (MDO), this paper describes the integration of Advanced Linear Physical Programming within Collaborative Optimization framework for designers to formulate concurrently and conveniently. The proposed framework would enable designers to formulate multiple system-level objectives in terms of physically meaningful parameters, and would hierarchically decompose the multilevel system into several small and more manageable subsystems for saving computational cost. A mathematical example using MDO application demonstrated the proposed framework in this paper.

articleTitle: Layered design and simulation of TD-SCDMA system based on BBU+RRU
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In this paper, the method of layered design is used to build a TD-SCDMA system simulation platform, and the ray tracing is used to establish a deterministic model in real scene. The simulation scene is a high-rise residential area, and is modeled by importing existing network data and latitude and longitude map. Technologies of N-frequency networking and BBU + RRU are also applied in this simulation platform, in the end some Key Performance Indicators in TD-SCDMA system are calculated and analyzed.

articleTitle: Sound classification based on modified log energy for digital hearing aids
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: An sound classification algorithm based on minimum distance clustering using modified log energy as features is presented. This system attempts to distinguish between three listening environment categories: traffic noise, babble noise, and quiet environment. Each sound source is assigned one codebook area beforehand. The decision-making is based on the distribution ratios of feature vectors falling into each codebook area. The feature group used in this system is compared to another two feature groups, a common cepstral feature group and mel-frequency cepstral coefficients (MFCCs), with the same classification method. The classifier using the modified log energy is superior to those using the other two feature groups in overall hit rate and the mean squared error between the classifier output and the correct output. Compared to MFCCs, the modified log energy set reduces computational burden of the whole system.
