articleTitle: Illumination compensation method for unevenly lighted document segmentation
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper presents a new method for binarizing unevenly lighted document images. An illumination compensation algorithm is proposed to convert the unevenly lighted document to an evenly lighted document. The compensated image is then binarized by applying an improved locally adaptive approach. The method effectively overcomes the difficulty in handling uneven lighting and enhances segmentation quality considerably.

articleTitle: A level set image segmentation method using prior region information
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Image Segmentation is a promising technology and very important for image retrieval, target tracking and image analysis applications. The existing region-based level set image segmentation methods which obey a criterion of maximizing the statistic distance of sub-region are mostly on the assumption of dimidiate image, often leading to unsatisfied segmentation results. In order to overcome this deficiency, this paper presents a novel level set image segmentation method using prior region information to improve the segment accuracy. The paper firstly introduces how the prior information is adopted into curve evolution energy function. Then the associated Euler-Lagrange equation which is the most important step is deduced. Finally, the implementation details for the proposed novel method are presented. Extensive experimental results show that the novel level set image segmentation method using prior region information presented in this paper has achieved higher accuracy compared with existing methods.

articleTitle: A method for intelligently selecting minimum break point set(MBPS) from multi-MBPS with the same cardinal number considering node electric betweenness
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The minimum break point set(MBPS) is the starting point of complex and ring network setting coordination, which always has so many sets that it needs to select a set of best MBPS. This paper considers the actual utilization for load flow to node and nodes' impact on the vulnerability of breakpoint relay protections, then takes node electric betweenness as measuring indicator of relay's vulnerability and proposes a method for selecting optimum MBPS from many sets of MBPS. Compared with the existing method, the indicator is more in line with flowing characteristics of load flow and actual occupancy for load flow to node, and selected MBPS is more appropriate. Finally, the effectiveness and rationality is proved with an example of simulation.

articleTitle: The design of model reference adaptive control
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The adaptive control technique based on the Lyapunov stability theorem is used widely, which is the model reference adaptive control (MRAC). Based on the MRAC method, an adaptive feed-forward controller was designed to decrease the error. The simulation was made by Matlab. The simulation result shows that it can achieve good control effect even if the parameter of controlled objects changed in large scale. When controlled objects changes from linear time-invariant system into nonlinear time-variant system, it can still obtain better control effect.

articleTitle: The design of temperature acquisition node in Wireless Sensor Net based on the Communication Protocol of HART
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In this paper, taking thermocouple as an example, the Design of a kind of new Low-power Wireless Sensor Node Based on The Communication Protocol of HART6.1 is presented. It builds the temperature measuring circuit of thermoelectric couple by analyzing the relationship between the output of the sensor and the input of the measurement module. It compensates the temperature in the way of measuring the inner temperature of MSP430F149, and improves the measurement precision in the process of software development. To realize the data transmission and display, wirelessly and in real time, the Protocol for the Communication between WIA wireless module and bottom data sampling unit is designed based on the Protocol framework of HART6.1. The experiment shows that this kind of wireless sensor node features the following characteristics, the stable and credible communication quality, low-power and high precision.

articleTitle: Constructing a real symmetric Toeplitz matrix with two prescribed eigenpairs
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper is concerned with the inverse eigenvalue problems for symmetric Toeplitz matrices. A kind of inverse problem for constructing a real symmetric Toeplitz matrix from the given k eigenpairs is proposed. By using the special structure of symmetric Toeplitz matrices, the Kronecker product and the vec operator of matrices, the problem is transformed into the system of linear equations. Some necessary and sufficient conditions for the solvability of the problem are given. The general solutions of the problem are presented.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation on semi-dry flue gas purification of MSW incineration
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper presents the numerical simulation about spray dry purification flue gas of municipal solid wastes (MSW) incineration. The fluent software package, κ-ε RNG turbulence model and the stochastic model of the track was chosen to do this work; the research on the flow field characteristics by increasing flow equalization board was carried out. The paper mainly studied the effect for flow characteristics, resistance and coefficient of droplet adhering on the wall. The simulation results are as follows: there was a significant asymmetry of opposite inlet side of the inlet velocity greater than the velocity side without the flow equalization board. The resistance decreases gradually with increasing of the flow equalization board opening diameter. And the coefficient of droplet adhering on the wall firstly increased and then decreased.

articleTitle: Control of gearshifts on dual-clutch transmissions during the inertia phase
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In order to improve shift quality of vehicles equipped with a DCT, using backstepping technique, a nonlinear controller is designed here for gearshifts during the inertia phase. Closed-loop control of clutch slip is carried out during the controller design. Furthermore, complex nonlinear characteristics from engine systems are represented by lookup tables. And these tables with their original form will be used in the proposed nonlinear controller. In the end, shift processes are simulated by the AMESim powertrain simulation model under various operation conditions to test the effectiveness of the designed controller.

articleTitle: Obstacle avoidance algorithm of moving objects based on humanoid strategy
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Avoidance is an important part of artificial intelligence research. It has a broad application both in the robot research and in game obstacle avoidance. This paper analyzes the game obstacle avoidance algorithm, proposes humanoid avoidance algorithm, establishs a communication type and a learning type model of obstacle avoidance algorithm, personifies a simple simulation to test and get the enhanced performance.

articleTitle: An auto-focus algorithm based on image processing
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: A coarse and fine combined fast search and auto-focusing algorithm was suggested in this paper.This method can automatically search and find the focal plane by evaluating the image definition. The Krisch operator based edge energy function was used as the big-step coarse focusing, and then the wavelet transform based image definition evaluation function, which is sensitivity to the variation in image definition, was used to realize the small-step fine focusing in a narrow range. The using of the TMS320DM642 digital signal processing chip as the platform of the focusing mechanism realized the application of the digital image processing based auto-focusing method in the optical measure equipment in range. The experimental results indicate that this algorithm can realize the image real-time focusing of the optical measure equipment, and the accuracy of this focusing system is ± 0.02 mm.

articleTitle: An entity-based method for XML keyword search
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Keyword search is a user-friendly way to query XML data. The basic problem of XML keyword search is how to define a valid query semantic. We observe that entity is an important concept for returning meaningful information in database queries. In this paper, we consider an XML document as a set of entities. By considering entity as the basic semantic unit, we propose a new semantic, Smallest Lowest Common Entity Ancestor (SLCEA) semantic to answer keyword search over XML documents. A SLECA node in an XML document represents complete information unit of the real world, it solves the problem with result not completely and meaningless. Besides the semantic, we also design two efficient algorithms to compute LCEA Set and SLCEA Set. By analyzing the semantic relationship among entity, property and value during keyword query processing, our approach significantly improves the search quality over XML documents. Finally, by according to different evaluation standard, we demonstrate effectiveness of our approach in the three different data sets.

articleTitle: Research on key technologies in automatic target-reporting
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Target-reporting system used in automatic weapons shooting training is based on dual-electrode design of the projectile through the short-circuit principle at present. After several research found, the target-reporting system now reported has missing report and other issues of false positives almost of all system, and round pistol bullets have a higher missing report rate. The causes from projectile, bullet holes, target, and other aspects of the signal is discussed and designed a complete program and high-speed signal extraction circuit, the final live-fire tests proved to solve the automatic target-reporting system omissions and misstatements of the problem.

articleTitle: A portfolio optimization model based on structural classification
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: We structured classified the securities and portfolio optimization from different particles, and established the portfolio optimization model based on structural classification which can take the industry factors into consideration when making investment decisions. With the structured model, we can optimize the selection of different types of assets and control the number of assets in the portfolio. We select the actual stock market historical data for empirical analysis and compare the result of our model with the one of the mean-variance model. The experimental results show the effectiveness of our model.

articleTitle: Evaluating target discovery rate of AUV system
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The target discovery rate of AUV (Autonomous Underwater Vehicle) system is one of the most important attributes of operational effectiveness. Evaluating the attribute requires a big sample size. It not only takes a long time, but also costs much. In order to solve these problems, the statistical test method for the target discovery rate of AUV system is adopted, based on the operational principle of AUV system and the mathematical model of projection and guidance. The target discovery rate is calculated based on test data and simulation test. The method makes full of test data during simulation, thus can effectively measure the target discovery rate at a small sample size.

articleTitle: Research on routing algorithm based on energy threshold in wirsless sensor network
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Wireless sensor network nodes have the drawbacks such as limited energy and poor processing ability. This paper presents two algorithms, i.e. heap-optimized shortest path algorithm and bidirectional shortest path algorithm to overcome above drawbacks. These two algorithms can improve routing efficiency, extend network lifetime and reduce network congestion by optimizing the selection of unmarked nodes and by introducing the node energy threshold E<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">min</inf>. This paper analyzes the principle and the implementation process of these two algorithms, and compares their routing efficiency with traditional algorithm via experiment. At last, the paper summarizes the advantages and applications of both algorithms.

articleTitle: Vibration analysis of automatic rotor spinner based on virtual prototype
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: There are mainly three types of spinner using in the modern textile industry: ring spinner, rotor spinner and vortex flow spinner. As the key technique of automatic rotor spinner, the whole procedure of automatic spinning can be represented by the automatic piecing vehicle, which can also represent the quality of positioning and piecing. There is vibration during positioning and piecing, which would bring the harm into the system. To analyse the vibration brought into the automatic rotor spinner, the virtual prototype should be built; while, the system is systematically described at first. The key part resulting in system vibration is the automatic piecing vehicle. The system is simplified by the structural characteristics; thus, the simulating model of virtual prototype is built. When the vehicle is decelerated to stop during the practical and improved operation, the vibration will be transferred from the vehicle itself to the entity, which can be calculated and compared in the simulation model. The results of simulation and comparison are shown that the main oscillating sources is the vehicle decelerating; furthermore, to decrease the system vibration, it is effective for the vehicle to decelerate the system with a even and smooth curves of retarded motion.

articleTitle: Proactive intrusion detection model based on autonomic computing
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: To explore the passive detecting mechanism of traditional intrusion detection system, based on autonomic computing, an autonomic proactive intrusion detection model is proposed in this paper. Centered on an autonomic manager, this model introduces an auction mechanism in the agent coordination layer to perceive environmental changes, to manage and allocate resources, and to achieve active intrusion response. Experimental results show that through rational parameter configuration, the model can effectively improve adaptability and detection accuracy of IDS.

articleTitle: Assemblability evaluation method of ship block based on fuzzy neural network
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The deficiency of assemblability evaluation method using traditional mathematical models is discussed in this paper. According to the characteristics of artificial neural network, it is proposed that artificial neural network can be used to evaluate the assemblability, and its implementation have been studied. The characteristics and laws of ship block building are analyzed firstly, and then the evaluation model of ship block assemblability is established. The evaluation result of ship assembly time and cost can be obtained using the evaluation model mentioned above.

articleTitle: Sparse principal component analysis for image in-painting
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Sparse representation, as a powerful statistical image modelling technique, has been proved to be a successful method for image restoration applications. Because of the development of l<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>-minimization, the optimization of sparse representation can be solved efficiently. Intrinsically, natural images are sparse in some domain, and the image quality largely depends on whether the sparse domain can represent the image well. Considering that the contents can vary significantly across different patches in a single image, sparse represented clear patches are employed to replace missing pixel ones. We propose a sparse principal component analysis approach to adaptive learn dictionary (basis) to sparsely represent the image patches for image in-painting. The in-painting problem and dictionary learning process are combined together and easily solved by soft-thresholding and SVD (singular value decomposition) alternatively. The experimental results on image in-painting validate that sparse principal component analysis method achieves much better performance and faster computation comparing to the state-of-the-art dictionary learning algorithms in both RMSE and visual perception.

articleTitle: Impact of missing data on parameter estimation of EM algorithm under exponential distribution
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper analysed is where the abstract should be placed. It should consist of one paragraph and a concise summary of the material discussed in the article below. We wish you success with the preparation of your manuscript.

articleTitle: Spectrum allocation based on interference management in femtocell networks
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In order to mitigate the interference between macrocell mobile stations (mMSs) and femtocells and allocate the spectrum efficiently, a graph coloring based clustering algorithm for channel allocation is proposed in this paper. Under the premise of guaranteeing the SINR requirements of mMSs, the algorithm determines the initial set of subchannels which can be used for each femtocell. Then according to the constructed interference graph of the femtocell networks, each femtocell mobile station(fMS) is allocated all the available spectrum resources dynamically. In this paper, we use an improved cluster algorithm to ensure the SINR of mMSs and maximize the femtocell throughput. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can reduce the outage probability of mMSs as well as improve the total throughput.

articleTitle: A method based on the genetic algorithm of equilibrium traffic assigment problem
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Traffic assignment is one of the primary steps in urban transportation planning process and the theoretical basis for program design in modern transportation planning. This paper based on the network users of the travel time at least as the goal, and took the Matlab simulation software as operation platform, applied Genetic algorithm to the traffic equilibrium distribution model, and then realized the traffic distribution process travel state optimal. A numerical example was given to illustrate the application was effectiveness and feasibility.

articleTitle: Design of control system for a 2-DOF Stabilized Platform
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The Inertial Stabilized Platforms (ISPs) are used for staying stabilization or moving of the view axis of a camera. The paper presents the design of an Inertial Stabilized Platform (ISP) with 2-DOF (Degrees of Freedom). The ISP has no coupling between 2-DOF. Each DOF is driven by a DC-motor with controller based on MCU MB96F346 (Fujitsu). The VG440 Inertial Systems (Crossbow) is employed as the tilt sensor of the platform. Three closed-loop of PID algorithm is used for keeping attitude of the ISP stable. The two controllers for 2-DOF driving can communicate through CAN bus. A PC can be connected to CAN bus to monitor and supervise the controllers. The experiments show that attitude of platform has a good rapidity, accuracy and stability. It is suitable for taking video in a moving vehicle.

articleTitle: A methodology for text classification based on feature clustering
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Recent advances in feature clustering offer a viable alternative for text classification. In this paper, we propose a methodology in which all the terms are clustered based on χ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> measures and only part of the clusters are selected to build the feature space. We also present that, higher precision and recall could be acquired when we select feature clusters base on their average χ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> measure and take CF-IDF to weight the clusters after clustering in comparatively lower cluster size

articleTitle: Design of intelligent concentrator in the power information gathering system
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In the context of smart grid, intelligent concentrator in the power information gathering system has become the development trend. In this paper, The structure and function of the power information gathering system are analyzed, and then it presents hardware design of the concentrator based on DTT6C01B chip. Original Q / GDW 376.1 and 376.2 protocol standard are expanded to realize the functions of data acquisition and control of smart appliances and charge piles. The concentrator supports McWiLL standard for uplink communication and WIA standard for downlink, which can meet the requirements of reliability end high efficiency in the data acquisition. The design of the concentrator provides a good reference design platform for the development of smart power.

articleTitle: The design of process oriented knowledge-based CAD system
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In this paper, the algorithms of process planning based on graph theory and the method of integrating knowledge with design process are discussed, which regulate and simplify the design operation. The process-oriented knowledge-based CAD system is realized which can achieve the automatic modeling and assembling of the main part of a reducer product during process design. By the implementation of combining KBE and process design technology, the design process of a product is managed and becomes more efficient and stable. The research validates the feasibility of process-oriented knowledge-based design method and also sets an example for dealing with complex product process planning problems.

articleTitle: Control over negative effects of vertical vibration on independent steering/driving wheels of an electric vehicle
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: On basis of the structure features owned by the suspension system under the four-wheel independent steering and driving electric car (FWISDEV) designed, the passive suspension model and active suspension model are established. Research shows that: the increasing un-sprung mass has little effect on both of the suspension working space (SWS) and body acceleration(BA), but exert a tremendous influence on the wheel relative dynamic load (WRDL); a reasonable selection of suspension rigidity and damping ratio may better relieve the effects of increasing un-sprung mass on WRDL. The Stochastic Linear-Quadratic Optimal Control-based active suspension, compared with passive suspension designed, may significantly reduce RMS values of WRDL and BA and take into account both of the stability and ride comfort, the performance of which will reach even exceed that as the traditional vehicles show; furthermore, compared with other suspension, active suspension has SWS though enlarged, still within the reasonable designed scope.

articleTitle: On the stability parameters of circular graph C(2n,n)
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In this paper we consider the domination number and bondage number of circular graph. These parameters can use to measure the robustness of an interconnection network with respect to link failures. By finding a minimum dominating sets we can compute the domination number and bondage number of the circular graph.

articleTitle: An energy optimization method for wireless sensor network
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Energy optimization problem in wireless sensor network is related to network utilization and efficiency of information transmission and routing algorithm and it is the core issue of wireless sensor networks. Based on the coronas hierarchical model, this paper, using the Dijkstra shortest path algorithm to calculate the optimal sequence of transmission distance from the source node to the sink node, proposes a dynamic multi-path routing algorithm originated from the energy balance and the minimum energy of the network. In addition, when the nodes transmit information from outer coronas to inner, we use the q-switch algorithm, which allows each node have q types of nodes available to choose one with the maximum energy to keep the balance of the network. When the nodes from a corona run out of energy we can search the remaining distance sequence to achieve the optimal energy of the nodes through the dynamic routing method.

articleTitle: An improved algorithm to determine topological relationship between point and polygon
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: There are defects on analyzing of topological relationship between point and polygon with Ray-algorithm, this paper made use of the different relationship of positions to improve and extend the Ray-algorithm according to the complexity of polygon, and it extended into complex polygon simply and effectively by adding one, adding two and adding three operations. It could analyze of topological relationship between point and polygon accurately, and gave the detailed steps of the algorithm. It shows that the result of experiment, this method was effective to simple and complicated of polygons.

articleTitle: A preemptive priority queue with impatient customers and multiple vacations
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The article established a queue model of a preemptive priority queue with impatient customers and multiple vacations. The first class customers have preemptive priority. Both two-class customers can renege because of impatience. First, we obtain State transition equations. Then we derive the probability distribution of the two-class customers, and respectively calculated the expected number of the two-class customers, the average reneging rate and other queue indices. Finally, we perform analysis by numerical examples.

articleTitle: Expansibility research of service robots communication protocol based on network calculus
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Network calculus has been a widely used theory for the performance analysis of network, especially switched Ethernet. The delay is the most important factor affecting the performance of Ethernet. In this paper, we get the arrival curve and service curve of the switch of each level. And then we derive the recurrence formula between the maximum delay and network scale using the theory of network calculus. After building the tree topology model of Ethernet/ SDARP, which is service robots communication protocol based on switched Ethernet, we calculate its delay by the formula. The simulation result by OPNET proves the accuracy of the formula. It also demonstrates the expansibility of the protocol.

articleTitle: Research on the access of Radio-on-Fiber in power communication
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: With the optical fiber communication and wireless communication technology advantage, Radio-on-Fiber (RoF) technology is a good way to solve the problems of bandwidth flexibility security and the electromagnetic interference, and its related technologies have attracted wide attention. With the construction of the Smart Grid, the bandwidth, stability and access reliability were demanded increasingly. According to the power system communication status and characteristics, transplant the RoF technology reasonably; combine with the advantages of fiber and wireless, will get the broadband and flexible information access, while reducing costs. The structure and application of hybrid RoF broadband access technology in the power system were discussed, and the corresponding performance and function were tested.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis in high voltage breakes based on IRBF neural network
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: According to the questions of Radial Basis Function (RBF) neural network in the mechanical failure diagnose of high voltage breakers, which can extremely affect convergence speed and precision of the RBF neural networks. This paper develops an improved RBF neural network learning algorithm based on immune algorithm. In the algorithm, the input data are regarded as antigens and the compression mapping of antigens as antibodies, i.e., the concealed layer center point, which also avoid network concealed layer center point hard problem. The weights of the output layer are determined by adopting the gradient descent algorithm. Then it imposes discipline good network on the mechanical failure diagnose of high voltage breakers. The simulation results indicate that this method has preferable application value in the mechanical vibration signal of high voltage breakers.

articleTitle: Pyramidal and segment-concurrent acceleration of dark channel prior algorithm
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Dark channel prior algorithm performs excellently in haze removal problem, but it is time consuming. Unlike the computational mathematics based methods, we give image processing ways to accelerate the algorithm. We first use pyramidal method to accelerate the algorithm, but the number of hierarchies could be used is limited, and it will bring roughness and undesired effect. Then the segmentation method is shown in the paper with bad block phenomenon. Additional subjections are used to stitch each segment together. The new algorithm greatly reduces the complexity and allows concurrent computation. By analyzing the Matting Laplacian Matrix, we also give explanation to the phenomena emerged in the experiments.

articleTitle: Application of Solid Edge's second development on the face of foam plastic processing of equal thickness
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This article describes a practical application of surface modeling in secondary development of Solid Edge. Then tests the box's dates, the dates are got from a displacement sensor of laser, and are pretreated. According to the pretreated dates, an entity of the test box is automatically generated to use software of secondary development of Solid Edge. The entity can be used for subsequent NC Programming and NC profiling. This method is a practical one. It can be applied for a processing of equal thickness. The process will be applied to treatment of foam plastic of cabinet surface.

articleTitle: Automatic cutting start-up and shutdown control method of roadheaders
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: To improve control precision of automatic cutting, by analyzing process path, key stages were found out which could give rise to roadway tunnelling direction error and cross section borderline roughness error. Different swing speed control methods of cutting arm were adopted in different stages which were slow start control at the beginning of cutting and slow stop control in each cutting step. Internal displacement sensors were used in driven cylinders of roadheader cutting arm to calculate the space position of cutting head and reflect swing speed of cutting arm. The method has been tested and verified on EBZ200 roadheader. The results indicate that slow start of automatic cutting could reduce vibration and prevent the change of machine body position and orientation; slow stop could reduce the control delay and improve roadway borderline precision.

articleTitle: Magnetic field stability analysis of two pairs of coil systems based on differential evolution algorithm
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The installation error produced during the arrangement of coil system has important influences on the uniformity of magnetic fields in the desired area. It has been the very considerable difficulty encountered in the past in attempting the numerical solution of the equations involved, especially a region under coil systems, and little study related the installation error was discussed. The paper considers the deviation degree of uniform magnetic field of the region given as the objective function and uses differential evolution algorithm to search the deviation range of coil systems parameters given to make the objective function reach the optimum. The result shows that the problem of research the variation of magnetic fields uniform degree caused by the arrangement error of rectangle coil systems can be solved effectively with differential evolution algorithm.

articleTitle: Implementation of a progressive target recognition system for all the angles
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: 3D target recognition is a popular research field in the laser near-field detection, where the scan image of the target is obtained line by line. The arbitrary spatial position between the detector and the target, along with the interference caused by the clouds, make it difficult to realize accurate real-time identification for the detector. This paper presents a method to generate gray-scale plane images under any viewpoint by calculating the echo signals from the surface of 3D planes. Besides, considering both scan imaging and signal processing in hardware, a local feature based on improved and simplified SURF algorithm is implemented in hardware to describe the target. Then a progressive 3D target recognition system is built on the FPGA, and the experiments performed on the Modelsim simulation software show that the system can reach a high recognition rate.

articleTitle: Stability analysis of nonlinear fractional neutral differential equations with multiple variable time delays
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: We study the stability of nonlinear fractional neutral differential equations with multiple variable time delays in this paper. Some results of the practical and finite-time stability are stretched to the nonlinear fractional neutral differential equations with multiple variable time delays system. Some conditions of the theory of this stability are obtained for the nonlinear fractional neutral differential equations with multiple variable time delays. Finally, an example is given to present the result.

articleTitle: Design of distributed marine AIS communication mechanism and integrated monitoring platform
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Automatic Identification System is an automated tracking system used on ships and by Vessel Traffic Services for identifying and locating vessels. Nowadays it is an important navigational aid for preventing collisions at sea. In this paper, we designed and developed a monitoring platform for distributed shipboard AIS based on the ARM microprocessor S3C44B0X and embedded real-time μC/OS-II operating system. And we also achieved the implementation of GIS function using Visual C++ combined with MapX on host computer.

articleTitle: Optimal relay station location design under low-rank line of sight environment
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In the low-rank line of sight(LOS) environment, in order to obtain the best system capacity of multiple-input multiple-output(MIMO) relay system, the location of relay station (RS) should be designed carefully. According to the characteristic of the RS system in low-rank LOS environment, a new genetic algorithm is proposed to design the RS location. Genetic algorithm is a parallel and efficient global optimization algorithm, but it is too sensitive to the mutation and crossover probability, and there is no unified convergence condition for ending which leads to prematurity and slow convergence. In this paper, the fixed mutation and crossover probability is improved, and the simulation results show that the improved genetic algorithm speeds up the convergence rate and avoids the local convergence.

Author Keywords: LOS Genetic Algorithm MIMO Relay Station Low-Rank

articleTitle: Research on the flight coverage of near-space hypersonic vehicle
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Near-space hypersonic vehicle which is rocket assisted to the apogee then unpowered return, gliding between 70km to 25km for a long distance. The flight coverage of near-space hypersonic vehicle has great value in overall design and control system design. This article will change the fight coverage into the trajectory planning in typical direction. And quasi-equilibrium glide trajectory will be divided into two stages: maneuverability glide phase and straight glide phase. In the first phase, the vehicle rolls in a constant large roll angle, and then rolls in reverse direction under a certain altitude, until the terminal position and heading are coincidence with the reference flight path. In the second phase, the trajectory planning is based on the method of dynamic pressure profiles. The simulation results shows the flight coverage of near-space hypersonic vehicle.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis of rolling bearing based on multi sensor information fusion
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of rolling bearing fault diagnosis, this paper introduces a multi-sensor information fusion method of diagnosis. After the processing of vibration signal collected with multi-sensor, the particle swarm optimization neural networks is used for local fault diagnosis, to obtain evidence independent of each other, and then using the evidence theory fuses them. Experimental results show that the method can effectively improve the diagnostic reliability and reduce diagnostic uncertainty.

articleTitle: Underground personnel positioning sysyem based on low-power card reader
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In order to achieve effective identification and real-time monitoring of coal mine personnel position, this paper proposed underground personnel positioning system based on low-power card reader. After a brief introduction of the ZigBee and CAN technology on basis of the features, it described the design elements of the hardware and software of low-power card reader.

articleTitle: Iris imaging system design based on PC
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The iris recognition technology gets rapid development with advantages such as high precision, non-invasive and etc. It is widely considered as one of the most promising biological certification technologies. The iris image acquisition is the key technology and gets more attention. This paper introduces a kind of iris imaging system based on PC. The system uses Micro Controller Unit (MCU) to control light source and ranging module and uses buzzer to indicate the distance between the user and the system. All these can improve the conveniency of the Man-machine interactive. Experiments show that this design method can get the high quality iris images, and enhances the usability of the system‥

articleTitle: Design of a universal home gateway for intelligence appliance interoperability
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In this paper, a universal home gateway software architecture for both IP-based and non-IP intelligent appliances is designed. Firstly, the software architecture is presented. And then the components and the main functionalities of the software are described. Finally, the software running results are verified by experiments and prove that the universal home gateway proposed can support the “plug and play” and interoperability of intelligence appliance.

articleTitle: Consensus of second-order multi-agent systems with general topology
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In this paper, we address the consensus of second-order multi-agent dynamical system. We also build a second-order multi-agent model with a general topology. We can obtain a special condition to ensure the consensus of the second-order system. Introducing the Laplace transform, we can have the consensus of the system. Moreover, we obtain the accurate solution of the system. Finally, numerical simulations are presented to verify the theoretical results.

articleTitle: Control design for stochastic continuous T-S model based systems
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper focuses on controller design for a class of stochastic continuous T-S nonlinear systems. Motivated by variable gradient method, an integral Lyapunov function is introduced to establish the stability conditions of the stochastic continuous T-S nonlinear systems. By introducing additional matrix variables and applying a cone complementarity-like technique, the established stability conditions can be employed for controller design. It has proven that this control design problem can be solved as a quadratic programming problem.

articleTitle: Research on internet of things of environment monitoring based on cloud computing
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Environment monitoring is the foundation of environment plan and environment protection. It has huge works, complicate and extensive sources, and need a lot of investments to do, and is difficult to perform monitoring at 24 hours every day periodically. To resolve the problem, a architecture of the internet of things of environment monitoring based on cloud computing is proposed, and a creative model named as Unified Layered Model is proposed, which combines wireless sensor network, GPS, WiFi, 3G communication, database, cloud storage, cloud computing, data mining, and service computing mode, etc. The model aims at collect and management environment monitoring data and related data, provides in time, online or offline, parallel, distributed, cross time and space environment quality monitoring, feedback and control functions.

articleTitle: Research on land-use automatical classification based on HJ -1 satellite data
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Based on the calibrated HJ-1 satellite images, Dark pixel method was used to do the atmospheric correction, then applying the pre-processing of the CCD data of HJ-1 satellite to the quantitative inversion model. Acquired four kinds of surface features index: Normalized Difference Vegetation Index, Land Surface Temperature, Vegetation Coverage Index, Normalized Difference Water Index, based on these indicators, extracted the six feature types and achieved the automatic classification of land-use.

articleTitle: Hybrid fault diagnosis based on model-based and case-based reasoning method
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Model-Based diagnosis describing internal structure and behavior of a system is deep knowledge which can obtain the diagnosis knowledge easily, but the large amount of calculation is its disadvantage. Case-based reasoning diagnosis relies on historical experience and the diagnostic efficiency is relatively high, but knowledge acquisition is the bottleneck. Therefore, according to the advantages and disadvantages of the two methods, this paper proposes using the model-based approach to achieve the case knowledge acquisition, and then complete the process of fault diagnosis by case-based reasoning. This approach which can improve the diagnosis efficiency not only learned the advantages of high accuracy and avoided the difficult problem of knowledge acquisition but also inherited the high-speed characteristics of case-based reasoning.

articleTitle: Spatial patterns analysis of urban road traffic accidents based on GIS
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: It is of vital importance to analyze road traffic accidents in order to improve traffic security management. Based on spatio-temporal analysis method, this paper aims to analyze traffic accidents data in time and space. Road traffic accident locations are usually described by geospatial coordinates, which can be mapped on road segments. Nevertheless, sometimes many traffic accidents locations were described by semantic data. Coordinates' information has to be decoded from the semantic data before they are mapped on road segments. The paper firstly presents a solution to extract fuzzy locations from traffic accidents data. Secondly, this paper presents a spatio-temporal analysis method based on kernel density estimation (KDE) to extract the patterns of traffic accidents, namely, times, locations. Finally the traffic accident data of Beijing area are applied to test the feasibilities of the presented methods. The initial studies show that spatio-temporal analysis methods presented in this paper provide a powerful tool for the analysis of road traffic accidents.

articleTitle: Identification and compensation of systems with hysteresis such as functional electrical stimulation
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Functional electrical stimulation (FES) is a medical technology that uses electrical currents to activate nerves innervating extremities affected by paralysis resulting from spinal cord injury (SCI), head injury, stroke and other neurological disorders. FES is used to restore function in people with disabilities. In many case, the electrical currents stimulate nerves through surface electrodes pasted on skins near the nerves. It is reported that strong nonlinearity such as hysteresis exists in FES system from electrical stimulations to joint angles. This paper proposes a new identification and compensation method for a nonlinear FES model from electrical stimulations to joint angle.

articleTitle: Quantitative identification of broken wire for steel rope based on BP neural network
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: To counter the problem in quantitive identification of broken wire for steel rope, a BP neural network model was set up by using Matlab in the article. According to the simulative and real detection data, its features of reliability and usability were proved.

articleTitle: The establishment and application of Cantonese/Mandarin semantic relevant database for search engine
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In the existing commercial search engines, the retrieval precision of Cantonese keyword is very low, which cannot meet users' demand. This paper improves machine translation techniques in Cross-Language Information Retrieval. It introduces Cantonese/Mandarin Semantic Relevant Database that's characteristic of Self-learning Artificial Intelligence and then puts forward a search engine model based on this database. Experimental results show that the search engine model based on Cantonese / Mandarin semantic relevant database is much more superior to the traditional search techniques in the Cantonese search. The search engine model greatly improves the retrieval precision of Cantonese keywords while not affecting the performance of existing search engines.

articleTitle: Design of real-time distributed system using DDS
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Data-centric design is a modern method for building advanced real-time distributed system. DDS (Data Distribution Service) is an API specification and an interoperable wire-protocol that defines a data-centric publish-subscribe architecture for connecting the anonymous information providers with the information consumers. The DDS APIs also allow data providers and consumers to present type-safe programming interfaces which are well suited for data-critical real-time distributed systems and QoS-enabled applications. The goal idea of this paper is to present a kind of real-time distributed system based on DDS and a general design of high level API which abstract the publish-subscribe process.

articleTitle: Cooperative wideband spectrum detection based on Maximum Likelihood Ratio for cognitive VANET
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Centralized cognitive Vehicular Ad Hoc Network (VANET) is a special VANET of vehicle-to-roadside (V2R) network that each vehicle could explore local spectrum gap and a central controller coordinates the spectrum for cognitive vehicles to realize dynamic spectrum access (DSA). In this paper, Maximum Likelihood Ratio (MLR) detection is proposed as the effective scheme for wideband spectrum detection in multi-carrier modulation based centralized cognitive VANET. Hard fusion process is implemented at central controller to make final decision by means of the combination of each vehicle's local sensing result with special rules. Meanwhile, robust cooperative sensing technique is investigated with the consideration of sensing channel SNR and reporting channel error rate. Simulation results are presented to confirm our theoretical derivations. It is revealed that, compared with energy detection (ED), cooperative wideband spectrum detection with MLR scheme has adaptive features. It is available to adaptive robust cooperative sensing with dynamic threshold variations for centralized cognitive VANET.

articleTitle: Data acquisition system design of bridge rubber bearing test machine on ARM9
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Considering the real-time and stability for data acquisition in bridge rubber bearing test machine, the hardware platform used em9260 core board and Constructed the Embedded data acquisition system based on ARM9 With dialgauge, load sensors, data acquisition cards and other hardware. The system of the structure is discussed in the Article, which presents the External hardware circuit and the flow chart of the embedded system control software and PC control software. After a series of actual tests, it is proved that the system is reasonable, and the system works stably. It achieves the design requirements.

articleTitle: Experimental study on infrared changes in the progressive failure and stress distribution of bolted roadway
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The thermal infrared (TIR) radiation in the deformation and progressive failure of coal roadway and the mechanism of thermo-mechanical coupling were investigated. The experimental achievement showed that the surface TIR temperature (TIRT) rose non-uniformly with the load increase before the stress peak and TIR radiation caused by stress concentration, shear band and bolted area, was much stronger and higher than that caused by stress relaxation, week friction and tensile fracturing. The bolted ranges were determined from the change ratios of TIR temperature of the different areas of the bolted surrounding rocks. The infrared thermal image anomaly appeared with the macro-cracks development in the progressive failure of bolted roadways, which reflected the spatial and temporal features of infrared precursor respectively. The infrared thermal image precursors were classified as TIRT increment region and TIRT constant region to disclosure the damage evolution and localization behaviours of bolted roadways.

articleTitle: A small-scale wireless transmission network attached to large-scale seismic acquisition and recording system
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Large-scale Seismic Acquisition and Recording System (LSARS) is one of the most important equipments in geological exploration. This paper describes a LSARS which contains both wired and wireless nodes. Wired node as the center, with a number of wireless nodes arranged around it, a small wireless transmission network is formed. A hierarchical network structure and a flooding algorithm with direction are designed and implemented for the wireless transmission network. Experimental tests show that the wireless transmission network can meet the requirements of the system.

articleTitle: Developing a power wireless private network based on TD-LTE technology for intelligent distribution networks
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: With the development of smart grid, the requirements of high speed, low delay and better coverage have motivated the need to a power wireless broadband private network that bridge the communication gap between the transmission network systems and the customers. In this paper, we give a general overview of studies on the major parameters in the distribution network communication system, and propose a new electric power wireless communication network of TD-LTE230 as well. The TD-LTE230 system is designed based on TD-LTE, and rebuilds its physical layer at 230MHz. the traditional spectrum for electric power system. A TD-LTE230 system has been deployed at Haiyan, Zhejiang province. After a year of stable operation, it has proved that as a good communication resolve scheme, TD-LTE230 system resolves the problems of wide coverage and too many measured points in the intelligent distribution network.

articleTitle: A new context-adaptive variable-length cdoing architecture
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In this paper a new context-based adaptive variable length coding (CAVLC) architecture proposed particularly aims to be implemented with Field Programmable Logics. The architecture is composed of a macro-pipeline formed by three stages. In the first stage, all coefficients are scanned and syntactic element “level” is encoded partially if needed. All the syntactic elements which had not been finished will be encoded in stage 2. At last, all the encoded syntactic elements will be assembled. The proposed design needs only 9 cycles to encode a 4×4 luma block in the worst case and is capable of processing 1080p@66.6 HDTV video streams coded in YCbCr 4∶2∶0, when it is implemented with a low-cost FPGA.

articleTitle: Realization of tags based intelligent algorithm for thesis topic assignment
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In the whole process of undergraduate thesis instruction and management system, thesis topic selection and assignment is a very important module. Based on the analysis of traditional graduation thesis management system of the topic assignment, proposes a tag based thesis assignment intelligent assignment algorithm. This algorithm can matching student's topic voluntary tags and teachers professional tags for two-way intelligent matching, and automatically finish their thesis topic assignment, better overcome traditional artificial two-way selection problem which have many trivial the steps.

articleTitle: The interpretation and credibility analysis of the precipitation data from the shared forecasts database
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The precipitation is a very important input in the traditional hydrological model and at the same time caused the uncertainty of the land surface model. Due to the heterogeneity existed in time and space, plus the simplexes of traditional methods and the insufficient of precipitation measurement technology, the observed precipitation data restricts the applications of the distributed model in simulation and forecasting to a certain extent. With the recent development of measurements and network technology, the meteorological forecasting has become a friendly-accessed, real-time system which can obtain an extended coverage of the land resources. However, the credibility, accuracy and practicability of the interpreted precipitation data needs to be further observed. Through the image processing, the resources were interpreted into the precipitation data which were compared with the measured rainfall values. Then based on the behavior of the hydrological-forecast resources, the method of credence test was selected, and a reliability analysis was conducted from the aspects of point and side. This paper proves that the method of obtaining point precipitation through the network access has a comparatively low precision, but the simulation of precipitation with measured data in temporal and spatial distribution is well established, which can be used as a supplement to the measured precipitation. So the hydrological-forecast resources mentioned above can be applied to the traditional hydrological model, which will greatly impact the study of precipitation in the temporal and spatial distribution, and improves the precision of the hydrological-forecasting

articleTitle: Dendritic cell algorithm for web server aging detection
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Web server aging refers to the phenomenon that web servers show progressive performance degradation after long-time continuous execution. Traditionally, analysis and detection of web server aging have been restricted by the nondeterministic nature. The immune-inspired negative selection algorithm (NSA) succeeds in detecting novel aging without aging samples, because of its adaptive and learning features. However, the NAS generates more false positives (FP) due to the crisp separation between self and non-self. As a hotspot method of artificial immune systems, dendritic cell algorithm (DCA) improves the NSA to some extent owing to its low FP rate and quick action characteristics. This paper proposed a method to apply the dendritic cell algorithm to detect and analyze web server aging. As a novel algorithm inspired by both theoretical immunology and observed immune principles and models, DCA would be a beneficial method to improve the quality of service in web server systems.

articleTitle: A survey on trusted cloud software development
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Cloud software application, which is implemented in SaaS model, is like the soul of the cloud computing. The trustworthiness is the key of success for cloud computing to some extend. In this paper, we summarize the methods for trust management from design to execution.

articleTitle: Synthesis of generalized linear quantum stochastic systems via quantum feedback networks
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The aim of this paper is to contribute to a new synthesis algorithm for generalized linear quantum stochastic systems that are usually encountered in linear quantum optics and in phenomenological models of linear quantum circuits. In particular, such a theory will enable the systematic realization of generalized coherent quantum linear stochastic controllers for quantum control. We show how an any generalized linear quantum stochastic system can be synthesized in a systematic way from one degree of freedom generalized open quantum harmonic oscillators.

articleTitle: Multiple model predictive control for oxygen starvation prevention of fuel cell system
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The purpose of this work is to prevent oxygen starvation of fuel cell system with the compressor surge and choke constraints considered. It has been already known that the compressor inertia causes the oxygen excess ratio to drop rapidly when the current drawn out of the fuel cell steps up dramatically. Thus we introduce a load actuator model to extract the load current out of the fuel cell as a performance variable. Then we are able to regulate the input of load actuator not only to smooth the transitions of load current to prevent the oxygen starvation, but also to track the desired current of fuel cell. Moreover, air supply system of fuel cell has strong nonlinear behaviors while working in a wide range. Thus a multiple multivariable model predictive controller has been introduced based on linearized models obtained from the fuel cell's nonlinear model linearized at operation points. The simulation results have demonstrated that the proposed control strategy is effective when applied to the fuel cell's nonlinear system.

articleTitle: Relevance Vector Machine based multi-feature integration for semantic place recogntion
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In order to work in realistic scenarios, it is a desirable feature for autonomous robots to extract semantic concepts from environments. In this paper, A Relevance Vector Machine (RVM) based approach is presented for the task of visual semantic place recognition. The high sparsity and Bayesian property makes this approach capable of obtaining probabilistic confidence estimation, and computationally efficient during the online prediction stage. Meanwhile, in order to take advantage of discriminative powers of different feature descriptors, a multiple kernel technique is introduced in our system, resulting in a very flexible model where arbitrary feature descriptors can be integrated smoothly. In this paper we choose three popular descriptors for our implementation. Experiments carried out on real typical office environment datasets show the feasibility and robustness of our approach.

articleTitle: Parallel computing in genetic algorithm for adaptive array antenna
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper presents how parallel computing could apply into genetic algorithm for adaptive array antenna. There are some constrains in this algorithm that prevent parallel computing to reduce the benefits in time cost. Therefore, instead of using normal model of parallel computing, we apply parallel genetic algorithm for adaptive array antenna to have an interesting result which benefits in the deep NULL.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of flight visual emulator
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Base on the analysis of open source graphics engine OGRE, the means to realize the flight visual emulator was researched and discussed. The thought and method on aircraft module making, flight scene establishing and Real-time flight state realizing were taken out. Through actual application of these ideas, the realization effect which was low-cost, run smoothly and less demanding to computer hardware in the flight visual emulator was obtained.

articleTitle: Indoor antenna location design based on ray tracing model
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: As most of the time mobile devices are used inside buildings, it is of particular interest for mobile network operators to cover indoor areas with their services. In order to reach satisfying indoor coverage, optimal antenna location has to be chose with the aid of coverage prediction. In this paper, ray tracing model and genetic algorithm are used to choose the antenna location, the former computes received power of each grid point, and then the later treats it as the fitness to find the optimal antenna location.

articleTitle: Integrated application of spatial information technologies in atmospheric water vapor retrieval and simulation
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper compares the water vapor retrieved from MODIS with GPS PWV in Kansas State and Oklahoma State of USA between July and August 2009, discovering that the MODIS PWV changes consistently with GPS PWV but is systematically lower than GPS PWV. Based on the significant linear regression relationship of MODIS PWV and GPS PWV, an integrated retrieval model is established, which can be used to improve the retrieval precision of MODIS PWV. Then interpolation models in GIS technology are discussed for water vapor simulation at the time there exist no MODIS data. The research shows that the integrated application of spatial information technologies improves the precision, spatial and temporal resolution of water vapor retrieval.

articleTitle: Fuzzy covering rough set model on dual-universes
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The Model of fuzzy covering rough set on dual-universes is an extension of rough sets in general relation. In this paper, we have first presented several important definitions in which the properties and theorems of fuzzy covering approximation operators are studied. Next, by using the transformation of fuzzy matrix, the threshold value of the parameter is presented to determine whether the fuzzy compatible relation can form a covering or not. Finally, as an application example, we utilize the results to study the model of medical system.

articleTitle: Network resource allocation algorithm optimization based on user's satisfactory level
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Resource allocation in a radio access network is always the essential issue that most network providers need to focus on. Especially in the future networks, with the contradiction between limited radio resource and increasing new services, efficient resource allocation scheme needs to be introduced to satisfy users' QoS demands. In this paper, we focus on optimizing the network bandwidth allocation algorithm based on user's satisfactory level when the radio access network is overloaded with an incapability to satisfy every user's bandwidth requirement. We firstly derive a mathematical quantification of user's satisfactory level, and then develop the summation of each user's satisfactory level as a criterion to evaluate the performance of the resource allocation algorithm. An algorithm that maximizes the summation of each user's satisfactory level is proposed. And the performance of our proposed algorithm is compared with the existing resource allocation algorithm. Results show that our proposed algorithm improves the existing bandwidth allocation algorithm based on user's satisfactory level.

articleTitle: Comparative study of applications of square root raised cosine filter and low pass filter in Digital Down Converter
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Digital Down Converter (DDC) is one of the key technologies in Software Defined Radio (SDR), where a pair of shaping filter and matched filter are required to satisfy the Nuquist up/down sampling condition. Since an appropriate choice of the filter pair affects the DDC performance, this paper studies and compares two kinds of filters, i.e., the square root raised cosine filter (SRRC) and the low pass filter (LPF). The computer simulation is done and the comparison is made in terms of pass-band ripple, stop-band attenuation, inter symbol interference (ISI), and the fix-point bit error rate (BER).

articleTitle: Study on guided projectile ballistic trajectory measurement based on MIMU system
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: An anti-high-g posture measurement system based on MIMU is introduced. Data acquisition and processing modules are mainly introduced in this article. In addition, the software of this anti-high-g posture measurement system is designed. Practical application results show that the design method is workable.

articleTitle: Research of rolling simulation system based on VRML and JavaScript
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Virtual Reality Modeling Language (VRML) is a modeling language which is used to build a model of a real scene or an imaginary three-dimensional world, and it is also a mainstream language for 3D website making on the Internet. Nowadays, rolling simulation system based on virtual reality is an important measure for rolling operation. In traditional virtual rolling scene, mathematical modeling of the rolling mill and simulation of the rolling process are fairly perfect, however, elastic interaction, data feedback and so on in rolling process is underemphasized. In this paper, simulation of the rolling system based on VRML and JavaScript is presented, and the accessing models information in real-time, dynamic control of scene, etc, through JavaScript are realized, based on which, a real interactive rolling system is built on the network.

articleTitle: The Unified Chebyshev polynomial kernel function for support vector regression machine
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Support vector regression machine (SVR) has become a promising tool in many research fields, such as web intelligence, machinery fault diagnostic technique, dynamics environmental forecasting, and earthquake prediction, etc. Kernel method is most important to get more robust and higher generalization ability of SVR. In this paper, a new kernel, named Unified Chebyshev polynomial kernel (UCK), is proposed for SVR. Firstly, a group of new Unified Chebyshev polynomials are constructed using Chebyshev polynomials. Therefore, on the basis of these polynomials, a Unified Chebyshev polynomials kernel is proposed and has been proved satisfying Mercer condition. The simulation results show that UCK can lead to better generalization performance in comparison with other common kernels on many benchmark data sets.

articleTitle: Intelligent condition recognition of transmission line based on digital image processing
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: According to the remote monitoring requirements of smart grid construction, in this paper the condition recognition approach combining digital image processing with artificial neural networks is proposed for transmission lines. The digital image processing methods, including gray scale transformation, histogram modification, wavelet packet denoising and edge detection are used to process the images of transmission lines and make the characteristics more outstanding. After dividing the images into some regions the distribution of edge features of transmission line components is extracted as characteristic values. This method has good adaptability. At last, a three-layer back propagation (BP) artificial neural network (ANN) is constructed and applied recognize the typical transmission line conditions. The result shows that this approach has good recognition rate and popularization.

articleTitle: Effect of bistatic angle on spread of bistatic Bragg lines
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: For a bistatic HF radar, the bistatic angle over a clutter cell is a variable. This will cause the spread of the Bragg lines. A new analytical method is proposed to investigate the effect of the bistatic angle on this kind of spectrum spread: both the receive beam width and range resolution are taken into account together, then the Bragg lines width is calculated. The result shows that this spectrum spread is closely related to the clutter cell's spatial position, and the relationship between them is presented. The measured data of some experiments are analyzed and the results demonstrate that this analysis is reasonable.

articleTitle: Simulation on aircraft generator control system using genetic algorithms
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In this paper, a comprehensive model of cascade brushless doubly-fed aeroplane generator is developed on the analysis of aeroplane generator's structure and the principle of variable speed constant frequency electricity generating. Furthermore, a simulation model of brushless direct current machine derived from this model is established in SIMULINK development environment to verify the validity of the model. In order to overcome the defects of hypo-best PI parameters by conventional method of trial and error, the real-coded genetic algorithms is adopted to optimize the parameters of rotate speed in which the fitness function is considered sufficiently for capturing systemic error and controlled output. The simulation results show that the best PI parameters can be quickly educed by adopting stator field orientation vector control theory and genetic algorithm. It is guaranteed that the power system output remains constant frequency and constant voltage of three phase ac under the circumstances of speed changing. However, the control strategy is considered as valid and effective.

articleTitle: Research on coal mine inter-accident intervals based on bootstrap
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper makes an analysis of the inter-accident intervals which are from four divisions of the British Coal Board by bootstrap method. It is carried out from two perspectives: data pre-processing and bootstrap analysis. The conclusions below have been obtained: Firstly, Most of the coal accidents happen in the interval of 0–20 days in all four divisions. Secondly, it is sufficient to estimate the mean and variance by bootstrap method. Thirdly, the bootstrapping result shows that division 3 is the safest division, but it also needs strengthen its safety management.

articleTitle: A novel outdoor localization with cellular topology in opportunistic networks
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Opportunistic networks is one of the most interesting evolutions of mobile ad-hoc networks (MANETs). This paper describes a novel outdoor wireless localization approach. It includes the deployment and localization algorithm in Opportunistic networks. In this paper, the opportunistic networks model consists of static nodes and motes. The static nodes are location known but motes are location-unaware. The static nodes are deployed around the monitoring region with the style of cellular which has proven rational and economic. In order to improve the accuracy of localization, the paper proposes a high accuracy outdoor ranging approach based on received signal indicator (RSSI). In addition, considering the delay tolerant characteristic of opportunistic networks, we present the correction-localization based on region division. The correction-localization method deals with the motes lie in the regions that are covered by two reference nodes. The performances of the network topology and localization algorithm are evaluated by using simulated and real experimental data.

articleTitle: High temperature proton exchange membrane fuel cell hybrid power system monitoring platform designing
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The design of 5kw high temperature proton exchange membrane fuel cell (HTPEMFC) hybrid power system monitoring platform is presented in this paper. The purpose of the system is to overcome the problems of low temperature proton exchange membrane fuel cell (LTPEMFC), such as poor water management and requirement of high-purity hydrogen.
