The present computerized real-time monitoring system is based on NI's PXIe hardware system and Labview software. The platform has two working modes - test mode and simulation mode. In the test mode, it provides the conditions for studying the problems of fuel cell hybrid power system, such as system performance, modelling and optimization, by completely monitoring all the working parameters in real-time. And in the simulation mode, besides the problems mentioned above, those with feeding control under changing loads, stability of output power and optimization of energy efficiency, can also be studied with multi-energy management system.

Author Keywords: High Temperature Proton Exchange Membrane Fuel Cell (HTPEMFC)

articleTitle: A FPGA-based ROHC decompressor design
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The bandwidth of the wireless channel is the most valuable resources in the whole wireless communication system. In order to utilize the limited wireless resources efficiently, the header's overhead introduced by transmission protocols must be reduced by header compression. Robust Header Compression (ROHC) is a compression scheme aims at providing a compression scheme that has high compression efficiency and high robustness when used in wireless links. Previous studies of ROHC are mainly focused on the software implementation and optimization of key parameters. In this paper, we introduce the basic concept and technology of RHOC and give the architecture of RHOC hardware decompressor which works under U mode. The decompressor is implemented on FPGA. The design of the decompressor is present in this essay also. It can work effectively, and decompress the packet such as IR, IR-DYN and UO-0/UO-1/UO-2 correctly. The performance of ROHC hardware accelerator which includes compressor and decompressor is evaluated through simulation. The result shows that the ROHC hardware compressor can compress the 40 bytes IPV4/UDP/RTP packet to 3∼4 bytes, and decompress effectively by the decompressor.

articleTitle: Research on intelligent scheduling system in aluminum industrial production
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In this paper, optimization scheduling control problem of aluminum industrial production process were divided in four main production stages: ore proportioning, production of alumina, aluminum electrolysis and aluminum fabrication. Each production stage is abstracted for production scheduling agent by the agent technology, and built as the supply chain alliance of virtual enterprise. Through connecting the agents to mesh structure, this paper establishes system structure of the aluminum industrial production intelligent scheduling platform and develops to realize the scheduling system preliminarily.

articleTitle: Research on LabVIEW system of fire detection based on BP neural network
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In order to reduce mis-warning rate, leak-warning rate and increase intelligent grade of automatic fire alarm system, in this paper, a novel system for building fire alarm based on BP neural network algorithm, which is developed by LabVIEW virtual instrument, is presented. In the LabVIEW virtual instrument system of fire detection, first, the multiple fire parameters were obtained from different detectors, then normalized and entered into the system and calculated by BP algorithm, finally the results of parameters processing were applied in the fire alarm. The experiment results show that this method can recognize fire signals and reduce the mis-warning and leak-warning rate. The fire alarm system can predict the fire timely and has stronger anti-jamming ability, so it will play an important role in building safety system.

articleTitle: A photodiode signal conditioning circuit for projectile velocity measurement
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In order to keep photodiode signal conditioning circuit could response to the very short pulse when projectiles cross the light mesh, the bandwidth of conditioning circuit should be increased and noise should be avoided. The key influencing factors on the bandwidth limit are analysed, and two optimization methods have been put forward at the same time. In the end, several experimental verification experiments are made to verify the two optimization methods which are put forward previously. The experimental results demonstrate that the former optimization method still could not be applied into the signal conditioning circuit, and the latter could improve the performance.

articleTitle: Image super-resolution based on guided filter and sparse representation
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This article mainly introduces the single image super-resolution (SR) problem based on guided filter and sparse representation. In fact, image super-resolution is highly ill-posed problem, so we needed to regularize it as prior knowledge. The result is to renew a high-resolution image from its down-scale and blurred image. We embark from the recently proposed compressive sensing (CS). We will training high-resolution image and the corresponding low-resolution image patch pairs to generating two over-complete dictionaries D<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">h</inf> and D<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ℓ</inf>. In this paper, we exploited guided image filtering as the feature extraction for the low-resolution image patch, instead of the second-order and first-order derivatives. We will showing the results with original images both visual and image PSNR improvements.

articleTitle: Design of coal mine ventilator intelligent monitoring system
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The paper mainly elaborates the design of hardware and software about intelligent monitoring system. The hardware includes DSP (That is a digital signal processor.), a variety of sensors, external circuits, the system debugging and simulating. The software includes a main program and a bus communication protocol. The system can realize functions of automatic detection and procession faults, automatic protection, and automatic display various technical indicators. These technical indicators include gas pressure, gas concentration, environment temperature, humidity, ventilator speed and motor running states. And it can achieve centralized monitoring and remote controlling, too. The experimental result shows that the intelligent monitoring system has a stable performance, flexible control and strong adaptability. The system can be widely used in coal mine ventilator surveillance occasions to promote their safety and reliability. The system can avoid gas explosion accidents caused by poor ventilation and reduce energy consumption.

articleTitle: Table of content
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)

articleTitle: Robust adaptive backstepping control of a class of uncertain nonlinear system
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: For the control of a class of nonlinear system with bounded disturbance uncertainties, by combining robust control and backstepping control, introducing the virtual control variable, recursively selecting the Lyapunov function, offering the adaptive law of parameters estimate, I designed an adaptive controller with state feedback, and analyzed its stability. This design needs no knowledge about the uncertainty internal parameters of the system. Theoretical analysis and simulation results show that the designed controller has better robustness to parameters uncertainties and bounded disturbance, and it can guarantee global asymptotic stability of the closed-loop system, which validates the efficacy of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Logic program with prioritized preference
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Prioritized preference based decision making is pervasive in real problems solving. We propose a new paradigm of logic programming to handle prioritized preference. The paradigm is interpreted based on answer set semantics. We introduce two semantics to optimize answer sets of the programs. Then, we present the properties of those semantics by investigating their order characterization. Finally, compared with related works, it shows our new paradigm has strong expressive power of preference representation and reasoning.

articleTitle: Autority aware expert search: Algorithm and system for NSFC
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper describes the peer reviewer finding algorithm used in an aided system to assist the proposal reviewing task in the National Science Foundation of China (NSFC)[1]. We propose a new probabilistic language model in which expert authority is taken into consideration, by introducing a prior probability of candidate into the model. Application codes representing research areas are defined by NSFC and are available for both experts and proposals. We integrate code information into our model as we add a code probability term into the model, thus promote rankings of experts with matched code. All proposals submitted to NSFC are written in Chinese, and since Chinese word segmentation is non-trivial task whose accuracy affects the final results heavily, we try to improve segment accuracy by adding domain-specific terms to a user-editable dictionary. Terminologies are extracted from certain field of bibliography data in NSFC system. Experiments show that our algorithm is effective in real world system like NSFC.

articleTitle: Measuring semantic relatedness based on ontology
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The need of determining the degree of semantic similarity/relatedness between two concepts within ontology is becoming an increasingly important task in the field of Information Retrieval. Semantic similarity is only a special case of semantic relatedness. Although a great attention has been paid to design semantic similarity methods based on ontology, there has been little discussion about the methods of semantic relatedness methods. In this paper, based on distance-based calculation model to calculate concepts' similarity within ontology, we introduced an improved method for measuring semantic relatedness. In addition, our approach considers some important properties such as concepts' depth, density, relation distance to measure semantic similarity/relatedness. The experimental studies are provided to illustrate that our approach is reasonable.

articleTitle: Standing tree volume measurement technology based on digital image processing
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper concerns the problem of standing tree volume measurement based on digital image processing. A computer and a camera were used in our work. Before the tree photo was taken, two red color marking labels were attached on the trunk. After the marking points and the tree trunk were extracted, the tree trunk edges were fitted with a high order curve. Then the volume of tree trunk of any height selected with a rectangle can be calculated. The experimental results show that the relative measurement error is low enough. So it is a viable method.

articleTitle: Study and improvement on LEACH protocol in WSNs
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper studies and analyzes the clustering mechanism in LEACH routing protocol which is the first cluster-based routing protocol for wireless sensor networks. One of problems in the LEACH protocol is that it depends on the time period to re-establish new clusters among whole network without considering the differences of energy consumption between the various clusters. The paper proposes an improved LEACH protocol to solve the above problem. In improved LEACH protocol, after clusters are established, each cluster head decides whether to select a new cluster head, based on their energy consumption. The new cluster head will be the node having more residual energy. Thus, those clusters with less load can avoid the energy consumption resulted in selecting cluster head frequently. At the same time, it also can prevent the overloading of the cluster head node to fail. Simulation results show that the improved LEACH protocol effectively prolong the network lifetime and effectively improve node's energy efficiency.

articleTitle: A multi-unit cascading type high-voltage power amplifier for driving piezoelectric actuators
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In order to improve the dynamic characteristics, load capacity and bandwidth of the power amplifier which is used to driving piezoelectric actuators, a novel high-voltage power amplifier based on multi-unit floating cascade topology is developed by using multiple independent high-precision power amplifier units cascade. To improve the stability, an effective dual-channel feedback compensation strategy is developed. Experimental results show that the output voltage amplitude is 0–1000V, the maximum output power is 1KVA, the large signal bandwidth is over 1KHz/0.3uF, and the static ripple is 100mV. It can satisfy the system requirements of low ripple, high accuracy, large bandwidth, short response time and excellent load capacity.

articleTitle: The influence analysis that disk shearing machine parameter setting and quality of the side shearing
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: There is a problem in a cold rolling line of domestic steel enterprise, which is the phenomenon of bad cutting-type when it used the diameter of 407mm bilateral disc shearing to shear the thickness of 2.82mm strip steel. In this paper, to solve this problem by create the shear system model according to certain simplified principle, from taking the simulation of practical operation conditions, we can obtain the relationship between shear force of coincidence degree and shear blade gap, and got affecting relation between coincidence clearance degree and strip steel shear quality. Finally using the theoretical knowledge demonstrates the accuracy of simulation results.

articleTitle: The performance comparison between Viterbi decoding and multistage decoding of BCM codes on AWGN channel
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper introduces the process of constructing BCM codes firstly. Then it focuses on the two decoding algorithms-multistage decoding and Viterbi decoding. Finally we compare their performance on the AWGN channel. The simulation result shows that both decoding algorithms achieve coding gain comparing to non-coding QPSK codes and that the BER performance of Viterbi decoding based on soft-decision outperforms multistage decoding.

articleTitle: Credit-based network management by weighted Fuzzy C-means
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Nowadays network management is no longer limited to the routine maintenance of software and hardware. This paper introduces credit scoring into campus network management systems by weighted Fuzzy C-means clustering and Support Vector Machines (SVMs) predictor. The records of abnormal events on a large campus network over the past two years are obtained and sorted. Improved ReliefF analyzes the weights of five attributes of records before classified by weighted fuzzy C-means clustering into four classes. N-fold method is then employed to train a SVM classifier for prediction. The results indicate that the SVM predictor outperforms our previous system effectively. The classification results also consist with our goal of focused management on a small amount of users and set up reasonable starting scores according to the class the user belongs to.

articleTitle: Optimal control design for Maglev train suspension system
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: As the single magnet is a multi-variable, nonlinear suspension system, a linear mathematical model based on state space is provided. The controllability, observability and stability of the system are discussed in this paper. Quadratic optimal control method is used for the suspension system design, and MATLAB simulation is applied to the study of quantities for the Q and R weight-matrixes. Different simulation graphics obtained by varying Q and R values, are used for the measurement of control performance. The simulation results show that the magnet gap deviation returns to zero value in quadratic optimal control, and reaches good control performance.

articleTitle: Deadlock prevention method for locomotive transportation dispatching system based on Petri Nets
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: As for the deadlock prevention problem of locomotive dispatching system, an improved dispatching rule is proposed based on former related work firstly. Then, the method of deadlock prevention based on Petri Nets for transporting dispatching system is studied. An offline deadlock prevention algorithm is presented by tabular method, by which the maximum number N of locomotives that can accommodate in the dispatching system can be calculated. Lastly, through constructing the resource allocation model based on Petri nets, the correctness of deadlock prevention algorithm is proved, and the necessary and sufficient condition for deadlock-free control of the dispatching system is verified. This approach that combining modelling and deadlock-free control is easy to implement and can be embedded into the real-time scheduler for developing large monitoring system software in future.

articleTitle: Optimization for wire tensions in wire-driven parallel manipulators
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In the paper, an optimum proposal of wire tensions based on the penalty function is given and a nonlinear mathematical model of wire tensions is established. By use of the penalty function algorithm, the constrained optimization problem of wire tensions will be transformed into unconstrained optimization problem. Two cases which are different minimum preloads at zero attitude position and the same minimum preload at different attitude positions are given to analyse the algorithm. The simulation results show that the curves of wire tensions are relatively smooth. There is no changed impact, and the values of the maximum tensions obtained are also realistic.

articleTitle: Improved determination method of periodic orbits around Sun- Earth libration point
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Richardson's three-order analytical solution gives a good approximation of Halo-type periodic orbit in the vicinity of Sun-Earth collinear libration points, whereas still cannot meet the requirements of high-precision orbit determination because of the limitation of precision. An improved method of periodic orbit determination is proposed and accomplished in this paper to iteratively correct the inaccurate initial values. The main idea of this improved correction method is based on a simulation point of view, which proposes a new exploration of simulation method and achieves a higher precision and lower time consuming. Simulation results are presented to demonstrate the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: A superpixel-level active contour model with global and local constrains
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Turbopixels are a powerful tool for image over segmentation, and have become increasingly popular in computer vision applications. They are constrained to have compactness, uniform size, and adherence to object boundaries. In this paper we advocate the use of turbopixels as the basic unit of active contour model, instead of operating at the pixel level. Firstly a color image is over-segmented into turbopixels, and then we represent color cues of turbopixels as a sparse color histogram in 8-d HSV color space. Finally we introduce edge indicator function and localizing region idea to obtain an improved active contour model. Practical experiments prove that our algorithm can obtain better segmented results than the state-of-art active contour model in color image segmentation.

articleTitle: Robust fault-tolerant method in the ducted fan UAV attitude control
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper studies the robust fault-tolerant control problem of the linear uncertain system in actuator failures. Using linear matrix inequalities, a H-inf state feedback fault-tolerant control method which can meet the regional pole constraints is proposed. This method has integrity to the actuator. It is applied to attitude control system of the ducted fan UAV. The simulation results shows that this method has good robustness for the ducted fan UAV's attitude control system when actuator is under the condition of performance degradation. Meanwhile closed-loop poles can be placed at a prescribed disk region

articleTitle: A* algorithm used in three-dimensional environment for optimal path planning
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In this paper, we obtain three-dimensional topographic height information by sensors and use gradient threshold method to deal with flatness on ground. Thus, there should be three robot traffic conditions: passable area, access more difficult area and hazard area. Then according to the robot's parameters, appropriate threshold value for traffic conditions will be obtained and then is stored in two-dimensional array in corresponding coordinates of the processed image. So we can establish an appropriate database table structure, and relational tables are built to connect the grid node information, road information and road access hardness information. Whereafter, we take advantage of A * algorithm to search for driving area and add threshold value as search path cost, so it's not only the shortest possible path, but also more efficient access path. It is proved that this can make better results, because it takes into account the corresponding actual geographical environment.

articleTitle: Based on equal-area measurable partition of workspace analysis
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper is focused on the workspace analysis. A simple, effective and intuitive scheme called equal-area measurable partition is presented. In order to verify the effectiveness and correctness of the proposed algorithms, the reachable workspace area of cable-driven 3-DOF parallel mechanism is analyzed quantitatively by the constraint conditions. And numerical solution of the global condition index (GCI) is given. The simulation results from the scheme shows that the mechanism has a certain load capacity and stability movement performance.

articleTitle: MIMU filter design for vehicle tracing
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In this paper, low cost microinertial measuring unit (MIMU) is designed for vehicle navigation application. Various navigation update equations are developed for locating and tracing the vehicle. Since low cost MIMU being larger bias and shift, strap-down inertial navigation system(SINS) has quickly accumulated some error and alone odometer velocity can not yield good results, zero constant velocity-down and horizontal direction constraint are argument to make the three-direction measurement model. Unscented Kalman filter (UKF) used the information from odometer and navigation parameter was proposed. Matlab simulation results indicate that the proposed method can effectively restraint the error, and continuous positioning and tracing distance can reach up to 1km. So this method can meet the vehicle tracing and location during vehicle travelling in tunnel and other place where the GPS data information can't be received.

articleTitle: Bias joint controlling operating method of APD sensor based on ADL5317
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The paper introduces a mode of bias voltage setting and provides a solution of stable application according to APD sensor used with the ADL5317. Combined with the photoelectric characteristics of APD sensor and internal function module of ADL5317, it gives the performance analysis and simulation to two kinds of controlling manners of ADL5317, revealing the control principle and changing law on working state and stability of APD. The bias joint controlling operating method of APD sensor based on ADL5317 and mirror current detection are focused on in the paper and the solution that controls the bias of APD comprehensively by using ADL5317 is presented.

articleTitle: Improved compact channel current model of power radio frequency SOI LDMOS for CAD tools
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Based on a drift current model, along the channel current of MM20 model, an approved SOI LDMOS compact model is presented in this paper. A continued and concise expression of the presented model for easily analysis of harmonic balance, which considers the quasi-saturation effect of SOI LDMOS and short channel effect, are observed. Comparison of simulated results of DC I–V and transform characteristic for the presented model with measured data are made, which shows they are well agreed, and this model is verified.

articleTitle: Stock price prediction method based on cluster of trend vectors
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Aiming at the short term price prediction for the investment in stock market, we introduce a way to symbolize the stock price data by data fitting and cluster technology according to its trend, and then propose a predict method using support vector machine which is wrapped by univariate marginal distribution algorithm. Based on the algorithm, we design a corresponding investment strategy, and test it on the real stock data with a comparison to the result of BP neural network. Experimental results show that our method is more effective and performs better than simple BP neural network to guide the investment.

articleTitle: Study of an algorithm of RBF-GPC for CFBB Unit
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Circulating Fluidized Bed Boiler (CFBB) is a multivariable, strong-coupling, long-time delay, nonlinear and time-variable systems. The accurate model is difficult to establish. So it is hard to get optimum effect with conventional control strategy. In this study, RBF network is used to identify the CFBB control system by establishing a predictive model in generalized predictive control strategy, and achieve predictive control with online rolling optimization and real time feedback revision. The simulation result shows that it can adapt the object change characteristic. This method has a good control effect and the strong robustness.

articleTitle: A network-optimized mechansim based on genetic algorithm for TD-SCDMA systems
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: TD-SCDMA, which has been widely used in China, provides better experience for mobile users than GSM did. However, weak coverage remains one of the most important problems in the current network as it used to be in GSM. One way to address the problem is through network optimization. Traditional approaches of network optimization exhaustively search all possible schemes for the optimal solution, which is computationally prohibitive. It is almost impossible to implement such a complex solution in real networks. A more efficient solution is in urgent need. The main contribution of this paper is a low-complexity solution based on genetic algorithm. Simulation results show that the proposed solution achieves better performance with lower cost of time.

articleTitle: Development of analysis software of general sinusoidal steady-state circuit
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The analysis software of general sinusoidal steady state circuit was designed by GUI in MATLAB. The equation of the circuit was formed by nodal tabulation method in circuit theory and the generality and applicability of the circuit analysis was improved. The input and output data can be visualized directly and the ideal transformer and a number of coupled inductors can be analyzed by GUI programming. The software computed the general sinusoidal steady state circuit and offered the results automatically. The computation examples verify the accuracy and validity of the program.

articleTitle: Representation and aggregation of bipolar preferences in a graded quadrivalent logic framework
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In bipolar preferences handling, the possibilistic logic framework is limited in real applications by two limitations: the requirement of coherence between positive goals and rejections, and the absence of bipolar preferences combination strategies. In this paper, a necessity degree based quadrivalent logic framework is introduced to handle bipolar preferences. In the new framework, not only two limitations are released, also it is proved the possibilistic logic framework is a special case of the new framework.

articleTitle: The principle of output side control and its
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Through the analysis of the principle of the overflow tank, the concept of the output side control is proposed, and a model of the output side feed forward control is extracted from the instance. Three examples of the output side feed forward control are given, that is used in current control, flow control and rotational speed control respectively. Experiments show that the model is feasible and it has an advantage over the input side feedback system not only in system stability but also in the bearing of high precise system, long time delay system and inexact mathematical model system.

articleTitle: Parallel answer set solving algorithm based on multi-core processor technology
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Answer Set Programming (ASP) is widely used in many areas of Artificial Intelligence. A parallel answer set solving algorithm based on multi-core processor technology is proposed in this paper. The parallel algorithm is designed on the shared-memory parallel computing model which is the abstract model of multi-core processor. The algorithm can distribute the whole solving task to several threads separately run on different cores of the multi-core processor. To make this parallel algorithm more efficient, we implement load balancing among different threads by the technique of shared global queue. The experimental results show that the parallel algorithm can improve the solving efficiency by times with the growth of processor cores.

articleTitle: An improved memetic algorithm for the vehicle routing problem
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper proposes an improved memetic algorithm (IMA) for solving the vehicle routing problem (VRP). The IMA uses a hybrid-selection strategy to enhance the crossover operator. Classical local search operators are combined for the route improvement. Besides, the same chromosomes are modified to be different so that the population diversity is preserved and the algorithm kept from premature convergence. The performance of IMA is tested by solving several VRP benchmark instances and compared to two genetic algorithms and the basic memetic algorithm. Experimental results validate that IMA could obtain superior solutions to the three counterparts within reasonable computation time.

articleTitle: ROI feature extraction algorithm based on the multi-scale corner
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: With several extraction methods discussed focused on contour corner, this paper presented a detection method based on multi-scale curvature polynomial (MCP), by making use of multi-scale information and the scale uncertainty of corner. Region profile at different scales and the corresponding curvature values were obtained by using the detection method of the curvature scale space (CSS), and the weighted sums were used in the curvature corresponding to local maxima points on different scales. And for non-polar curvature point, the curvature product was adopted, all the curvature polynomial value of the region was calculated and the contour corner of the region was extracted by taking the threshold. The test shows that the algorithm is simple, and it is more effective in the extraction of region of interest (ROI) than the traditional ones.

articleTitle: A wireless sensor network node design based on ZigBee protocol
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: A wireless sensor network node is designed in this paper which includes temperature, humidity monitoring signal collection and communication protocol design based on ZigBee. The ZigBee network node can be used to achieve network control, device management, data collection, information transmission and so on. This design includes hardware and software. A full function ZigBee node (FFD) used PIC18LF4620 MCU as the core CPU and chip MRF24J40 as the RF transceiver controller. These two chips communicate each other, and also the data acquisition and transmission controlled through the SPI interface. The temperature and humidity of the environment can monitor by ZigBee wireless network node. The digital temperature sensor TC77 and capacitive humidity sensor HS1101 is used to measure temperature and humidity. Software design is based on microchip stack for the ZigBee protocol. All above are achieved and to measuring in real environment to prove the design is reasonable, reliable, and can be widely used

articleTitle: Forecasting approach of subway tunnels deposition based on ANP-SOM model
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The main influencing factors on its nature of complexity and indetermination are analysed deeply in this paper. Super Decisions software of ANP (Network Analytic Hierarchy Process) is used to solve the weights of all the influence factors. Use them as the initial weights to train SOM neural network for the fine-tuning; a new ANP-SOM model which consider to various factors, levels and impact of each other feedback synthetically is pretended. This model is well-adjusted, convergence and precision. It was used in forecasting of Xi'an Tunnel deposition and has achieved a good predicted result.

articleTitle: A binary space based on modified hamming distance for clustering
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Any things can be seen as an entity represented by multiple properties. This paper define a binary space for clustering, in which for each entity, we convert the raw data into the attribute string and transform it into a binary string in accordance with binary tree. The order of each attribute is no importance. At the same time, because the weight of each attribute is different in this space, we use Modified Hamming distance (MHD) to replace Euclidean distance to calculate proximity between two binary strings. In this way, the binary space is more close to reality, simplifies the calculation and improves computing efficiency. Finally, we take k-means clustering algorithm for example and select 74 financial indexes data of 1796 listed companies to experiment. Due to use ‘0’ and ‘1’ representation, this space is simple and efficient in terms of clustering. The results show that this space performs better in processing mass data.

articleTitle: Bayesian learning based visual saliency detection
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper is to present a Bayesian learning based framework for visual saliency detection in natural scenes. Especially, for any point in the scene, this framework has considered whether it is salient or not; but previous methods by Bayesian learning seem not to do so. This framework includes two steps. First, the framework indicates that visual saliency is constituted with three main saliency modules. In a free-viewing manner, these main saliency modules are rarity, distinctiveness and central bias. Second, they are non-linearly combined for the final saliency map by a regularized neural network. The experimental results on two fixation datasets indicate that our framework outperforms other representative methods.

articleTitle: Building damage detection based on single high-resolution remote sensing imagery
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper presents a building detection approach based on HSV color space. The method is based on the gray level histogram features, which can separate the housing construction units from complex background. A building damage detection algorithm based on regional statistical information is also proposed in this paper, and a set of performance parameters of feature vector is studied to identify the extent of the housing collapse. The experiments on Haiti post-earthquake images from Google Earth and Yushu post-earthquake images from Internet are discussed in the paper. The experimental results show that proposed approach is effective and feasible.

articleTitle: A new image segmentation method based on optical degradation model
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: For machine vision inspection systems, captured images are often degraded to various extents because of the lens spherical aberration. In order to solve this problem, this paper introduces a new method which first found an optical degradation model (ODM) by the point illumination in the image plane, and simplified the optical degradation model based on the properties of illumination distribution. The method compensated the background from the original image and employed global threshold to make better segmentation. The performance of the new method is validated by a comparison with the Otsu's segmentation method, as well as the adaptive threshold method.

articleTitle: Research and application of data mining in enterprises consumption warning association
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper proposes a structured item-sets time and space algorithm, which is used to find warning association rules between energy consumption monitoring points, according to the time characteristic and spatial characteristics of overall energy consumption in industrial enterprises, and the new algorithm can solve many difficulties that tradition mining algorithm encountered. The new algorithm has been improved on the basis of the classical Apriori algorithm. Introducing the time dimension and space dimension, new algorithm can dig more associated knowledge during different time periods and in different spatial layers. Through establishing minimum energy monitoring unit and adopting time-sharing and hierarchical data mining strategy, the new algorithm avoids producing excessive candidate sets. The improved algorithm has been applied in energy data analysis of production process of a large industrial enterprise in the domestic and achieved satisfying practical results.

articleTitle: The research of extracting moving target based on GrabCut
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This study is designed to achieve a technology of extracting moving target within local windows based on GrabCut. After user cut out the moving target in the first frame, our system then covered a series of local windows over the contour of the target totally. Then our system used sparse optical flow algorithm and dense optical flow algorithm respectively to track the moving target and moved the local windows according the tracking result, which led to correct models and accurate extracting results. This study compared the affects to extracting results of tracking results between dense optical flow algorithm and sparse optical flow algorithm. Experimental results show that dense optical flow algorithm is better than the sparse optical flow algorithm and the former can ensure that the local windows cover the contour of target totally all along and lead to accurate extracting result of moving target.

articleTitle: Improvement on the wideband DOA estimation by averaging covariance matrices over frequency bins
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: An improvement on the wideband DOA estimation is proposed. The new covariance matrix of a frequency bin is obtained by averaging the covariance matrices of its adjacent frequency bins, then the general wideband DOA algorithms are applied based on the new covariance matrices. Compared with the wideband algorithm without covariance matrices average, the improvement has the higher resolution and the smaller root mean square error for most cases. The theoretical analysis of the errors of DOAs shows that the average operation is effective and the error from this operation is negligible especially when very limited snapshots are available. The computer simulation is applied to compare the performance between the improved method and the conventional method.

articleTitle: A time synchronization mechanism for heterogeneous wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Based on the characteristic of heterogeneous wireless sensor networks (HWSNs), the importance of time synchronization for data aggregation and network coexistence of HWSNs is discussed. In addition, a time synchronization mechanism, which includes the advanced delay measure time synchronization (ADMST) and clock frequency transition mechanism, is proposed. ADMST is employed in the subnet of the HWSNs, while clock frequency transition mechanism should be employed before ADMST for synchronizing between (or among) the subnets. The test platform contains both the hardware (CC2430, MSP430F2618+CC2520) and software (protocol stack meeting IEEE 802.15.4E standard draft), and the experimental results show that the scheme can be well applied to time synchronization and realize data aggregation and network coexistence in HWSNs.

articleTitle: Flexible flow line scheduling problems with re-entrant flows and queue-time constraints
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: We consider scheduling problems in a flexible flow line (FFL) with re-entrant flows and queue time constraints. The objective of the scheduling problem is to minimize the number of tardy jobs. The problem considered in the study is a NP-hard problem in the strong sense. Since much computation time is required to find the optimal solution, heuristics are an acceptable practice for finding good solutions. In this research, rule-based heuristics are proposed to solve FFL problems with re-entrant flows and queue time constraints. To evaluate the performance of the proposed heuristics, a large number of test scenarios are designed to simulate practical shop floor problems. For these candidate problems, computational experiments are performed to compare the performance of the proposed heuristics against several well-known dispatching rules. The results show that the proposed heuristics outperform other heuristics.

articleTitle: RS image processing automata
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: RS supply principal information for 3S technics. RS image processing, median-filter, image smoothing, sharpening and enhancement are always the main tasks of GIS. This paper gives a general mathematical model—RS image processing automata on image convolution of RS image processing. The analysis of the complexity of RS image processing is used this automata. For RS image there are always mass dates, so the complexity of the algorithm of RS image processing is very important. Combine some theories of fuzzy mathematics, the author suggest fuzzy RS image processing automata. And the efficiency of this automata, that is used to RS image processing, is proved at least ten times faster than the classic algorithms. The effect of RS image processing is height -end.

articleTitle: Freeway ramp metering based on robust integral of the sign of the error
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Based on the characteristic of highly nonlinear and uncertain of traffic flow model for freeway, ramp metering was designed in the way of robust integral of the sign of the error (RISE). The unmodeled term in the model was estimated by its bounded differential. Because the control input was designed to achieve the estimated error closing to zero, the control effort is reduced. The controller is presented without approximately linearizing the macroscopic traffic flow model and knowing the upper bound of unmodeled term. The control approach is verified not only to be robust subject to uncertainties including external disturbances and unmodeled dynamics, but also to be adaptive to unknown parameters. A numerical example shows a satisfactory track performance.

articleTitle: A data fusion approach based on compressed sensing theory for wireless sensor network
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In this paper, a data fusion approach based on compressed sensing theory for energy-efficient data transmission in wireless sensor networks is proposed. This approach can effectively reduce the data transmission cost and improve data precision. The simulation results show the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of the LIMU pulse counting system
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The sense organs of the launch vehicle control system are of great important in maintaining the launch vehicle attitude stability. Based on the deep analysis of the digital pulse signals from the telemetry interface of laser gyroscope inertial measuring unit (Laser Gyroscope Inertial Measuring Unit-LIMU), the digital pulse signal counting system is designed based on FPGA, and the functions and components of hardware are detailed introduced. At last, the system is simulated in the Libero IDE development environment with VHDL. The results show that the system has the virtue of higher reliability, lower cost, less source requirement, shorter development cycle and has good application value.

Author Keywords: Launch Vehicle Control System LIMU FPGA

articleTitle: System life prediction algorithm design and data analysis of inertial navigation
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Equipment has long service period and high reliability requirements, equipment support personnel not only need to complete the necessary test and repair, but also have to make clear the future development trend of equipment performance and the life expectancy during life cycle. Life prognostic can help them to improve the equipment maintenance and ensure high logistics and readiness capability of equipments. In this paper, the author researches and analyses the life prediction algorithm, pre-treatment method and optimization method of equipment service. These algorithms are applied and validated by calculating and analysis the practical test data, which can provide theories basis and references for the weapon PHM.

articleTitle: Model-deviation compensation control based on the transformation of state
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In this paper, a new model-deviation compensation control based on the transformation of state for a general nonlinear system with uncertainty is introduced. By using the concepts and theorems of differential geometry, the original system can be converted into the simplified form. Firstly, the problem and the simplified nonlinear system are described. Secondly, the process of the transformation of state is given, including the existence conditions and the mathematical expressions. Then the model-deviation compensation control is developed. It has the state-error correction term and the model-deviation compensation term besides the equivalent control term. Finally, the simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed controller.

articleTitle: Cam-weighted local tangent space alignment for dimension reduction
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Manifold learning works well in discovering the intrinsic structures embedded in the high-dimensional coordinates and most of the methods lie on the distance metric. This article proposes an unsupervised learning algorithm called cam-weighted distance local tangent space alignment (Cam-WLTSA) which performs well with artificial sample data sets. The cam-weighted distance, first using in the nearest neighbour classification, plays a significant role in this algorithm, which avoiding inappropriate neighbour searching. This algorithm can discover the intrinsic structures which can be used for classification and recognition. Simulation studies demonstrate Cam-WLTSA can give better results in dimensional reduction than LTSA with some artificial sample data sets.

articleTitle: Natural gradient based reinforcement learning algorithm using active stimulating
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Episodic Natural Actor-Critic (eNAC) algorithm is an important direct policy search algorithm which can guarantee the unbiasedness of the natural gradient estimate and have good learning result theoretically. But it has a major drawback: the system reset assumption. A novel algorithm, active stimulating based eNAC (AS-eNAC) algorithm, is proposed to release this restrictive assumption. AS-eNAC algorithm is an extension of eNAC algorithm by introducing an active stimulating procedure into the interaction process to generate the informative episodes automatically. As the initial state of the generated episodes may be different, which violates the prerequisite of the natural gradient estimate method of eNAC algorithm, a linear approximator of the initial state value function is employed in the natural gradient estimate process to improve the accuracy of the estimated natural gradient. Simulation results of the cart-pole balancing demonstrate the efficiency of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Study on robot coalition problem based on novel quantum-inspired ant colony algorithm
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Robot coalition problem is a complicated combinatorial optimization problem. In this paper, a novel quantum ant colony algorithm for the problem is proposed, where the thought of quantum evolution algorithm is combined with ant colony algorithm. In this algorithm, the pheromone is encoded by quantum bits and a new pheromone representation is designed. To avoid the algorithm falling into local optimum, the strategy of quantum crossover is designed to improve the information structure of population. Simulation results show that the algorithm is more effective than quantum genetic algorithm and basic ant colony algorithm.

articleTitle: A new path tracking approach for a mobile robot under velocity field
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: To study path tracking for a mobile robot under velocity field, an efficient and effective approach is suggested. In the traditional method, frequent variation of a robot's linear velocity would cause inefficiency, especially in dynamic environments and/or multi-robot workspace. Comply with the bounds of linear and angular velocities and accelerations of a real robot; we select reasonable linear and angular accelerations by utilizing the linear velocity and angle control laws proposed in this paper. It is an efficient approach since that a robot's linear velocity is kept at the maximum all the time instead of frequent variation. Simulation results in multi-robot workspace illustrate that it is an efficient and effective approach not only for a single mobile robot but also for multiple robots, furthermore, it is high precision.

articleTitle: Domain decomposition method for a kind of parabolic variational inequality with fourth-order
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: A domain decomposition method for a kind of parabolic variational inequality with fourth-order was presented. First, the parabolic variational inequality was reduced to an elliptic variational inequality by using semi-discretization and implicit method in time. Then using finite element method to discretize the elliptic variational inequality and reformulate it into an equivalent optimization problem. As the equivalent optimization problem, domain decomposition method was proposed and the convergence of the method was analyzed. Finally a numerical example was shown and the feasibility and efficiency of the method were proved.

articleTitle: Research and implementation of the technology supporting MicroBlog data collection based on web crawler
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: MicroBlog is an effective vehicle for the network public opinion, and plays an important role in dissemination of the public opinion. A crawler which consisted of user crawling and contents crawling used to crawl MicroBlog is designed. The crawler used protocol-driven strategy, event-driven strategy and template extraction methods to achieve the successful extraction and data storage. Experiment shows that the crawler has an efficiency and integrity of information collection compared with the crawler BFS. A more flexible crawler is needed with the more complexity of DOM Tree.

articleTitle: The research of supine human body vibration on sleeper coach
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: A sleeper coach freedom vibration system model is established, in order to simulate the frequency response on a recumbent human body's head, buttocks and legs under the condition of random input of road irregularity from the front and rear wheels of sleeper coach. Based on the model, the vibration analysis of recumbent human body and calculation results are compared with these of the road tests, then the conclusion will be used for providing theory and reference data for further research of improving sleeper coach riding comfort.

articleTitle: The study of tower grounding resistance measuring equipment based on the method of selective electrode
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The paper introduces the measuring grounding resistance principle of the method of selective electrode and frequency conversion, on the basis of which it also designs the variable frequency grounding resistance detector based on ADSP_BF504, which adopts the DDFS technology and the transformation frequency measurement technology based on the fast Fourier transform to measure grounding resistance, and fixes the fast Fourier algorithm by using the interpolation algorithm with window to complete the biggest interference frequency measurements. And for its performances of automatic frequency selecting, reducing leakage, and inhibit clutter or noise interference, it can achieve the purpose of grounding resistance accurate measurement.

articleTitle: Parallelization of KMP algorithm for the masking-off of repeats in DNA fragment assembly
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: DNA fragment assembly is one the most important aspects of bioinformatics. A new parallelizing optimizing method based on KMP algorithm is proposed in this paper with the aim of dealing with the problem of masking-off of repeats during the DNA fragment assembly. This parallelizing optimizing method divides the target sequence into several parts by the idea of divide and rule, then the main processor assigns each part of sequences to corresponding processors with parallel pattern matching by KMP algorithm. This parallelizing optimizing method can reduce time complexity and the computer simulation has proved the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Path tracking control of tractor-trailer mobile robot with two trailers
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In allusion to the problem of path tracking control of tractor-trailer mobile robot with two trailers, the control algorithm is presented in this paper. The motion model of robot is established firstly, and then the control algorithm of path tracking is designed based on LOS (Line of sight) method and PID (Proportion, differential and integral) control algorithm. The simulation results show that the tractor-trailer mobile robot can be effectively controlled to track the multi-linear paths via the presented control algorithm.

articleTitle: An optimized method of memory simulation accuracy in multicore multithread processor
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: As memory accesses become slower with respect to the processor and consume more power with increasing memory size, the focus of memory performance and power consumption has become increasingly important especially in Multicore-Multithread processor. Multi2Sim is a kind of computer architecture simulation and modeling tool which support Multicore-Multithread processor simulate[4]. The feature makes it a suitable tool for the research of the CMPs architecture. The source code of Multi2Sim is open, which makes it easy to modify and port. But the Multi2Sim provided a poor accuracy to memory system simulation. In this paper, we presented the Multi2Sim simulation framework and make a deep analysis for the key modules kernel. According to the defect, we introduced a project that integrate the DRAMsim with Multi2Sim to solve the problem and gain a accurate memory simulation. At last we discussed the performance of the project.

articleTitle: SDVRP model for emergency logistics and evolutionary heuristic approach
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Inspired by the idea of split delivery vehicle routing problem (SDVRP), this paper proposes a multi-objective, multi-period emergency logistics model, which minimizes the unmet demand, total delivery time and unbalanced supply among demanders. The weighted aggression is taken to compromise the three objectives. The chromosome code structure is designed so as to translate the delivery plans into gene sequences. Based on the feasible initial population generated by the roulette wheel selection, disaster-affected sites are clustered and the evolutionary optimization is performed by the procedures of selection, crossover and mutation. A numeric example is presented and the optimal solution is obtained to validate the model and algorithm.

articleTitle: Ad hoc network link performance inference method
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In linear analysis model on Ad Hoc network link inference, when the rank of routing matrix is not equal to that of its augmented matrix, there is no solution for the non-homogeneous linear equations. In order to solve this problem, The paper brings forth a link performance inference method based on multi-objective optimization. Firstly, link performance inference problem was transformed to a multi-objectives optimal one through simple mathematical transformation in the paper, Secondly, genetic algorithm was used to obtain a sub-optimal solution. The simulation experiment verifies the effectiveness and correctness of the method in this paper.

articleTitle: Semi-supervised LDA by labelling words
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: We propose a new semi-supervised learning technique, which is called Words labelled Semi-Supervised Latent Dirichlet Allocation (wssLDA) by labelling words for large text collections analysis. The model incorporates supervision with Latent Dirichlet Allocation by adjusting weights of topic words chosen by users. Results with perplexity for documents and F-measure for clustering show the improvements for the topic learning and document analysis tasks.

articleTitle: A contribution-based incentive mechanism for P2P file sahring systems
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In P2P file sharing systems, behaviours of free riders and malicious peers cause negative impact on the robustness and availability of these systems. However, most existing incentive schemes only consider behaviours of free riders or malicious peers, thus fail to effectively enhance performances of these systems. In this paper, a contribution-based incentive mechanism with considering both behaviours is proposed. Firstly a contribution management scheme is presented to identify peers with different behaviours. Then a contribution value-based service policy is given to provide differentiated service to peers with different behaviours in order to motivate cooperation among peers. Simulation results confirm the ability of our proposed incentive mechanism to effectively identify both free riders and malicious peers, and punish them by reducing the level of service provided to them.

Author Keywords: Completely decentralized P2P file sharing systems

articleTitle: A DVGE service system for risk assessment of dam-break in barrier lake
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper employs theories and technologies of the distributed virtual reality and geographic information system (GIS) to construct a DVGE (Distributed Virtual Geographic Environment) system. The proposed DVGE System provides geographically distributed users with a shared virtual space and a collaborative platform in order to implement risk assessment work. Using five-layer service system architecture efficiently integrates and shares geographically distributed resources as well as modeling procedures. Meanwhile some key technologies including distributed virtual scene modelling and implementing mechanism of collaborative workflow are discussed. Finally, a DVGE prototype system is implemented to support risk assessment and impact analysis of dam-break in Barrier Lake. The experimental results show that the scheme developed in this paper is efficient and feasible.

articleTitle: Techniques for checking rulebases with intuitionistic fuzzy inference
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper deals with problems of checking rulebases of intuitionistic fuzzy inference and presents a set of techniques for checking intuitionistic fuzzy rules. Theorems of the relationship between theoretical output of system design and practical results, the inexistence of conditions for interactivities among intuitionistic fuzzy rules, and the impact of factors of interactivities among rules in magnitude are exposed with the courses of proof. The experimental results show that rationality and validity of constructed rulebases can be checked by utilizing proposed methods for being synthetic analysis and processing of intuitionistic fuzzy rulebases with hard problems to check the completeness, interactivity and consistency of intuitionistic fuzzy rules solved.

articleTitle: Study on the interactive serial medical images segmentation
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Interactive segmentation algorithm, which can provide accurate, reproducible boundary extraction, is widely applied to medical images. For hundreds of serial CT images of a patient, it is intolerable for radiation therapy physicians to delineate cancer target and some key normal tissues interactively one by one. The paper suggests a method to segment key layers of the image sequence with interactive live-wire segmentation algorithm by doctors firstly, and then with the continuity between layer images, snake active contour is used to get object contours on the large number of middle layer images by the interpolating between adjacent key layers. For the interactive live-wire segmentation algorithm, heap sort is used for searching the globally optimal path from the start node to the goal node to reduce the complexity of the calculation time. Algorithm analysis and experiments indicate that the presented methods can evidently improve the efficiency of segmentation of serial medical images.

articleTitle: A new type of electro-hydraulic actuator used for aircraft structural test
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: With describing the system components and working principle of a new type of electro-hydraulic actuator used for aircraft structural loading test, the mathematical model of electro-hydraulic actuator is established, it was modelled and simulated by using advanced modeling and simulation environment AMESim. It is shown that using AMESim to model and simulate performance more directly and veritably, and can complete the design task accurately and quickly. The simulation results show that the design of electro-hydraulic actuator performance target achieves the expected requirements, and it can be used widely in aircraft structural loading test system.

articleTitle: Dynamics modeling and simulation of UUV with cabin doors opened process
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: To secure the UUV load release, simulation and study on the cabin doors opened process is indispensable. The disturbing f orce characteristics of the cabin doors-opened process is num erically simulated by using sliding mesh, and the hydrodynam ic characteristicof UUV with cabin doors open is simulated b y numerical calculation of three dimensionalflow-filed, and b y building up the dynamics model of UUV in cabin doors-ope ned process,the disturbed movement characteristics of UUV i s simulated and studied under the different cabin doors-opene d angular speeds. The simulation results show that influenced by thedisturbance of the cabin doors-opened process, UUV m oves downwards in longitudinal planewith theattenuation of p itch oscillation, and the higher the doors-opened angular spee d is, the moresevere the disturbed movement is. The simulatio n results can be used as the initialconditionsof subsequent sec urity release of load.

articleTitle: A novel calibration method with iterative correction
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The implicit calibration is always needed for many visual hull reconstruction in a canonical world coordinate. We use a translational planar object for camera calibration instead of the object with known 3D geometry. However, there is an unavoidable inaccuracy in manufacture and assembly of planar object, that leads to the planar object deviate from the space of 3D calibration object. The deviation of planar object causes an error of control point's world coordinate. This error will decrease calibration precision directly. We propose a correction approach by which the accurate camera calibration is achieved. The original information of control point is used to compute an initial set of camera parameters. With these parameters, we calculate a skew-correction coefficient matrix by which the error of information of the control point is corrected. The new information is used to optimize a set of new camera parameters. This process is then repeated until convergence. In many experiments based on real images, the pixel reprojection errors obtained by our method are about 30% lower than those of traditional method. Increased accuracy of camera calibration directly leads to improvement in 3D reconstruction.

articleTitle: Effectiveness system and its evaluation of the airborne VHF radio set based on Cloud model
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper is concerned with the analysis of the communication effectiveness of VHF radio set. A theoretical treatment of a new model for evaluate the effectiveness of the VHF radio set is given. The method is based on the ADC law, the Analytic Hierarchy Process and the Cloud theory. Attention is concentrated on the index system and the normalization of the different indexes. The membership degree function between the different lays is determined based on Cloud model. It is shown that evaluating the effectiveness of VHF radio set by the Cloud model is feasible.

articleTitle: The simultaneous approximation order of multivariate function by neural networks
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In this document, we first give the order of simultaneous approximation of multivariate functions defined in simplex by multivariate Bernstein polynomials. Second, we prove that multivariate polynomials defined in simplex can be simultaneously approximated arbitrarily by a sigmoidal neural networks. At last, we give the order of simultaneous approximation of multivariate functions in simplex by neural networks.

articleTitle: Pedestrian detection based on an assembly of sub-image detectors
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: A method is put forward for pedestrian detection in single-frame which has a robust performance in the presence of clutter and occlusion. The search window is divided into 20 blocks in which areas are named sub-image. Each block is detected by sub-image detector which is learnt from the relevant block of training images using Support Vector Machine (SVM). We assemble all the sub-image detectors with SVM to approach the detection decision. The system has been tested on different databases and on real scenes. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm has a strong ability to detect the pedestrians, even under a condition of occlusion.

articleTitle: Analysis and optimization of flight vehicle aerodynamic configuration based on immune clone selection algorithm
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of parameter adjustment in aerodynamic configuration design of flight vehicle, the influences of the main configuration parameters on the aerodynamic coefficients, dynamic coefficients and dynamic characteristic parameters are analyzed based on the integrated design concept and parameter sensitization analysis method. A new idea of aerodynamic optimization taking the dynamic characteristic parameters as the objectives is proposed, and the major configuration parameters are optimized based on the idea and immune clonal selection algorithm.

articleTitle: Integer linear programming and branch & bound algorithm based approach for constructing MRST with high efficiency
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Minimum rectilinear Steiner tree (MRST) construction is a fundamental problem in VLSI routing, combinational optimization and computational geometry. In this paper, a novel approach based on the combination of geometric analysis, integer linear programming and branch & bound algorithm is presented to construct MRST efficiently. Firstly, an integer linear programming model of MRST problem is built well versed in binding with special features of solution space. Then in order to depress the high computational complexity of constructing MRST, geometric analysis and the branch and bound algorithm are introduced to optimize search space. Experimental results demonstrated the capabilities of the proposed approach to build MRST with high accuracy and efficiency.

articleTitle: Analysis on context-information retrieval oriented to application-layer of internet of things
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Expanding data scale and continuous information changes are important problems that arise in application-layer of Internet of things. In this paper, we present a dynamic context-information retrieval model for solving such problems. A new model has been constructed by organizing key data located on Internet of things from the point of view of object-oriented technique. Context-aware semantic retrieval algorithm and ranking method are put forward to achieve and rank the search results. Combined with real example, the practical performance of model is analyzed. Experimental results demonstrate the meaningfulness and the efficiency of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Adaptive flight control law based on neural networks and dynamic inversion for unmanned aerial vehicle
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: For the small-sized UAV, the paper puts forward a nonlinear control method based on dynamic inversion. In order to compensate the dynamic inversion error, the paper designs an adaptive dynamic inversion controller with neural networks, which have excellent performance in nonlinear functional approximation. The pseudo-control error caused by actuator character is feedback to reference model through pseudo-control hedge, which eliminating the influences each other between the adaptive unit and actuators. The simulation result shows the improvement of the gradual convergence of tracking error and the robustness of system through adaptively compensating inversion error by neural networks.

articleTitle: Fuzzy edge detection of color remote sensing image
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Aiming at color remote sensing image with complexity, fuzziness and strong noise, an edge detection algorithm based on blocky fuzzy enhancement and multi-direction fuzzy mathematical morphology gradient is putted forward. It enhances the image by blocks in fuzzy domain, then employs fuzzy mathematical morphology gradient operation with multiple structure elements of different directions on the image to extract the edge, and it can not only detect real edge with directionality but also restrain non directional noise effectively. Experiments show the algorithm is effectual to detect the edge of color remote sensing image.

articleTitle: H infinity filter in maneuvering target tracking of military guidance field
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The EKF filter is an effective tool for estimating the states of a system. However, accurate system models are not as readily available for industrial problems such as the maneuvering target tracking. State estimators that can tolerate such uncertainty are called robust. The H infinity filter was specifically designed for robustness. In this paper, an improved filtering method combing the H infinity filter is proposed and implemented for maneuvering target tracking of military guidance field. The simulation results show that it yields better performance than EKF when the robust exists.

articleTitle: A fast and accurate detection algorithm for circle target
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: To meet the requirement of fast and precise recognition and detection for circle target, a novel method is proposed. The specific characteristics of circle edge are fully extracted by using multiple structuring element-based generalized morphological edge detection. Then, a spatial moment-based algorithm is developed to detect the edge of circle target, and the subpixel location of circle centre is determined using the least mean-square fitting algorithm. The experiment results show that the proposed algorithm can locate circle target fast and accurately in ideal image and noise image.

articleTitle: Design and simulation of the auto-control system of classroom lights
