publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Focusing on the increasingly large energy loss of lighting power, this paper introduces a kind of practical auto-control system of classroom lights. This system will adopt the combination of MC-S20T180NO opposite type photoelectric switch, DC Solid Relay and middle and small scale integration 74LS47, CD40192, etc. It will take Multisim10 simulation software as the design platform. Through the circuit design and simulative experiment, the system can automatically control the lights according to the variations of environment illumination and the amount of people in the classroom. Each performance index has reached the design requirements. It has quite strong adaptability to all kinds of classrooms in universities, middle schools and primary schools. It has got actual promotion values.

articleTitle: Text similarity calculation based on domain feature word
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper proposes an improved method for feature selection based on traditional mutual information by establishing domain feature words which utilize the differences in the representation of a word in different classes. By the method, we can reselect the feature set out of the established one based on the traditional mutual information. It not only reduces the dimension of the vector but also represents the text more effectively. At the same time, a text similarity calculation system is designed in this paper. Finally, the experimental results show that the improved feature extraction method is superior to the traditional mutual information and the system has a good performance.

articleTitle: The application of information entropy in financial risk evaluation of supply chain
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: With the development of economics globalization and IT, the core of competition is no longer the competition among different individual enterprises, but the competition among different supply chains. In the supply chain system, the unstable financial situation of one of the supply chain members will have an absolute impact on the whole supply chain. More seriously, the capital chain can be broke down. To fully understand the level and influence of the financial risk that supply chain nodes enterprises face, the authors put forward a model for supply chain financial risk evaluation with the help of information entropy. By giving different evaluation indicators different weight, this model can provide us with an objective result that will be useful for us to identify the stability of the supply chain, choose enterprises with low financial risk, replace enterprises with high financial risk, better prevent supply chain risk and have a direct or indirect effect on operation of the upstream and downstream enterprises.

articleTitle: Cliques indexes and applications in employees' social networks
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper combines the indexes of EI (External/Internal links), modularity, and ARI (Adjusted Rand Index) to analyze the ‘cliques’ phenomenon in social networks. Firstly, the relationship between EI index and modularity is explored and ARI index is introduced to measure the overlapping of cliques. Secondly, the characteristics of the clique in employees' Social networks of 4 Chinese small-sized high technology enterprises are researched by using these indexes. The results indicate that the ‘Cliques’ phenomenon is popular but performs different characters in different networks.

articleTitle: Comparison of optimization approachs designed for plate rolling schedule
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper studies application of different optimization approachs in plate rolling schedule design. First of all, the optimization index function and constraints are defined according to the features of plate mill and the plate, then the linear programming method, genetic algorithm and particle swarm algorithm are applied to optimize rolling schedule respectively. Finally, the results are analyzed and compared. The findings show that both particle swarm and genetic algorithm work better in controlling plate shape, but their efficiency is to be improved for online use as a lot of data and plenty of time are needed for iterative computations.

articleTitle: Nondeterministic finite automata for high-speed network
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: With the rapid increase of the network bandwidth, implementing regular expression with hardware has become inevitable. This paper presents a FPGA-based NFA algorithm to achieve a regular expression, which separates the regular expression into wildcard strings and fixed strings, and implement both types pattern matching with a similar structure. It reduces the complexity of programming and takes full advantage of the characteristics of the FPGA. Experimental results show that the implementation is able to process many characters per one clock cycle, and to run at high frequency. Thus the algorithm enables the matching of regular expressions in high-speed network.

articleTitle: Study on UAV flight based identification technology
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In order to verify the feasibility of applying identification technology to engineering control of such air vehicles as missiles, by taking into consideration the flight authenticity, repeatability, safety and reliability, the unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) similar to missile flight control is selected as the controlled object. Based on identification theory and control guidance theory, this paper firstly makes theoretical analysis on UAV's identification technology, and then conducts flight practice to verify the theory. Firstly, The feasibility of UAV's closed-loop identification and the generation of excitation signals are studied. Secondly, identification experiments platform, namely UAV system platform, is constructed, including hardware platform and such software platforms as control guidance, signal transmission and data collection. Thirdly, multiple flight identification experiments are conducted on UAV, thus obtaining identification data. Finally, the mathematical model of UAV is obtained through analyzing and processing data, and this model is verified in time domain and frequency domain. Through a series of simplification method, a mathematical model, which is available in engineering, simplified and close to reality, is achieved, and its correctness is verified at last. The results show that identification's theory and ideology can be entirely applied to the engineering practice controlled by actual air vehicles.

articleTitle: A novel congestion control algorithm by exploiting cross-layer information in multi-hop wireless networks
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In multi-hop wireless networks, TCP performs poorly due to the difficulty in distinguishing congestion problem from error transmission caused by MAC layer link error and collision. To solve this problem, the paper proposes a novel cross-layer congestion control algorithm based on coordination of TCP and IEEE 802.11 MAC protocols. In this work, each node can monitor the contention degree of the wireless channel in MAC layer, as a basis to determine the network congestion. And this MAC congestion information will be sent to the TCP sender using the cross-layer techniques, under which, TCP sender can dynamically adjust the congestion window size to keeping the network load at a reasonable level. Also due to the cross-layer information, TCP will know the reason of the packet loss and avoid starting congestion control mechanism incorrectly. Simulation results show that this algorithm could provide a more efficient solution for frequent transmission losses, and thus result in a significant improvement of the network throughput.

articleTitle: Efficient optimizations for Instruction Set Simulation
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Instruction Set Simulator (ISS) is one of powerful debug tools for the DSPs. However, the efficiency of the instruction set simulation is very low. The paper describes the implementation and the optimization of the instruction set simulation for ZW100 which was developed by CETC. The optimizations include the use of instruction cache which has been used widely and pre-execute method also be presented. These optimizations all improve the performance of the instruction set simulator.

articleTitle: Research on adjustment strategy of PAR in harmony search algorithm
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: As a meta-heuristic algorithm, Harmony Search (HS) can be used to solve lots of NP-hard problems. The pitch adjustment rate (PAR) in HS algorithm is very important parameter in balancing local exploitation and the global exploration. In this paper, three new PAR adjustment strategies are presented for enhance the global optimality of HS, which follow small PAR values with large BW values in early generations, and large PAR values with small BW values in final generations. Finally, the computational simulations and comparisons are carried out by employing six benchmark problems from related literature. The experimental results indicate that using convex function adjust the PAR could improve the performance of HS algorithm. Conversely, using the concave function adjust the PAR reduce the performance of HS algorithm.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of cooperative network coding scheme with feedback in relay-shared networks
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Cooperation and network coding are two hot research topics in wireless communication. To combine and take advantage of them, a cooperative network coding scheme with feedback in relay-shared network is studied. We make theoretic analysis by system outage probability, expected data rate and energy consumption. Results show that the presented scheme achieves performance improvement.

articleTitle: Point position based on cloud model
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: According to the non-linear observation function in GPS point positioning, as well as the mathematical characteristics of combination with randomness and fuzziness of cloud model, with the optimization algorithm and the principle of GPS pseudo range point positioning, from the aspect of non-linearization, the experiment is set to build the GPS point positioning model based on cloud model. With Matlab simulating it, the result shows that the algorithm converges fast while the model result has good stability and reliability.

articleTitle: Analytical analyses research for the automated controlled heavy duty vehicle on the phase locked-loop theory
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In this paper, we present our analytical analyses for the nonlinear dynamical system of the automated heavy-duty vehicles (HDVs) and for its acquisition and tracking processes. A quasi-linear method is used to study the acquisition and tracking process and time scales for the automated HDVs. Parameters such as generalized natural frequency, damping factor, lock time, lock range, pull-in time, pull-in range for the HDVs are given. Those parameters serve as complementary analyses to time and frequency domain functional analysis for HDVs conducted in the previous studies. They provide quick and quantitative metrics for determining the quality and performance for a dynamical HDVs system.

Author Keywords: Automatic control Analytical analyses PLL theory

articleTitle: Internet based industry community discovery and its applications to industry survey
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: With the deepening of social informatization, almost every aspect of the key industries of national economy is reflected on the internet, such as industrial structure, industrial distribution, industrial-scale, industrial development, industrial policies and so on. How to use these massive free industrial data on the internet effectively becomes more and more important for industrial rule exploration and industrial policy formulation. Industry is a concept between microeconomic cells and macroscopical economy units. If each microeconomic cell is viewed as a node in networks, then the whole national economy constitutes a complex network, and further, a specific industry is a community of this complex network. In this paper, we propose the concept of internet based industry community and two discovery algorithms, and then apply them to industry survey. The case study on fishing industry shows that internet based industry community can offer constructive information in tasks such as comparative analysis of domestic and foreign industries and hot events tracking.

articleTitle: Simulation and analysis of RIPv2 routing authentication based on GNS
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Illegal routing information may have disastrous effects on the normal work of the network. Therefore, most of the modern routing protocols support authentication of routing information in the routing level to ensure the reliability of the information. This paper describes the two authentication modes of RIPv2, analyzes the realization mechanisms and PDU formats. Based on GNS3, a typical network topology is designed, and with the aid of it we carry out functional verification and security analysis. Experimental results show that the configuration of RIPv2 routing authentication can effectively prevent the router from receiving unauthorized or malicious routing updates, thereby improving network safety.

articleTitle: Hardware-in-the-loop simulation of satellite large angle rapid maneuver attitude control
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The satellite flight dynamics simulator for control is a laboratory system designed for the purpose of developing and testing attitude control algorithms in a low-risk, low-cost environment. This paper presents the details for the design and construction of a novel hardware-in-the-loop simulator for satellite attitude control, including hardware and software. A nonlinear attitude control algorithm which combines reaction flywheel and thrusters for satellite large angle rapid maneuver is presented. To validate the correctness of the simulator and algorithm, the paper carries out the corresponding hardware-in-the-loop simulation on single-axis air bearing table. Simulation results indicate that the simulator is able to support the experiment and the algorithm can efficiently accomplish attitude maneuver task in shorter time with less fuel consumption compared with reaction flywheel or thrusters only.

articleTitle: A fast segmentation of MRI image based on chan-vese model
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Nowadays, active contour model and level set method have made a great success in the image segmentation, but these methods also have drawbacks: existence of local minima because of non-convexity and the huge amount of calculation. To solve these problems, the paper improved the original Chan-Vese model. Firstly, the nonconvex Chan-Vese model can be reformulated as convex optimization problem based on the work of Chan, et al. This can extract a global minmizer of the model. Then edge detector operator was incorporated into convex Chan-Vese model, and a hybrid model based on edge and region information was proposed. As for the drawback of level set method, the paper exploited fast duality projection algorithm to compute the global minimum of the proposed model. Meanwhile, the paper proposed a new iteration terminal condition which advoided the useless iterations and reduced the iteration time. Finally, the proposed model is applied to MRI images, and the result proves that the proposed model can extract the target region rapidly and accurately.

articleTitle: Design framework of controlled sensing for data reduction under data rate constraints
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Networked control system is a popular research issue and has been applied in many applications for decades, for example, sensor network, remote control system, industrial control system, etc. Since network bandwidth is limited, numerous data is transmitted over network that could result in heavy network loading and further cause delay and packet drop-out phenomenon. In order to effectively transmit data over a bandwidth-limited, it is essential to perform data reduction. Therefore, it is important to analyze meaningful message/information in the data for removing redundant data and transmit them reliably over bandwidth-limited network. In the paper, we design a sensing controller to acquire useful and important data and enhance its visibility based on the dynamic behavior of target. For reliable transmission, communication module is designed based on current available bandwidth and system dynamic. The communication module performs data reduction by sampling and quantizing in temporal and spatial domain, respectively. Moreover, communication module has been examined based on the video transmission scenario.

articleTitle: A gray image watermarking algorithm based on DCT
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: A robust invisible image watermarking algorithm, which embeds a gray image watermarking in the host image, is put forward in this paper. It overcomes the binary watermark's faults, and can embeds higher b it rate in the host image based on blockwise DCT. The gray image watermark is embedded in the host image by altering the chosen DCT medium frequency coefficients, which is easy to be implemented. The experimental results confirm that the proposed algorithm successfully withstands most of the common attracts, including noise interference, cropping, and image compression.

articleTitle: Design of ADSP-BF548 fatigue driving detection system based on eye features
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: To avoid traffic accidents caused by fatigue driving, this paper utilizes fatigue detection algorithm based on eye features to transplant on ADSP-BF548 hardware platform. The camera captures driver's face video in real time; it localizes driver's eye position and status via frame-difference projection, template matching and Kalman methods. At last, make a warning if driver's eye-close time proportion is more than the threshold in a period of time. The experiment shows this driver fatigue detection system based on ADSP-BF548 is of high accuracy and real-time.

articleTitle: The analysis and research of WSN's energy efficient routing protocols
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Due to the limitation of sensor node calculation ability, communication ability and energy, the routing protocol design's primary goal is to improve the energy efficiency and prolong the survival time of the network. This paper, based on the analysis of wireless sensor network routing protocol, focuses on the analysis of typical routing protocols, such as SPIN, Directed Diffusion, GEAR and LEACH etc. In the study of their working principles, we summarized these routing protocol energy-efficient characteristics and the advantages and disadvantages, and made some suggestions on the improvement direction and applications.

articleTitle: The control system design of 0-E theodolite based on Kalman filter
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: According to the advantage of Kalman filter, the author designed a kind of combined control system based on Kalman filter. The combined control system conquered the disadvantage that control system can't realize combined control to the random object, and improved the tracking precision of control system.

articleTitle: Application of robust adaptive backstepping control in a class of uncertain nonlinear system
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: I presented the state equation of a class of uncertain nonlinear system with bounded disturbance. By introducing the virtual control variable, combining robust control with backstepping approach and recursively selecting the Lyapunov function, I designed an adaptive controller with state feedback, and analyzed its stability. This design needs no knowledge about the uncertainty internal parameters of the system. Simulation results show the control system has good position tracking performance and strong robustness, validating the efficacy of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: LS-SVR based nonlinear adaptive direct Generalized Predictive Control
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Generalized Predictive Control (GPC) has a strong ability of overcoming load disturbance, random noise and delay change, and the selected model has less parameter. But it also has some problems such as big amount of calculation and no consideration on both rapidity and over modulation. An adaptive direct GPC method is proposed based on LS-SVR and tracking error. This method uses LS-SVR method to design predictive controller, and uses a modified projection algorithm based on tracking error to adjust the weight of LS-SVR adaptively, in order to avoid the calculating of the inverse matrix. The result indicates that the method is not only very effective but also reduces the calculation amount.

articleTitle: Spatial Constrained Self-Join query algorithm in sensor network
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The join query in sensor network is an important type of query that can find relation between different data sources. We name a join query as spatial constrained self join query in which a sensor node is only related with sensor nodes around itself. Existing SENS-join can solve this problem. But in SENS-join's pre-computing phase it wastes too much energy since it sends all attribute join tuples to base station. We put forward hierarchical grid routing method in which the sensor nodes nearby can influx together in a high level grid cluster header. Based on hierarchical grid routing method, we put forward an efficient self join algorithm by processing semi-join operator in grid cluster headers to avoid sending all join tuples in security region to the base station and to further reduce energy consumption of sensor nodes. Experimental results have shown that SCJA outperforms SENS-join in terms of both energy consumption and scalability.

articleTitle: Implementation of a portable electronic system for providing pain relief to patellofemoral pain syndrome patients
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In this study, a portable electromyogram (EMG) system and a stimulator is developed for patellofemoral pain syndrome (PFPS) patients, with the objective of reducing the pain experienced by these patients; the patellar pain is caused by an imbalance between the vastus medialis obliquus (VMO) and the vastus lateralis (VL). The EMG measurement circuit and the electrical stimulation device proposed in this study are specifically designed for the VMO and the VL; they are capable of real-time waveform recording, possess analyzing functions, and can upload their measurement data to a computer for storage and analysis. The system can calculate and record the time difference between the EMGs of the VMO and the VL, as well as the signal strengths of both the EMGs. As soon as the system detects the generation of the EMG of the VL, it quickly calculates and processes the event and stimulates the VMO as feedback through electrical stimulation units, in order to induce its contraction. The system can adjust the signal strength, time length, and the sequence of the electrical stimulation, both manually and automatically.

articleTitle: A method for delay estimation using traffic monitoring data
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper presents an algorithm to estimate delays at roadworks using historical and real time traffic data. Two types of delay are considered in the algorithm, queuing delay and the moving delay, of which queuing delay is the dominant part of the total delay at roadworks. A queuing delay analysis method is introduced. The algorithm uses a queuing analysis diagram, which takes demand and capacity as input, to estimate the expected queuing delay. Then an initial validation is carried out using operational traffic data from different types of sites. Demands and capacities estimated using historical profile data for different days of the week are used in the validation to test the sensitivity of delay estimation with respect to errors in demand and capacity estimation.

articleTitle: Design of PMSM servo system based on TMS320LF2407A DSP
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: A design of PMSM servo system based on TMS320LF2407A DSP and the schematic of servo system are presented in this paper. The paper also presents algorithms for rotor position estimation, and current, speed and position detection. Double-loop vector control simulation model for PMSM servo system is built in MATLAB/SIMULINK and the results show that it has high dynamic and static performance.

articleTitle: Quantum signaling transmission computing model and simulation analysis
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Signaling is an essential and important component in quantum communication. However, the current research on the quantum signaling transmission computing model has not yet commenced. In this paper, based on the background of noise, the transmission damage probability model of quantum signaling is presented. The relationship between the fidelity of signaling and the samples sent is studied. The simulation results show that, when the state of quantum entanglement is the maximum state of entanglement, the fidelity is 1. The fidelity is increased with the number of samples and limited to 1. For the signaling standards of the future quantum communication system, this study has good technical support role.

articleTitle: The feature extraction of plant electrical signal based on wavelet packet and neural network
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: To solve the difficulties of feature extraction of plant electrical signals and to realize effectively the classification of plant electrical signals, a method of plant electrical signal recognition which is combined with wavelet packet decomposition and the BP neural network was put forward in this paper. The method first decomposes wavelet packet of the plant signals, and puts the maximum of the eigenvalue of signal covariance matrix. The mean absolute value and zero-crossing rate as the eigenvalues, and then put the constructing feature set into the BP neural network, realizing different plant signal identification. The experimental results show that the optimal wavelet packet decomposition reduces the size of the BP neural network, and reduces the complexity algorithm, speeds up the network training time and classification speed. Therefore, this method has good recognition effect.

articleTitle: Danger Theory: A new approach in big data analysis
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Danger Theory is a novel computing model inspired by biological immune systems which is some different with the traditional Artificial Immune Systems, especially the self non-self model. The Danger Theory concerns the potential dangers (which presents like the danger signals) rather than non-self pathogens, so the new computing model introduced into information analysis can take a new approach for big data processing on key features and properties choosing. The authors introduce some works on Danger Theory about the definition of danger, and the capture of danger signals, which could be helpful to increase the abilities of self-learning and intelligence in different applications.

articleTitle: An improved cooperative PSO algorithm and its application in the flight control system
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Standard particle swarm optimization solely relies on iteration formula to update and depend on initial swarm samples. This can easily make it fall into local optimization. To solve the problem, a new algorithm is proposed using cooperate optimization between two particle swarms. It uses advanced Tent Mapping method to generate initial swarm sample, meanwhile adjusts inertia weight dynamically. This new algorithm can be used in flight control system and the simulation results are very promising.

articleTitle: A processing method for inconsistent answer set programs based on minimal principle
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Answer set programming (ASP) has become an important tool for knowledge representation and reasoning. Inconsistency processing in ASP provides a way for reasoning of inconsistent knowledge. In this paper, we present a minimal principle based method to process inconsistency in ASP. The method is able to ensure maximum retention of certain knowledge by removing the fewest defeasible rules preferentially. Then, we propose corresponding algorithms for simple logic programs and extended logic programs, and analyze the complexity of our method. After that, we compare this method with related work. Finally, we conclude and indicate the prospect of the further research.

articleTitle: Experimental study of spoiler influence to delta wing generated vortex in water towing tank
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper deals with the effects of spoiler to the breakdown features of detached vortex of delta wing at different incidences and incoming flow speeds. Experiments were carried out in a water towing tank. A spoiler generating additional vortex was fixed on the leading edge at resolved position. The vortex generated by spoiler combines with the delta wing detached vortex, which could enhance the stability of detached vortex. The PIV measurements exhibited that, spoiler can postpone the breakdown phenomenon. Flow visualization revealed that, the delay effect of vortex breakdown was very sensitive with respect to the position and dimensions of the spoiler.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis of bearing based on Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In this paper, the feasibility and flexibility of Support Vector Machine which apply to fault diagnosis of bearing have been studied, and a concrete fault diagnosis method is presented. It is combined multi-class arithmetic which adopts decision directed acyclic graph with wavelet packet furthermore, this study conducted with example. Finally, the new method compared with traditional mode identifying methods. And it has been offered for fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Apply proe to cad system development for conventional mechanical transmission parts
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Through to DC servo motor speed governing system of research, the dynamic and static characteristic of speed governing system for single closed loop with current positive feedback and voltage negative feedback were analyzed and made a simulation by means of mathematic model gave, the reliable theory basis was provided for the practical application of speed governing scheme.

articleTitle: Location based adaptive routing protocol for underwater acoustic sensor networks
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: By analyzing the advantages and disadvantages of existing routing protocol of underwater acoustic sensor network, combining with underwater acoustic channel model, the author proposes a novel adaptive routing protocol based on the location of the nodes (LARP). The routing protocol can select forward route adaptively according to the level of data packets and the dynamic characteristics of underwater environment. Therefore, it can reduce the delay of network transmission, save the network energy consumption and improve the quality of the network communication effectively. Finally, through the simulation of four different routing mechanism: HH-VBF, VBF, MPR and LARP, our routing protocol's superiority is verified.

articleTitle: Map building for multi-robotic system based on robot technology middleware
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Multi-robot system is widely used in exploring in large-scale unknown environment and performing the complex tasks. This paper presents map building for multi-robot system using RTM as communication platform. We use the Player Project works as simulation platform to realize topological map for multi-robotic system and use SP2ATM algorithm for path planning. The paper presents the architecture of the proposed method and gives some experiments to verify the effectiveness.

articleTitle: Stabilization of NCSs over SNR constrained channels with disturbance observer
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: A signal-to-noise (SNR) method is used to obtain a tight bound for linear time invariant (LTI) coding systems over an additive Gaussian noise channel. Both spectral factorization methods and disturbance observer are utilized, with complete results provided for internal stability, the infimal signal to noise ratio (SNR) required and a four-step iterative design procedure. A numerical example is given to illustrate the results.

articleTitle: A modified Square-root Unscented Kalman Filter restraining outliers
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Aiming at solving the problem that the accuracy and stability of Square-root Unscented Kalman Filter(SRUKF) will be affected if there are outliers in the observation values, this paper proposes an improved SRUKF restraining outliers based on orthogonality of innovation in the filtering processing. This modified filter at first detects whether there are outliers in the observation values by judging if the orthogonality of innovation is lost or not, and then assigns an activation function as the weight to each observation value, which can keep the orthogonal properties of the innovation sequence and the outliers can be detected and corrected. The Matlab simulation results about the GPS/DR integrated navigation system show that this modified filter is effectively resistant to outliers in the observation values and improves the filtering accuracy and stability.

articleTitle: Realization of implementing sound mixing technology in Digital Smart Home Terminal
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: To enable multichannel audio streaming play simultaneously with one set of audio device in Digital Smart Home Terminal, multichannel data resampling and sound mixing should be realized. This paper introduces the resampling and mixing filter components based on the frame of Mediastreamer2. Sinc function interpolation method is used to realize implementing sound mixing technique in digital smart home terminal and average algorithm is used in mixing data. A test on S3C6410 is given to this mixing audio technology, and the result shows that it is feasible, with an acceptable range of distortion error.

articleTitle: Coordinated-turn control law design of aircraft based on optimal tracking
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The latitude movement of aircraft has strong coupling and poor stability, and takes on strong nonlinear. Coordinated-turn control is one of the latitude control research interests. Using optimal tracking controller combined with proportion integration differentiation (PID) to solve the sideslips of coordinated-turn. Based on the fixed-wing airplane linearization model??the application of optimal tracking in the lateral controller design is studied. And during the action the influence of roll angle and attack angle is analyzed. The experimental result shows the proposed method effectively.

articleTitle: Opinion summarization of customer reviews
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper focuses on the problem of opinion summarization of customer reviews, which has not been solved completely in how to get a summary that overlaps the most important topics of review text and to extract the opinion on these topics. With the intuition that both factual text and evaluative text should be considered in opinion summarization, this paper deals with sentiment and topics of review text simultaneously and proposes a multi-document opinion summarization approach based on Latent Dirichlet Allocation model. Experiments on product reviews show that the approach is effective.

articleTitle: Data stream prediction in distributed stream processing environment
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: With the wide adoption of distributed stream processing, the requirement of guaranteeing QoS has been raised to a new standard. Since node load influences QoS directly, it is a hotspot of research. Through analyzing the relationship between input data stream and load of physical node, this paper abstracted a local node model from traditional distributed stream processing network. Based on this model, a new data stream prediction algorithm grounded on a classic machine learning algorithm — Share Algorithm — is proposed. The new algorithm uses recent data stream as the prediction resource and efficiently accomplishes the prediction of single nodes in the future period. Our experiments show that 73% of predictions can achieve the accuracy more than 90% with some common data traces.

articleTitle: An improved direct torque control approach for asynchronous wind power generator
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: An improved scheme for direct torque control of asynchronous wind power generator is presented in this paper. It is not only simple but also can match for the performance of conventional hysteresis comparator. In the paper, a torque fuzzy PI controller and a linkage PI controller are used to replace the conventional hysteresis comparator. Simulation results show that the improved method of direct torque control based on space vector pulse width modulation proposed in the paper improves the performance significantly for reducing the torque ripple and the generator start current, as well as enhancing the performance of the whole wind turbine generator control system.

articleTitle: An improved method to robot's environment map-building based on the normal distribution transform
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: According to the problem that the traditional map-building method has high complexity, a map-matching method based on the combination of normal distribution transform (NDT) and environment feature extraction is proposed. The real-time environment information is obtained by two dimension laser sensors, from which the geometric feature is extracted and it will be transformed into normal distribution using NDT method, then the map is matched the by Newton' s algorithm. The method can reduce the complexity of the traditional NDT process, improving the efficiency of the map-matching. The experiment results demonstrate the effectiveness and superiority of the method.

articleTitle: Research of frame synchronization technology for burst OFDM system
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In OFDM burst communication system, frame synchronization plays a vital role and it directly affects the performance of the entire communication system. This paper proposes a frame synchronization scheme with energy detection and accurate synchronization for Power Channel which presents strong interference, poor time-varying and severe frequency select. Experimental results show that the frame synchronization scheme has the advantages of high probability of detection and low probability false alarm.

articleTitle: FEA on vibration characteristics of an aero-engine turbine rotor
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: A method for vibration characteristics analysis of an aero-engine turbine rotor is presented in this paper. The natural modal analysis for dynamical analysis is made and the results can be used as criterion of many dynamics characteristics and further analysis. In this paper, the natural modal of an aero-engine turbine rotor with the joint hole fully constrained and in free status is calculated respectively. And the first ten natural frequencies and mode shapes are obtained. Also, vibration characteristics of each natural modal and the corresponding influence on the turbine rotor and other structure are discussed. The analysis method and results presented in this paper can be used for further analysis on optimal design and vibration safety verification for the turbine rotor system.

articleTitle: Robust control with state decoupler for combined shape and gauge system in rolling process
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Considering the dynamic characteristics of the deformation zone, a new model of combined shape and thickness system in rolling process was proposed, regarding bending force and gauge as the main factors. Taking various kinds of secondary causes, perturbation and disturbance into consideration, robust control methods were brought in. A mathematic model was proposed based on field data, then static decoupler and robust controller were developed with benefit of robust control toolbox in MATLAB. Simulation results show the effectiveness of tracing and decoupling and robustness for parameter perturbation.

articleTitle: 3D location of non-cooperative circle target based on monocular vision and laser range finder
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper studies on the position and orientation estimation method of non-cooperative circle target based on monocular vision and laser range finder. According to an image with the radius of a circle unknown, the measurement information of laser range finder and the image coordinate of laser spot, we can obtain the location information of non-cooperative circle target. Because the camera does not need to move to take two separate images, this algorithm is more convenient and quicker. The experiment results also show that the proposed algorithm is effective and accurate.

articleTitle: Implemention of hardware-assisted virtual machine cache partitioning
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: With the growing number of processor cores, how to efficiently use the processor core resources has become a major challenge for the computer field. As a new computing model, virtualization technology can take full advantage of multi-core processors to improve system resource utilization. The last level cache shared between the virtual machines running on the multi-core processor. The current multi-core processors using the LRU implicit partitioning strategy will make a big performance loss. This paper gives a hardware-assisted implementation of cache partitioning. We choose some applications from SPEC CPU 2006 to experiment. From the experimental results we can see, the best cache partitioning can improve performance of virtual machine by 10%.

articleTitle: Study ip - iq theory and Wavelet Transform method for harmonic current detection
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Currently, It is hard to analyze and detect the dynamic harmonic quickly and exactly using the Traditional analysis methods for the Power system harmonic, the Wavelet Transformation has the advantage to analyze the fluctuating and fast changing harmonic. This paper has proposed a new harmonic current detection method based on the Wavelet Transformation so that it can analyze any harmonic well. This paper compares the harmonic current detection method based on the instantaneous reactive power theory with the Wavelet Transformation in the simulation and experiment, the test results show that the Wavelet Transformation has double resolutions in the both time & frequency domains, it has the fast dynamic response speed and the good accuracy, which can solve the harmonic problem analysis well. In this paper, it takes the PCI -1712L high speed data acquisition card and designs a set of harmonic current detection device based on VB and Excel or based on LabVIEW software. The model machine shows that the harmonic current detection method based on the Wavelet Transformation has the best effect

articleTitle: Realization of simultaneous perturbation stochastic approximation using FPGA for on-line PID parameter tuning
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Simultaneous perturbation stochastic approximation (SPSA) algorithm has attracted considerable attention for challenging optimization problems. SPSA is a highly efficient gradient approximation that relies on two measurements of the objective function. On the other hand, field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs) are glue logic and prototyping devices jumping to product. In recent years, FPGAs have become essential in the design of digital systems, complementary to the role played by microprocessors. This paper addresses realization of SPSA using FPGA for on-line parameter tuning for the PID controller. The voice coil motor (VCM) is used as a plant for illustrating the position control performance. Three stages are presented to develop a FPGA chip of the specific function, namely, Simulink simulation, hardware simulation and FPGA with hardware implementation. Experimental results show that realization of SPSA using the FPGA is very efficient for on-line application.

articleTitle: A new cooperative multi-robot path planning in dynamic environment
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Dynamic path planning is a fundamental and difficult problem in mobile robotics. This paper presents a new approach of multi-robot path planning in dynamic environments, by using cooperative co-evolution and APF algorithm. The key ideal of our approach is to combine with global and local path planning, and to make fully use of centralized and distributed approach via information fusion mechanism. The proposed approach has been simulated in the TeamBots (a popular tool of multi-robot simulation). The results of dynamic simulation show the efficiency of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Digital watermarking algorithm based on singular value decomposition and wavelet transformation
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: How to prove the robustness of robust watermarking against geometrical attacks is still a difficulty of watermarking researchers. Merely using singular value decomposition or wavelet transform watermarking algorithm has different faults. This paper proposed a novel watermarking based on SVD and DWT, which was robust to common geometrical attacks. In the embedding, the lowest frequency components of the source image which were transformed into DWT were divided into sub-blocks in order to improve capacity of watermarking. Then the watermark is embedded in the singular values of sub-blocks after being Arnold scrambled. And the robustness of watermarking could be improved. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can resist many kinds of attacks very well, and has good robustness and invisibility, and solve the contradiction between the robustness and the invisibility.

articleTitle: The intelligent boiler control system of self-learning and self-optimizing
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This article discusses the design of intelligent controller for combustion process of Stack-boiler. From the principle of energy conversion and conservation of fuel combustion, it puts forward a kind of control method which calculates the Stack-boiler's real time efficiency on-line, and uses the self-learning and self-optimizing fuzzy control system to online adjust the air-coal ratio of Stack-boiler in the premise of satisfying the target load, and to make the Stack-boiler's furnace combustion efficiency to achieve optimal. The control system not only makes the Stack-boiler in the optimal combustion state, but also realizes the real-time online monitoring of the Stack-boiler, and realizes the economic, environmental protection operation of the Stack-boiler.

articleTitle: Decision making model based on state assessment and hierarchical FSM in robot soccer
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In order to improve validity and pertinence of strategies in robot soccer, this paper put forward a finite state automatons hierarchical decision model based on match state estimations. This model synthesizes and quantitates the information of state estimations and feedback of performing effects, establishes tactics conversion relationship based on finite state automatons, accordingly makes a tactic suiting current states. The simulations indicate that the decision model in this paper improves validity and pertinence of tactics to a great extent, enabling that whole abilities of attacking and defending for the soccer team attain corresponding melioration.

articleTitle: Optimization selection evaluation for crossing site establishment schemes of fuzzy matter-element of approaching an ideal solution
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Fuzzy matter-element assessment approach approaching an ideal solution to evaluate the schemes is adopted since the location selecting of crossing site establishment involves many factors and commanders are difficult to make scientific decision. Fuzzy matter-element evaluation model with six presupposing crossing site was set up, in consideration of twelve indexes of optimization selection including the river width, velocity, water depth, unloading field, probability of obstacles in the river, bank slope, bank height, rendezvous field area, entering and evacuation time, protection and alert efficiency, work amount of military temporary road and hidden security. The order in selecting of each crossing site was determined by calculating weighted indexes relatively good membership of composite fuzzy matter-element. It provides a scientifically rational and simple evaluation method to solve such issues.

articleTitle: AN improved interpolation method using FFT
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In this paper, an improved interpolation method using FFT is proposed. The improved interpolation method takes the advantages of the two interpolation methods which one is using filter and another is using FFT, and can effectively improve the accuracy by reconstructing the samples on both ends of the sequence which is interpolated by the FFT method. Experimental results show that, compared with the FFT-based interpolation method proposed by Prasad, the method presented here can increase the accuracy of interpolation by 100 times or so, while only increase the computational amount by 3.1%. Compared with the interpolation method using filter, under the condition of same computational amount, the method presented here can increase the accuracy of interpolation by more than 10 times.

articleTitle: Improved simulated annealing algorithm for GTSP
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: By analyzing the principles and shortcomings of traditional simulated annealing algorithm, an improved simulated annealing algorithm for solving GTSP (Generalized Traveling Salesman Problem) is proposed. In this paper GTSP is changed into multi-segment map problem which is solved with dynamic programming algorithm by individual coding. Individual fitness function based on multi-segment map optimal sub-structure is designed to speed up algorithm calculation. Experimental test results show that the new algorithm has faster convergence and better solution than traditional simulated annealing algorithm.

articleTitle: Find a Multi-agent planning solution in nondeterministic domain
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In the Multi-agent planning domain, every agents have its own target state, and the planning problem is that the agents arrive the target state from the initial state without conflict. Finding a Multi-agent planning solution in the deterministic domain is a very hot problem. However, it is a problem to be studied in the nondeterministic domain. We study on the issue, and propose a solution algorithm. Firstly, the idea of the algorithm is to take the state layered by the hierarchical thinking. Secondly, search by the partial greedy choice and backtracking according to the conflicting list of the current state set of the agents. Finally, find a collaborative planning without conflict.

articleTitle: Robust MP-augmented ukf algorithm in integrated navigation system
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Based on the researches of the advantages and disadvantages for model prediction filter, robust filter and unscented Kalman filter, a new robust model predictive-augmented UKF algorithm is proposed. And the input of the system state information is increased by add the drive noise into the system states. The model error is restrained by model predictive filter, and the robustness of the system is enhanced by robust estimation, overcoming the deficiency that the unscented Kalman filter is more sensitive to system model errors. The proposed new algorithm is applied to the SINS/CNS/SAR integrated navigation system for simulation, and the results show that the algorithm can effectively restrain attitude angle error and velocity error, and the convergence rate and accuracy of the filter is superior to the unscented Kalman filter.

articleTitle: A visual automatic objective cognition method using human instruction for robot imitation
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: A visual automatic objective cognition method using human instruction for robot imitation learning is proposed. The image sequences of human instruction are segmented into some sets of image s sequences of object using dynamic detection. These images are extracted from some features in the defined features pool to construct a features database. Features in this database are clustered based on density to refine clusters of conceptions corresponded to objects. This method can cognize the objects in daily environment autonomously and incrementally with the help of human's instruction, and the results of experiment prove effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: A BICM-ID based FM IBOC DAB system
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In this paper, the application bit-interleaved coded modulation with iterative decoding (BICM-ID) for FM IBOC DAB systems over Rayleigh fading channel is addressed. As compared with TCM which utilizes symbol interleaved, in addition to implementation advantages, BICM-ID performs well on fading channel for bandwidth-efficient transmission. Here, this dissertation analyzes the key element of BICM-ID, and then addresses the optimal solution to yield a significant improvement for FM IBOC DAB systems. Various analytical and simulation results reveal that our design optimized with BICM-ID outperform the conventional approach in civilian applications.

Author Keywords: Bit-interleaved coded modulation with iterative decoding

articleTitle: Based on fuzzy-PID control of the pedal stroke simulator applications in brake-by-wire-systems
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Analysis and comparison with conventional brake systems and brake-by-wire-system with pedal stroke simulator, and the establishment of the pedal stroke simulator model with the AMESim software, joint Matlab/Simulink software to design fuzzy-PID control strategy of the pedal stroke simulator. Through simulation verification draw that this brake-by-wire-systems and the control strategy can achieve the requirements of conventional brake systems, and effectively improve comfort during braking.

articleTitle: Missile terminal guidance trajectory optimization with radar imaging constraints
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Azimuth resolution of Synthetic Aperture Radar(SAR) is closely related to the trajectory of platform. For the missile-borne SAR, its terminal guidance trajectory not only satisfies with SAR imaging constraints, but also satisfies with the capability of striking front target. In order to acquire the best azimuth resolution within a fixed time, direct shooting method is used in two-dimensional trajectory optimization of SAR terminal guidance. Firstly, optimization model of missile-borne SAR terminal guidance is established, that is, missile command acceleration is as optimal variables, minimum dwell time is as object function. Expressions of object function, imaging constraints, overload constraints are given in detail. Secondly, control variables is discretized to using direct method to convert the optimal control problem into a nonlinear programming problem. Lastly, sequential quadratic programming method is used to solving the nonlinear programming problem. Simulation results demonstrate the validity of the method.

articleTitle: BLDCM servo control using a novel predictive variable structure control strategy
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In this paper, a novel variable structure control algorithm, named predictive variable structure(PVS) control, is designed for a brushless DC motor servo system to track a given referred position signal. The PVS control strategy is described in detail based on phase plane analysis, and exponential stability of the controlled closed-loop system is proved. Since in this novel control strategy no sliding mode is constructed, the chattering in conventional sliding mode variable structure control method can be eliminated. Moreover, this control strategy can avoid overshoot and is computational efficient. Experiment results demonstrate that the control method improve dynamic and static performances of brushless DC motor servo control systems.

articleTitle: Modelling method of 3D tunnel with collapsible fractures based on Java3D1
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Tunnel modelling is one of hot research areas on digital mine. Analyzing the basic elements and the topological relationship of the 3D tunnel model, 3D tunnel model with collapsible fractures is proposed. Data model of 3D tunnel is conducted in-depth study; data structure of 3D tunnel model with collapsible fractures is defined, and the key issues of the model are studied. On that basis, modelling method of the 3D tunnel model with collapsible fractures is detailed studied, and it is carried on programming with Java3D. The result shows that, 3D tunnel can be reasonably described with the model, and the model can be used to model the 3d mine geography network and to analyze the applications based on the 3D mine geography network.

articleTitle: Strategy for complete hole patching based on greedy algorithm in wireless sensor network
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In Wireless sensor network, node error, energy depletion and other factors will lead to the appearance of hole which will cause network failure. So it's necessary to activate some inactive nodes to patch hole. In order to select the right nodes from the set of inactive nodes to patch hole efficiently, a strategy for complete hole patching based on greedy algorithm is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the strategy analysis its feature by detecting hole. Secondly, according to the characteristics of hole greedy algorithm is used to select the appropriate nodes from an inactive set of nodes to patch hole. In the algorithm, choose an inactive node which can cover the most arc intersections of hole first. Then select the following nodes by the same rule. When a new node is selected, at least one arc intersection of hole must be covered. Repeat this procedure until the hole is complete patched. Finally, through the simulation experiments to prove the proposed strategy is effective, and analysis the performance of the strategy based on the comparison of the experiment results. Using the proposed strategy can realize complete hole patching, and enhance the coverage ability and utilization of patching node.

articleTitle: Study on coastline changes of Yellow River estuary using semi-supervised clustering
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper proposes an image segmentation strategy based on semi-supervised clustering. Firstly, we extract band information from images to generate pixel datasets; secondly, incorporate the instance-level knowledge in the form of pairwise constraints to assist clustering, and partition two clusters; finally, generate binary images based on clustering results so as to segment land and ocean. Then, we utilize our method to extract coastlines of Yellow River estuary in 1978, 1989, 1999 and 2009, so as to analyse the coastline evolution of Yellow River estuary.

articleTitle: A new algorithm for image fusion via sparse representation
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: An image fusion method is presented to sharpen the multi-spectral image using sparse representation. Firstly, IHS transform is applied to multi-spectral image. Achieve new intensity component which takes the method of smoothing filter-based intensity modulation on the original intensity component. Subsequently, the intensity component and panchromatic image are fused their sparse coefficient through sparse representation. Finally, the fused image is achieved by the IHS transformation. The test results prove that suggested method improves spatial resolution and maintain spectral characteristics comparison with some conventional method.

articleTitle: Development of identification and control software for proportional decompression valve
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper developed a piece of user-friendly automatic identification and control software based on MATLAB and xPC hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) test bench. This software can realize the functions of testing, identification and verification, control simulation and results analysis for proportional decompression valve in Electro-Hydraulic Brake (EHB) system.

articleTitle: Reference command tracking and simulation research of hypersonic cruise vehicle
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The focus of this paper is on control design and simulation for an air-breathing hypersonic cruise vehicle (HCV). Aiming at the highly nonlinear and strong coupling for HCV mathematical model, the theory of feedback linearization based Lie derivative introduced can convert accurately nonlinear mathematic model into equivalent linear model for control design. By the proper transformation, dynamic inversion flight control systems for hypersonic vehicle designed can stabilize the system and relieve the coupling effects. Simulation results show the correctness of the simulation platform and the effectiveness of the control approach.

articleTitle: A new flame region orientation method based on CMYK color feature
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In order to promote orientation efficiency of flame area in a forest fire monitoring system, this paper proposes a combination algorithm of color property based on CMYK color space and genetic algorithm. It implements and configures M, Y, K elements as the adaptation function factors and uses neighborhood region's color lower order moments as the features and could gain a accurate primary orientation of forest flame of a frame image in 0.05 s. It will do further verification to the primary orientation of forest flame by color mutual information calculation between key template image and searched window region image. The experiments show that the algorithm has a better orientation result and calculation efficiency.

articleTitle: Distributed estimation with convolutional coding in wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The problem of distributed estimation of an unknown noise-corrupted parameter in wireless sensor networks (WSNs) is considered in this paper. Because of the impact of noise channels, convolutional coding is used to protect the transmission of sensor observations here. To minimize the total power consumption, a novel kinds of power scheduling is derived. The formulas of the proposed power scheduling suggest local sensors with poor observation qualities should decrease their quantization levels and the levels should be also related to coding methods, channel qualities, given mean squared error (MSE) and local signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). Finally, simulation results show that not only is the scheme energy-efficient but also it achieves comparable performance of a given MSE.

articleTitle: Representative Based Data Stream Clustering algorithm
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: To solve the problem of data streams clustering, the algorithm RB-Stream (Representative-Based Data Stream Clustering) was proposed. Firstly, this paper presented the concept of circular-point based on the representative points and designed the iterative algorithm to find the density-connected circular-points representing the clusters. Secondly, the author designed the adjacent list to save clusters for both storage and retrieve efficiency. The RB-Stream algorithm can find the clusters of different shapes under the data stream environment, it is capable of capturing the evolving clusters by introducing the temporal density. The experiments show that the RB-Stream algorithm is feasible and scale expandable.

articleTitle: Parallel auto-pumping control of vacuum system on TEM
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: For the normal operation of TEM, the required vacuum must be achieved in order to avoid the interaction of electrons and gas molecules within column. According to the vacuum demand of the normal operation of TEM, the vacuum system structure is marked out, then the pumping flow is designed which adopt parallel pumping method of vacuum pump. This method shortens the pumping time and heightens the use efficiency of vacuum pump. For actualizing automatic pumping, the pumping object of vacuum pump is exchanged by controlling open or close of isolation valve with PLC by computer programming. Finally, the measurement results indicate that vacuum system can fulfil the pre-established vacuum demand.

articleTitle: An Mahalanobis distances based text clustering algorithm
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Though traditional fuzzy partitional text clustering algorithms are one of the most widely used methods, they are only fit to detect spherical structural clusters because they are based on Euclidean distances. When the data set has high dimensions, the accuracy and efficiency will decrease. Focus on solving this problem, a Fuzzy Mahalanobis distances based text clustering algorithm was proposed. Otherwise, finding eigenvalue and eigenvectors of a symmetric matrix or computing pseudoinvertion were used to avoid the singular values problem when finding Mahalanobis distances. The numerical experimental results show the validity of the proposed methods.

articleTitle: Improvement of TCP Reno protocol in wireless networks
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: If three duplicate acknowledgements are received, TCP Reno protocol would judge the occurrence of congestion somewhere between source and destination of network, and then halve the rate. This paper introduces the congestion judgment indicator of TCP Vegas into TCP Reno protocol in wireless networks, and analyses these duplicate acknowledgements further, if the current network is not in a state of congestion, then it doesn't need to reduce rate and thereby the throughput of wireless networks would be improved.

articleTitle: A three-stage power control trategy and simulation of induction heating power
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: To a certain extent, the traditional voltage and current double closed-loop regulation is able to satisfy the regulatory requirements of induction heating power supply. However, its limiting effect to voltage or current will cause the phenomenon that the output power is less than the rated power. Therefore in this paper, a novel three-stage power regulation strategy is put forward based on the analysis of the working condition of a parallel inverter and comparison with the traditional voltage and current double closed-loop control strategy. It makes the power supply maintain load matching and output a constant rated power. And the regulation of system is simulated using matlab when the analog load changes and the net voltage fluctuates, which confirms the advantage of the proposed three-stage power regulation strategy.

articleTitle: Formal verification of mutex of concurrent system
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The model of concurrent system is the research foundation of its performance evaluation, simulation, scheduling and control. Mutex is one of the most important features of concurrent. systems.This paper establishes a general mathematical model—Mutex-Model for exclusive systems. Decomposes the mutex property of concurrent system into safety, liveness and non-blocking and translates these features into LTL formulas formal specification. Gives a model checking algorithm based on fixed-point theory for Mutex-Model. And then combines with an example, the paper formally verifies the Mutex-Model Gives the explicit refinement and improvement of the model. As concurrent system's processes increase, this model checking algorithm have to face state explosion problem. So the paper gives another symbolic model checking algorithm based on BDD and Boolean formulas. This algorithm is simple and efficient, and effectively alleviate the state explosion problem.

articleTitle: Security weaknesses of two-parity ID-based authenticated key agreement protocols
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: We analyse the existing ID-based authenticated key agreement protocols, and find out that several proposed protocols of this type do not satisfy related security attributes. This paper reviews Wang's, He's and Guo's protocols sequentially, and shows key compromise impersonation attack on Wang's scheme, ephemeral secrets reveal attack on He's scheme, key reveal attack and ephemeral secrets reveal attack on Guo's scheme, respectively, Finally, this paper proposes some improving suggestions on corresponding weaknesses of these protocols.

articleTitle: A cluster routing algorithm based on small-world model
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: A routing clustering algorithm based on the small world model is presented to overcome the problem of LEACH's unreasonable cluster head selection and the uneven energy consumption. First of all, the method optimizes the topology optimization the wireless sensor network by clustering coefficient feature of small world. Secondly, it chooses cluster heads considering energy and degree of each node in the network. Simulation result shows that the method can optimize the network topology. Compared with LEACH algorithm and LEACH-improved algorithm which doesn't considerate the degree of nodes, the proposed method also enhances the life time of nodes, reduces the overall energy consumption and improves load balance of the network.

articleTitle: A cooperative sampling scheme for field sampling in dense wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Field sampling is a significant kind of application of wireless sensor networks (WSNs). In this application, multiple sensor nodes usually cooperate to sample and estimate the physical signal. A sampling scheme which only considers the sampling process of each sensor node is not suitable for the application. Cooperative sampling with multiple sensor nodes can fulfil the application. For a dense WSN in which more sensor nodes are deployed in an interested field, cooperative sampling scheme is crucial for conserving energy and improving estimation accuracy. In this paper, we present a cooperative sampling scheme for field sampling application. The basis of the scheme is to group the suitable sensor nodes and arrange the sampling time of these groups. The analysis and simulation results show that, under the restriction of the estimation accuracy, the scheme can conserve the energy of the sensor nodes and balance the energy consumption amongst the different groups.

articleTitle: Bearing fault diagnosis based on Lie group classifier
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper briefly describes the framework of Lie group classifier, then Lie group classifier is introduced to detect fault of bearings, aiming at the characteristics of bearing fault vibration signals. Firstly, training feature set and test feature set are constructed from fault vibration signal. The two sets consist of mean value, energy, root-mean-square value, peak value, crest factor, kurtosis, shape factor, clearance factor. Secondly, training feature set is applied to Lie group classifier to compute classifier parameters. Thirdly, bearing fault is diagnosed by Lie group classifier based on test feature set. The results show that this method can detect fault with high accuracy rate and it presents a new method for bearing fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Model reduction of electric load simulator
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Because of the limitation of linear controllers used in the present development stage, model reduction of electric load simulator with a high-order nonlinear model becomes the basis of control system design. To solve this problem, Balanced Truncation is proposed in this paper as the improvement of traditional Dominant Poles for model reduction. An analysis method of model reduction error based on H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> norm is also researched to evaluate the reduction effect of different ways. A synthesis error including linearization error and order reduction error can be obtained and analysed finally. Compared with Dominant Poles, the superiority of Balanced Truncation in model reduction of electric load simulator is testified by the experimental verification.

articleTitle: Calculation principle of dynamic derivatives for wire-driven parallel suspension systems used in forced oscillation experiments in low-speed wind tunnels
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
