abstract: Traditional model suspension systems of the wind tunnel experiment to determine dynamic derivatives are summarized. And the development of cable-mounted suspension systems is stated and its feasible calculation method of aerodynamic force/torque by a balance between the scale model and the cable connectors is analyzed in detail at the first time. After analysis of the difference between wire-driven parallel suspension systems and cable-mounted suspension systems, the advantages of WDPSS are presented and the state-of-art is given. The 2 issues including the connection manner among the model, the balance and the strut as well as the identification of dynamic derivatives based on calculation of the aerodynamic force/torque are investigated. The research results will be helpful for further study of WDPSS for used in forced oscillation experiments in low-speed wind tunnels.

articleTitle: Multiple video watermarks based on 3D-DWT and 3D-DCT robust to geometrical attacks
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: For the copyright protection of digital video, a new video watermarking algorithm based on 3D-DWT&DCT is proposed. We select video segment and get 3D-DWT&DCT coefficients using 3D-DWT&DCT. The sign sequence of 3DDWT&DCT coefficients is used as feature vector, which is utilized to enhance the robustness against geometrical attacks. Combining the concept of third-party, we describe how to embed and extract the multiple watermarks. Simulation results demonstrate the proposed algorithm has strong robustness to geometrical attacks.

articleTitle: Study on distortion-quantization models based on DCT coefficient distribution models
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In H.264/AVC, rate control and mode decision play important roles for efficient video compression. Usually, rate control employs R-D model to select the quantization parameter for precise bit rate control. R-D model which includes rate quantization (R-Q) model and distortion quantization (D-Q) model can be derived from mathematic modeling based on distribution of DCT coefficients. Therefore, the DCT coefficients distribution models are very important for D-Q modeling. Currently, some D-Q models have been proposed based on these three models, such as Laplacian, Cauchy and Generalized Gaussian Distribution (GGD), but there is no systematic and rigorous comparison on their accuracy. In this paper, we will have an analysis on three DCT coefficients distribution models. Also, we will test several existing D-Q models and give fair comparison on these models. This work is meaningful for efficient video coding algorithm optimization in the future.

articleTitle: Removing multiplicative noise using A data-fidelity term and nonlocal total variation
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In this paper, we consider a hybrid method for removing multiplicative noise e.g. speckle noise. Our model consists of l<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> data-fidelity term and the nonlocal total variation as regularizer. The l<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> data-fidelity term can preserve edges during despecking framework in the curvelet domain. We import the nonlocal total variation as regularizer which can recover the textures and local geometry structures. Moreover, the efficiency of the algorithm adopted here is based on operator Augmented Lagrangian for the hybrid method. Experiments show that the proposed scheme outperforms the most recent methods in this field.

articleTitle: A new intra-frame rate control algorithm based on edge information for H.264
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a new rate-quantization(R-Q) model and rate control algorithm for I-frames in H.264/AVC. The number of target bits for the first I frame is corrected based on pre-encoding of the first two frames, and the number of target bits of an ordinary I frame is determined by the relation among the number of bits generated for I frame and P frames of the recently encoded GOP. The Q<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">step</inf> is obtained according to the R-Q model which takes the frame complexity and buffer status into consideration. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can increase the average PSNR (peak signal-to-noise ratio) of reconstructed video by 0.96 dB for QCIF sequences and 0.46dB for CIF sequences. At the same time, some skipped frames are avoided.

articleTitle: Research and implementation of servo control of seismic platform
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The occurrence of the recent tsunami and earthquake tremors looks so alarmed. The government and the residents are concerned with the ability of the buildings constructed to withstand the vibrations resulted from the earthquakes. The challenge is to develop an Earthquake Simulator that can generate sine wave and real earthquake signal playback. Use National Instruments (NI) LabVIEW, and the PCI-6221 module, to create an easy-to-use software and hardware solution for controlling large public earthquake simulators in this paper. This system is named as the earthquake simulator system. The objective of the Earthquake Simulator System is to act as a test platform for the structural analysis of scaled down modelling of buildings under earthquake vibrations and also as a platform to train the public on the safety awareness to tackle the situation during an earthquake event. The experimental results will show the platform can honestly reproduce the historical earthquake.

articleTitle: Parallel model research on the heterogeneous computer system
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The high-performance computing market has entered the Petaflop era, and is aiming to the Exascale supercomputer. One of the important approaches to achieving the Exascale performance is the heterogeneous computing, whereby the capability of each node is extended with the addition of various types of computational accelerators, such as Cell, GPUs, and FPGAs. In such heterogeneous (or hybrid) systems, CPUs offer generality over a wide range of applications while specialized accelerators provide better power efficiency and performance-per-dollar for specific computation patterns. However the parallel of the algorithms on the heterogeneous system is difficult. It is different from the traditional architecture. This paper presents two important parallel programming models which could leverage the computing capacity of the heterogeneous system. One is the CPU-Centred model and the other is Accelerator-Centred model. These models are very useful for the current popular GPU-accelerated systems and the emerging CPU and GPU fusion systems.

articleTitle: Passivity analysis and adaptive control for variable-speed constant-frequency doubly-fed wind power generator
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: A passivity-based control for variable-speed constant-frequency doubly-fed wind power generator is presented. The control system using energy concept considers the doubly-fed induction generator as a non-linear system, combining the control demands of variable-speed constant-frequency wind power generation, the proper reference (steady-state) behaviors and injecting damp method are chosen. The designed controller achieves maximum wind energy capture by keeping unity power factor in the stator side and asymptotic tracking desired rotor speed. Lastly, an adaptive passivity-based control strategy is considered with regard to the doubly-fed induction generator resistances change. Simulation results based on MATLAB/SIMULINK reveal good performance of the proposed control scheme.

articleTitle: Individual pitch control of windturbine based on blade element theory
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Wind shear and tower shadow makes wind speed in the rotor rotating plane changing differently. It affects the corrective pitch control greatly and increases the fatigue load. This paper model 1.5MW wind turbine for individual pitch control, and analyze the main reason of periodic load fluctuation. Then individual pitch control based on blade element theory was researched combining the actual of the load is difficult to measure. Pitch angle was distributed by weight number to realize individual pitch control. The weight number was computed according to the wind speed with consideration of wind shear and tower shadow. Simulations indicate that the proposed individual pitch control method not only meet the basic power control request but also reduce fluctuation of load, so it can solve the problem of fatigue load and prolong the lifetime of wind turbine in process of development to large-scale.

articleTitle: Flight control design for UAV using Hierarchical Dynamic Inversion
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Automatic flight control system is the core on Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV). The flight performance of UAV depends on the quality of designed flight control law to a great extent. Therefore, it is of great significance to study automatic flight control system. The paper discusses the application of Hierarchical Dynamic Inversion (HDI) in the design of a flight control system for fixed-wing UAV. Aiming at the DHC-2 ‘Beaver’, flight simulation involving the Book-shaped trajectory tracking is carried out. Ultimately, the HDI system was compared with the PID system and the results showed that the former has better performance in terms of stability, operability, and accuracy.

articleTitle: Sampling inspection in overall normal inspection
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Hypothesis testing is the mathematical statistics, in accordance with certain assumptions inferred from the overall sample method. Normality test is actually a hypothesis testing. Improving and testing the new statistics on normality test based on the overall normality of the statistic W test method are reasonable.

articleTitle: Active yaw-moment control based on logic threshold and PID control
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Active yaw-moment control (AYC) is one of the advanced active safety technology for modern vehicles which method could enhance vehicle active safety. In this paper the control method with combination of logic threshold and PID control is brought out to improve the vehicle stability. The PID control parameters are generated by logic threshold method through the controller adjusting parameters. The wheel brake torque to keep vehicle stable is calculated by PD controller. The results of simulation show that the self-correcting logic threshold and PD control algorithm can be used to control the vehicle performance effectively.

articleTitle: Fuzzy clustering of clients' credit risk for futures company
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Based on the real clients' transaction data, several characteristic indices are defined and computed first. These indices then serve as basic variables for clustering. K-means clustering and improved fuzzy clustering approaches are applied to client classification. The final classification is obtained by using intersection-based clustering combination algorithm. The clustering result provides the scientific base for futures companies to improve the clients' risk management.

articleTitle: Self-updating algorithm for crosstalk cancellation as old users offline
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Crosstalk is a major factor in inducing performance degradation of the next generation very-high bit-rate digital subscriber line (VDSL) system. Many crosstalk cancellation methods such as Zero-forcing (ZF) algorithm, First-Order (FO) algorithm, iterative crosstalk cancellation algorithm etc. have been proposed. These methods are based on the assumption that the number of users and the crosstalk environment remains unchanged. In actual access environment, the old users are often offline or the new users are on-line, causing the crosstalk environment changed. Therefore, self-updating crosstalk cancellers are often needed. In this paper, we propose a fast algorithm for updating the ZF crosstalk cancellers when the old users are offline. Simulation results based on measured data demonstrate that the proposed self-updating ZF algorithm maintains the same performance as the original ZF algorithm and dramatically reducing the computational complexity.

articleTitle: A cognitive decision model for heterogeneous computing systems
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper proposes a cognitive decision model for heterogeneous computing systems to rationally take advantage of all computing resources for certain applications. We build a cognitive decision model that can convert the problem of distributing certain applications onto several heterogeneous computing resources into a search of problem space where cognitive techniques can play their roles. Based on this model we choose Soar as the modelling tool to create an experiment extracted from a system once we built. Experiments show that our model is applicable and prove that the cognitive decision model can improve the efficiency and performance of heterogeneous computing systems.

articleTitle: A deductible claim process risk model and ruin probability
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper studies a deductible claim process risk model. The author puts an emphasis on studying the risk model under the condition that claim number process is Poisson process and loss distribution is exponential distribution. According to the calculation, draw the interesting conclusion that under the two situations whether regard deductible as claim or not, the aggregate claim is the same. Furthermore, depending on the conclusion in classical risk models draw the expression of relative security loading, adjustment coefficient, and ruin probability. Finally, the author using renewal function and relative conclusion draw the explicit expression of ruin probability in this risk model.

articleTitle: Study on epistemic logical description of metaphor understanding
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Metaphor plays an important role in language epistemology and discourse understanding. The research of metaphor is an increasing important field in cognitive science. We must get along with metaphor in our life. As a common phenomenon, metaphor influences our life as a kind of thinking; because of metaphor we can use a certain area of experience to explain another field experience. In this article, we try to put forward a logical system to descript metaphor understanding. First, we present the basic epistemic logic system, including the language, semantics, and axiomatisation. Then, a conservative metaphor system for the metaphor understanding is constructed based on this system, and the corresponding language, semantics and axiomatisation are presented. Finally, the application of this metaphor epistemic logic system is showed.

articleTitle: Study on the communication robustness of detecting equipment based on wavelet multi-resolution analysis
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper studies the CAN bus communication model of complex intelligent detecting equipment under serious electromagnetic working condition, analyses the effects of the serious interference to the equipment and reasons of the errors in data transmission when working. This paper employs the wavelet multi-resolution analysis, due to the property of time-frequency localization and multi-scale analysis; the disturbed CAN communication signal can be decomposed, filtered and reconstructed. This results in Simulink show that the communication robustness in interfered detecting equipment is improved greatly after wavelet transform.

articleTitle: A new temperature control strategy for foam glass kiln and its application
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In this paper, a new temperature control strategy is proposed by analyzing the working mechanism of the kiln and the temperature control problem in it. First of all, fuzzy neural network is applied to model the foam glass kiln, and optimize weights and threshold value of the neural network with the aid of the Clonal Selection Algorithm. Single and changeless control strategy is no longer applied in the controller design. The structure of the controller is modified at any time in the process of production according to the temperature output error, and its aim is to achieve the best optimal control of the foam glass kiln. The application of the model in the control system is successful and effective. Good control effect makes the product quality has been greatly improved.

articleTitle: DVR real-time compensation signal generation algorithm based on transformation
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of voltage drop by use of serial compensation, real-time compensation signal generation algorithm is designed in order to provide reference input signal to DVR control system. The algorithm uses iterative filtering to generate the reference waveform of the sinusoidal and orthogonal in real time and provides a basis for pqr transformation. In the pqr coordinate system, p -axis component of the ideal voltage signal during the voltage drop is DC, p -axis, r -axis component is zero, which provides a simple representation to the calculation of the compensation component. Calculate the compensation component in the pqr coordinate system and get the compensation component of the abc coordinate system by using the pqr inverse transform in real-time. The simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Research and simulation of guidance law based on GPS/INS combination
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In this work, the proportional navigation (PN) law with gravity compensated based on GPS/INS combination is formulated at first, and a guidance law is designed via Variable Structure Control (VSC). Secondly, as the primary reason of chattering in the traditional VSC, the input Relay-characteristic is improved in order to reduce chattering at the end time, and three continuous functions are given. To evaluate the performance of the two guidance solutions, a numerical simulation of the missile's guidance with a two-order dynamics of the autopilot is used. The results show that, guidance law based on VSC is faster than PN law. Moreover, the improvement has a great effect on reducing chattering at the end time, and the third method addressed by this work has a better result.

articleTitle: A novel algorithm for moving object detection in embedded remote video monitoring system
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: A remote video monitoring system is built based on embedded web server by using moving target monitoring. In the system a novel algorithm based on symmetric difference and background difference is proposed. The system will alert when it detect and recognize the illegal invasion in the scope of monitor. Thus the intelligent monitoring system is achieved. Experiment results show that the new algorithm provides much more detailed information compared with the existing methods.

articleTitle: Effect of zero to the transient performance of automatic control system
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The distribution of pole-zero determines the property of the automatic control system. The paper studies how the additional zeros in the left half of the s-plane affect the transient performance specification of the system by Matlab tools and analyzes the essential reasons for these effects.

articleTitle: The research on the affecting factors of safety management of nuclear power based on improved ISM
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: After the occurrence of the Fukushima nuclear accident, the safety problem of nuclear power is focused on by the whole world. In order to carry out safety management of nuclear power effectively, improved structural interpretation model(ISM) is used to identify and analyze the major factors that affect the implementation of safety management and the relationships between each other. And in this model these factors are classified and analyzed according to their driver power and dependence power. By this way, the structural interpretation model of the safety management of nuclear power is established. The results show that the improvement of laws and regulations is the deepest factor, which should be given a key control in the safety management of nuclear power.

articleTitle: The study on anti-high-g technology of missile body attitude measurement system
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: In high tech local war, it is necessary to develop the guided projectile system in order to improve the range, accuracy and reaction speed. The missile body attitude measurement system is an important part of the guidance system. Solving the survival problem in shells fired high-g harsh environment becomes one important studying field. Anti-high-g material is discussed, and direct at the performance of anti-high-g for the missile body attitude measurement system, we made the ANSYS software simulation, the Machete test and the live-fire flight test. At last, we get a conclusion that the anti-high-g plan can play a good role to reduce the effect of high-g for the missile body attitude measurement system.

articleTitle: Parallelization research on watershed algorithm
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Watershed algorithm is an effective and efficient image segmentation method. However, due to the influence of noise and fine-grained of flat region, too many local extremum can be detected by algorithm, which easily lead to numerous small regions appearing in the follow-up segmentation and over-segmentation. This paper combines the watershed and seeded region growing algorithm to eliminate the phenomenon of over-segmentation, which gets a better result. But when the image size grows bigger and bigger, the number of region segmented by watershed algorithm and the computation of region merging will both increase sharply, which eventually results in that the process of segmenting image to consume much more time. In order to speed up the segmentation, in this paper a parallel method based on MPI is presented, which is composed of watershed algorithm and region merging. Experiment results show that the given algorithm has a good speedup.

articleTitle: PDDL based workflow auto-modeling for Spatial Data Mining
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Spatial Data Mining (SDM) has grown a lot during the last years. More and more data mining operators are brought forward to the SDM domain. A SDM problem can be typically confronted by separating into several steps that could be organized into a workflow which is consisted of several core SDM operators and some assistant operators. However, the large numbers of operators makes it difficult to organize a tailored workflow by a manual workflow modeling. In this paper, an Artificial Intelligence (AI) Planning method is introduced into SDM workflow modeling, while the critical processes and elements for modeling a complete SDM workflow is abstracted and analyzed, and the corresponding elements are formally described by using Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL). After the PDDL description, a JavaFF planner is used to drive the SDM workflow auto-modeling. A demonstration application of workflow auto-modeling for spatial outlier mining is proposed as well, to test the feasibility and availability of automated workflow construction achieved by the presented AI Planning method. The goal of this work is to present an attempt for Auto-Modeling of SDM workflow, and to help users out of previously cumbersome manual design of workflow and meanwhile to lower the threshold by AI Planning.

articleTitle: Analysis of the avalanche property of the KASUMI algorithm
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: The avalanche effect is an important performance that any block cipher must have. Based on the analysis of the KASUMI block cipher and with the KASUMI algorithm program and experiments, the changed ciphertext and the changed bits numbers are given by changing every bit of the plaintext. The avalanche effect of the 64-bit KASUMI plaintext is presented by the detail test data in this paper.

articleTitle: Integration of multi-view matching models for linear array digital imagery
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: For high resolution digital imagery obtained by linear array imaging systems, principles, working procedures of multi-view matching model, including both GC<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> and MVLL model, were introduced. Similarities and differences between GC<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> and MVLL model were analyzed. Then, the method and process to integrate GC<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> and MVLL model was proposed. Based on ADS40 aerial three-line-array image datasets, experiments were done on a discontinuity feature. The experimental results proved that the integrated model could synthesize more image information to enhance matching reliability, and compared with single multi-view matching model, possessed greater matching superiority.

articleTitle: Signal modulation and compatibility analysis of Compass Phase III B2 signal
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: As multiple Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSS) such as GPS, GLONASS, Galileo and Compass are all in service, the spectrum resource of the radio-navigation satellite service is getting scarce, therefore, the effectively using of spectrum and GNSS compatibility becomes a matter of great concern. Alternate Binary Offset Carrier (AltBOC) is an optimized modulation method which transforms two different signals on its different main lobes of spectrum that could utilize the spectrum effectively. After Galileo E5 signal, Compass Phase III (CP III) B2 is the second signal that uses AltBOC modulation. This paper presents the theory of AltBOC modulation and implements few schemes of constant envelope AltBOC for CP III B2 signal. It also discusses certain outstanding characteristics of AltBOC such as code tracking performance, anti-multipath interference, wide Gaber bandwidth, and low d istortion at transmission in h igh-power amp lifier. And compatib ility of CP III B2 AltBOC signal is further analyzed. In simulation section, the compatibility assessment between GPS L5C and CP III B2 AltBOC signal at worldwide geometry locations is carried out and presented with some new results. Simulation results reveal that basic performance of signal and compatibility assessment result both should be taken into account during signal modulation design in current multiple GNSS environment.

articleTitle: A dynamic tracking mechanism for mobile targets in cluster-based WSNS
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: How to save energy for target tracking in WSNs is an important issue. The basic idea of energy-saving method is using sleep mechanism to make nodes into sleeping until they are awaking to process target sensing scheme. However, if nodes enter sleep state too much, targets may lose easily from the sleeping nodes. It is high consuming the energy to find back these losing targets. Thus, it would notice accuracy of tracing targets when saving energy. In this proposal, it offers a scheme about trace of moving target. It uses cluster scheme and algorithm, which apply different strengths and energy-consuming according to different possibility of losing targets. The possibility of lost is aimed to different acceleration of targets and wake up different number of nodes. Lowering losing rate of target can own energy-saving and improved performance.

articleTitle: Classification for concept-drifting data streams with limited amount of labeled data
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Most existing concept-drifting data streams classification approaches assume that the true label of the instance in the data streams can be accessed right after it is classified and utilize it to detect concept drift as well as adjust the current model. It is impractical in real-world applications because manual labelling of data is both costly and time consuming. We apply a novel technique to overcome the problem mentioned above. The proposed method takes advantage of the model clusters generated by the fast KNNModel algorithm to classify the instances in the data streams. With the unlabeled testing instances, the arrival of a novel class and the drift in the underlying concept of a class are detected when the number of instances which are not covered by any model clusters increases rapidly at a certain significance level than that of before. The domain experts are asked to label a few instances to adjust the current model if and only if concept drift happens. Experimental results on both synthetic and real data streams show that compared with the traditional classification algorithms, our method acquires the comparable or better efficacy and efficiency using only a small amount of labelled data

articleTitle: Neural network adaptive robust control based on dead time compensation
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: Executive body of the dead nonlinear has greater influence on the system's performance. In this paper, the dead zone compensation of RBF network adaptive robust control were designed by using the RBF neural network instead of classic compensator of BP network. It can greatly reduce the system parameters and also make the network initialization work clear. GL and the GL matrix multiplication operator were introduced and thus mathematically rigorous proof of the n section joint robot system stability. The simulation results show that this method has good tracking performance and strong robustness.

articleTitle: Comparative study of frequency domain constraints on fir filter design by frequency sampling
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: This paper describes a comparative study of frequency domain constrains of frequency sampling based iterative lowpass filter design. Two new constraints are presented to reduce the iterative number. Simulations show that both the conventional constraint and our new constraints yield similar performance. However, the proposed constraints significantly reduce the iteration number and therefore reduce the computation load.

articleTitle: Study on optimization of A* algorithm based on path planning of terrain following
publicationTitle: International Conference on Automatic Control and Artificial Intelligence (ACAI 2012)
abstract: An improved A* algorithm for the optimization of the vertical flight path based on terrain following is proposed. Which resolves the problem that the A* algorithm needs much more time when searching in big space. The paper primarily analyzes A* algorithm, and presents a new improved method of the traditional A*. In the route planning the approach angle to goal position is considered. Numeral simulations are carried out by using various typical terrain; the results accord with the requirements of optimal reference path in terrain following system. Simulation results show that this is a perfect method for route planning of low altitude penetration with higher quality and efficiency.
